<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <base target="_top">
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <style>
    /* MASHWARAK CUSTOMER WEB — V2.4.2 LAUNCH RELIABILITY */
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');
    :root{
      --navy:#6E1F32;
      --navy2:#8B2B43;
      --navy3:#4F1423;
      --gold:#C7A06A;
      --gold2:#EAD2AC;
      --ink:#31262C;
      --muted:#8D7E84;
      --line:#E8DDDF;
      --soft:#FBF5F3;
      --white:#FFFFFF;
      --green:#1F9D68;
      --red:#D45151;
      --amber:#C98B2B;
      --shadow:0 12px 35px rgba(9,55,77,.10);
      --radius:20px;
      --radius-sm:14px;
    }
    *{box-sizing:border-box}
    html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#eee8e6;color:var(--ink);font-family:'Cairo',Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif}
    body{min-height:100vh}
    button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;font-family:'Cairo',Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif}
    button{cursor:pointer}
    .app{max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;min-height:100vh;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 50px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
    .screen{display:none;min-height:100vh;padding-bottom:90px}
    .screen.active{display:block}
    .topbar{
      position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
      height:66px;padding:0 18px;color:#fff;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),var(--navy2));
      box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(0,35,55,.14)
    }
    .brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;line-height:1}
    .brand b{font-size:22px}
    .brand span{font-size:9px;opacity:.8;margin-top:5px}
    .icon-btn{
      width:38px;height:38px;border:0;border-radius:12px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center
    }
    .hero{
      position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:335px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(4,34,52,.12),rgba(4,34,52,.85)),
        url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1515569067071-ec3b51335dd0?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80') center/cover;
      color:#fff;padding:24px 20px 26px
    }
    .hero:after{
      content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -80px -160px -80px;height:260px;
      background:#fff;border-radius:50% 50% 0 0/24% 24% 0 0
    }
    .hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:2;margin-top:116px}
    .hero-copy .eyebrow{font-size:12px;opacity:.85}
    .hero-copy h1{font-size:28px;margin:8px 0 4px;line-height:1.35}
    .hero-copy h1 span{color:var(--gold2)}
    .hero-copy p{margin:0;font-size:12px;opacity:.88;line-height:1.8}
    .booking-card{
      position:relative;z-index:5;margin:-48px 16px 0;padding:16px;
      background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5edf1;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)
    }
    .segmented{
      display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;padding:5px;background:#f0f5f7;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:14px
    }
    .segmented button{
      border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;background:transparent;color:#637681;font-weight:700;font-size:12px
    }
    .segmented button.active{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy2),var(--navy3));color:#fff;box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(6,65,90,.18)
    }
    .field{
      position:relative;margin-bottom:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius:14px;background:#fff;transition:.2s
    }
    .field:focus-within{border-color:#8bb7c8;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(26,104,132,.08)}
    .field .label{display:block;font-size:9px;color:#81929e;padding:9px 13px 0}
    .field input,.field select,.field textarea{
      width:100%;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;padding:5px 13px 11px;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px
    }
    .field textarea{min-height:78px;resize:vertical}
    .two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
    .estimate{
      margin-top:12px;padding:14px;border-radius:16px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f2f8fa,#e8f2f6);border:1px solid #dce9ef
    }
    .estimate small{display:block;color:#7b909e;font-size:9px}
    .estimate strong{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:var(--navy);font-size:20px}
    .estimate p{font-size:8px;color:#8b9ca6;margin:5px 0 0}
    .primary{
      width:100%;border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 18px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy2),var(--navy3));color:#fff;font-weight:900;
      box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(5,65,90,.18)
    }
    .secondary{
      width:100%;border:1px solid #cfdce3;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 18px;
      background:#fff;color:var(--navy);font-weight:800
    }
    .mini-features{
      display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;padding:18px 16px 10px
    }
    .mini-feature{text-align:center;font-size:9px;color:#647985}
    .mini-icon{
      width:44px;height:44px;margin:0 auto 7px;border-radius:50%;
      display:grid;place-items:center;background:#eef6f8;color:var(--navy2);font-size:19px
    }
    .whatsapp{
      margin:6px 16px 0;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:16px;background:#eaf8f0;color:#147a4e;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800
    }
    .section-pad{padding:18px 16px}
    .page-title{text-align:center;margin:4px 0 18px}
    .page-title .symbol{
      width:50px;height:50px;margin:0 auto 10px;border-radius:16px;display:grid;place-items:center;
      background:#eaf3f6;color:var(--navy2);font-size:24px
    }
    .page-title h2{margin:0;font-size:22px;color:var(--navy)}
    .page-title p{margin:6px auto 0;max-width:320px;color:#7b8f9b;font-size:10px;line-height:1.7}
    .success-box{
      display:none;margin-top:13px;padding:14px;border-radius:15px;background:#e9f8f0;border:1px solid #c4ead5;
      color:#137849;font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;text-align:center
    }
    .error-box{
      display:none;margin-top:13px;padding:12px;border-radius:13px;background:#fff0f0;border:1px solid #f1c9c9;
      color:#a63c3c;font-size:10px;text-align:center
    }
    .availability-details{display:none}
    .admin-login-wrap{padding:36px 18px}
    .admin-card{
      padding:20px;border-radius:22px;border:1px solid #dfe8ed;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow)
    }
    .admin-hero{
      padding:20px 18px 14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),#0f6578);color:#fff
    }
    .admin-hero h2{margin:0;font-size:20px}
    .admin-hero p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:9px;opacity:.78}
    .stats{
      display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px;padding:14px 16px
    }
    .stat{
      padding:14px;border:1px solid #e1eaef;border-radius:16px;background:#fff
    }
    .stat small{display:block;color:#83949f;font-size:9px}
    .stat strong{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:23px;margin-top:6px}
    .tabs{
      display:flex;gap:7px;overflow:auto;padding:0 16px 12px;scrollbar-width:none
    }
    .tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
    .tabs button{
      flex:0 0 auto;border:1px solid #d8e4ea;background:#fff;color:#607581;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 13px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800
    }
    .tabs button.active{background:var(--navy2);border-color:var(--navy2);color:#fff}
    .list{padding:0 16px 20px}
    .list-card{
      padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;border:1px solid #e0e8ed;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(4,45,68,.05)
    }
    .list-card-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
    .list-card h3{margin:0;font-size:13px;color:#203b4b}
    .list-card .meta{margin-top:5px;font-size:9px;color:#7d909c;line-height:1.7}
    .route{margin-top:9px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:11px;background:#f4f8fa;color:#365565;font-size:10px}
    .badge{
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap
    }
    .b-new{background:#fff2cf;color:#9c6a00}
    .b-ok{background:#e5f7ee;color:#147a4e}
    .b-blue{background:#e5f2f8;color:#16617f}
    .b-red{background:#fdeaea;color:#a33d3d}
    .card-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin-top:11px}
    .card-actions button{border-radius:10px;padding:9px;border:1px solid #cbdbe3;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);font-size:9px;font-weight:800}
    .card-actions button.primary-mini{background:var(--navy2);border-color:var(--navy2);color:#fff}
    .bottom-nav{
      position:fixed;bottom:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:40;
      width:min(520px,100%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
      border-top:1px solid #e0e8ec;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)
    }
    .bottom-nav button{
      border:0;background:transparent;padding:9px 4px 8px;color:#728792;font-size:8px;font-weight:800
    }
    .bottom-nav button span{display:block;font-size:19px;margin-bottom:3px}
    .bottom-nav button.active{color:var(--navy2)}
    .loading{
      position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);display:none;place-items:center
    }
    .loading.active{display:grid}
    .spinner{
      width:42px;height:42px;border:4px solid #dce9ee;border-top-color:var(--navy2);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .8s linear infinite
    }
    @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
    .modal{
      position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:80;background:rgba(0,25,38,.58);display:none;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center
    }
    .modal.active{display:flex}
    .modal-sheet{
      width:min(520px,100%);max-height:88vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;padding:18px
    }
    .modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:13px}
    .modal-head h3{margin:0;color:var(--navy)}
    .close-x{width:34px;height:34px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:#eef4f7;color:#49616f}
    .muted{color:#7c909c}
    .hidden{display:none!important}
    @media(min-width:760px){
      body{padding:20px}
      .app{border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;min-height:calc(100vh - 40px)}
      .screen{min-height:calc(100vh - 40px)}
      .bottom-nav{bottom:20px;border-radius:0 0 28px 28px}
    }
  
/* =========================================================
   V1.2 | PROFESSIONAL BURGUNDY MOBILE REDESIGN
========================================================= */
.app{background:#fff9f5!important}
.topbar{
  background:rgba(255,249,245,.97)!important;
  color:var(--ink)!important;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(110,31,50,.08)!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px)
}
.topbar .brand b{color:var(--navy)!important;font-size:20px!important}
.topbar .brand span{color:#9a858b!important}
.topbar .icon-btn{
  background:#fff!important;color:var(--navy)!important;
  border:1px solid #e6d9dc!important;box-shadow:none!important
}

.hero{
  margin:12px 14px 0!important;
  min-height:290px!important;
  border-radius:28px!important;
  padding:24px 20px!important;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 18%,rgba(255,255,255,.13),transparent 31%),
    linear-gradient(145deg,#4f1423,#6e1f32 52%,#8b2b43)!important;
  box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(89,27,45,.17)!important
}
.hero:after{
  content:""!important;position:absolute!important;
  width:170px!important;height:170px!important;border-radius:50%!important;
  right:-52px!important;top:-60px!important;bottom:auto!important;left:auto!important;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)!important
}
.hero:before{
  content:"";position:absolute;width:260px;height:260px;border-radius:50%;
  left:-100px;bottom:-125px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10)
}
.hero-copy{margin-top:22px!important;max-width:340px}
.hero-copy .eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  font-size:9px!important;font-weight:700
}
.hero-copy h1{font-size:30px!important;line-height:1.42!important;margin:17px 0 7px!important}
.hero-copy p{font-size:10.5px!important;line-height:1.9!important;max-width:310px}
.hero-car{
  position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:18px;width:160px;height:90px;z-index:2;
  opacity:.96;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.16))
}

.customerIntro{padding:18px 14px 0}
.customerIntro .kicker{font-size:8px;color:var(--navy);font-weight:900}
.customerIntro h2{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:18px;color:#402d35}
.customerIntro p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:8.5px;color:#908087;line-height:1.7}
.bookingSteps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.bookingStep{
  padding:11px 9px;min-height:96px;border:1px solid #eadfe1;border-radius:17px;
  background:#fff;box-shadow:0 7px 20px rgba(70,26,39,.05)
}
.bookingStep i{
  width:27px;height:27px;border-radius:10px;background:#f7edee;color:var(--navy);
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:8px
}
.bookingStep b{display:block;font-size:8.5px;color:#49353d}
.bookingStep span{display:block;font-size:7px;color:#9a8a90;line-height:1.5;margin-top:3px}

.driverJoinCard{
  margin:14px 14px 0;padding:14px;border:1px solid #eadbdd;border-radius:19px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#fbf3f1);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(71,27,41,.06)
}
.driverJoinIcon{
  width:44px;height:44px;flex:0 0 44px;border-radius:14px;background:#f2e3e6;
  color:var(--navy);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:20px
}
.driverJoinCopy{flex:1}
.driverJoinCopy b{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#412b34}
.driverJoinCopy span{display:block;font-size:7.5px;color:#8d7e84;line-height:1.55;margin-top:3px}
.driverJoinCard button{
  border:0;border-radius:11px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;
  padding:8px 10px;font-size:7.5px;font-weight:900
}

.booking-card{
  margin:14px 14px 0!important;padding:17px!important;
  border-radius:24px!important;border-color:#eadfe1!important;
  box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(86,24,42,.10)!important
}
.booking-card .field{background:#fffdfb!important;border-color:#e8dddf!important}
.booking-card .field:focus-within{border-color:#ba8794!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(110,31,50,.065)!important}
.segmented{background:#f6efef!important}
.segmented button.active{background:#fff!important;color:var(--navy)!important;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(79,20,35,.08)!important}
.estimate{
  background:#fbf5f3!important;border:1px dashed #d7b6bd!important
}
.estimate strong{color:var(--navy)!important;font-size:12px!important}
.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6e1f32,#8b2b43)!important}

.mini-features{padding-top:14px!important}
.mini-feature{color:#7e6f75!important}
.mini-icon{background:#f7edee!important;color:var(--navy)!important}

.adminFooterLinkWrap{
  margin:8px 14px 0;padding:14px 0 22px;border-top:1px solid #e7dcdd;text-align:center
}
.adminFooterLinkWrap p{margin:0;color:#9d8e94;font-size:7px}
.adminFooterLink{
  margin-top:9px;border:0;background:transparent;color:#b4a3a9;
  font-size:7px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px
}

.pageBack{
  width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid #e5d8db;border-radius:12px;
  background:#fff;color:var(--navy);display:grid;place-items:center
}
.admin-hero{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f1423,#6e1f32)!important
}
.adminTopRow{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px
}
.adminBack{
  width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);color:#fff
}
.adminRefresh{
  width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);color:#fff
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.2.1 | POST SUBMISSION RESET / NAVIGATION FIX
========================================================= */
.postSuccessActions{
  display:none;
  grid-template-columns:1fr;
  gap:8px;
  margin-top:10px;
}
.postSuccessActions.active{display:grid}
.postSuccessActions button{
  width:100%;
  border:1px solid #dbcbd0;
  border-radius:13px;
  padding:11px 13px;
  background:#fff;
  color:var(--navy);
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:900;
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.8 | PROFESSIONAL CLEAN REBUILD
   Dark red + gold + white, smaller typography, generic Egypt rides
========================================================= */
:root {
  --mw-red:#B91535;
  --mw-red-dark:#861128;
  --mw-red-deep:#67101F;
  --mw-gold:#E3B64B;
  --mw-gold-soft:#F5D783;
  --mw-ink:#152033;
  --mw-muted:#7E8797;
  --mw-bg:#F4F4F5;
  --mw-line:#E7E9ED;
}

#screenCustomer {
  background:var(--mw-bg)!important;
  padding-bottom:92px!important;
}

.mwTop {
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;z-index:20;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:16px 16px 0;
}
.mwTopBtn {
  width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  border-radius:12px;background:rgba(70,0,15,.18);color:#fff;
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:18px
}

.mwHero {
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  min-height:390px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(135,10,38,.36) 0%,rgba(112,8,30,.28) 40%,rgba(68,5,19,.42) 100%),
    url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1713559528444-c52d007022fe?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1800&q=88') center/cover no-repeat;
  border-radius:0 0 30px 30px;
}
.mwHero::after {
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 66% 18%,rgba(245,215,131,.22),transparent 22%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(185,21,53,.16),transparent 45%);
}
.mwBrand {
  position:relative;z-index:5;text-align:center;color:#fff;padding-top:62px;
}
.mwBrand h1 {
  margin:0;font-size:43px;line-height:1.08;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-1px
}
.mwBrandLine {
  width:54px;height:5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--mw-gold);
  margin:9px auto 8px
}
.mwBrand p {
  margin:0;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.6;color:#fff
}
.mwHeroCopy {
  position:absolute;z-index:5;right:22px;bottom:24px;
  max-width:230px;color:#fff;text-align:right
}
.mwHeroCopy b {
  display:block;font-size:18px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:900
}
.mwHeroCopy span {
  display:block;margin-top:5px;font-size:9px;line-height:1.7;color:#F7EFF1
}
.mwHeroCopy i {
  display:block;width:45px;height:4px;border-radius:999px;
  background:var(--mw-gold);margin-top:10px;margin-right:auto
}

.mwBooking {
  position:relative;z-index:8;
  margin:-14px 14px 0;padding:17px 15px 16px;
  background:#fff;border-radius:22px;border:1px solid #eceef1;
  box-shadow:0 15px 34px rgba(19,31,50,.11)
}
.mwBookingHead {
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px
}
.mwBookingHead h2 {
  margin:0;font-size:19px;line-height:1.2;color:var(--mw-ink);font-weight:900
}
.mwBookingHead p {
  margin:4px 0 0;font-size:8px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--mw-muted);font-weight:600
}
.mwBookingIcon {
  width:43px;height:43px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:#FFE9ED;color:var(--mw-red);font-size:22px;flex:0 0 43px
}
.mwTripToggle {
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px;
  padding:4px;background:#F3F4F6;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:10px
}
.mwTripToggle button {
  border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:7px;background:transparent;color:#7A8290;
  font-size:8.5px;font-weight:800
}
.mwTripToggle button.active {
  background:#fff;color:var(--mw-red);box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(20,30,48,.06)
}

.mwField {
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);
  align-items:center;gap:10px;
  min-height:58px;margin-bottom:9px;padding:7px 11px;
  border:1px solid var(--mw-line);border-radius:15px;background:#fff
}
.mwField:focus-within {
  border-color:#D06C82;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(185,21,53,.06)
}
.mwFieldIcon {
  width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:#FFF0F3;color:var(--mw-red);font-size:17px
}
.mwFieldGold .mwFieldIcon {background:#FFF7DF;color:#BE8612}
.mwFieldBody label {
  display:block;font-size:9.5px;color:#243149;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:1px
}
.mwFieldBody input,
.mwFieldBody select {
  width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;outline:0;color:#838B99;
  font-size:9.5px;padding:0
}
.mwFieldBody input::placeholder {color:#A1A7B0}

.mwSubmit {
  position:relative;width:100%;height:49px;border:0;border-radius:25px;margin-top:9px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#C3193D 0%,#A51131 100%);
  color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;
  box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(165,17,49,.22)
}
.mwSubmit::before {
  content:"‹";position:absolute;left:17px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-55%);
  font-size:31px;line-height:1
}

.mwDriver {
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:156px;
  margin:14px 14px 0;border-radius:21px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(88,6,24,.18) 0%,rgba(140,11,38,.78) 54%,rgba(115,8,31,.92) 100%),
    url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1630705344895-eb7b1bde9221?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1400&q=88') left 38% center/cover no-repeat;
  box-shadow:0 13px 28px rgba(104,9,31,.15)
}
.mwDriver::after {
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,rgba(140,10,38,.08) 45%,rgba(93,5,26,.22) 100%)
}
.mwDriverContent {
  position:relative;z-index:3;margin-left:auto;width:55%;padding:17px 14px 58px;color:#fff;text-align:right
}
.mwDriverTitle {
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:7px;
  font-size:18px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.2
}
.mwDriverBadge {
  width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mw-gold-soft);
  color:#6A4011;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:17px;flex:0 0 34px
}
.mwDriverContent p {
  margin:7px 0 0;font-size:8.5px;line-height:1.65;color:#fff;font-weight:600
}
.mwDriverBtn {
  position:absolute;right:14px;bottom:13px;width:calc(55% - 28px);height:38px;
  z-index:4;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F4D66E,#E3B64B);
  color:#3D2A0E;font-size:10px;font-weight:900
}
.mwDriverBtn::before {
  content:"‹";position:absolute;left:13px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-55%);
  font-size:25px;line-height:1
}

.mwFeatures {
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px;
  margin:14px 14px 0
}
.mwFeature {
  min-height:88px;padding:9px 7px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ECEEF1;
  border-radius:16px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(19,31,50,.05)
}
.mwFeatureIcon {
  width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 6px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;background:#FFE9ED;color:var(--mw-red);font-size:17px
}
.mwFeature:nth-child(2) .mwFeatureIcon {background:#FFF1C3;color:#9A6B08}
.mwFeature b {
  display:block;font-size:8px;color:#253047;font-weight:900
}
.mwFeature span {
  display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:6.8px;line-height:1.45;color:#8B929E
}

.mwNav {
  position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:0;z-index:40;
  width:min(540px,100%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);
  align-items:end;padding:9px 8px 10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.98);
  border-radius:21px 21px 0 0;border-top:1px solid #ECEEF1;
  box-shadow:0 -8px 22px rgba(18,29,47,.08)
}
.mwNav button {
  border:0;background:transparent;color:#657083;font-size:7px;font-weight:800;padding:2px
}
.mwNav button span {display:block;font-size:19px;margin-bottom:2px}
.mwHomeWrap {transform:translateY(-18px);color:var(--mw-red)!important}
.mwHome {
  width:50px;height:50px;margin:0 auto 3px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#C3193D,#A51131);color:#fff;font-size:23px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(165,17,49,.20)
}

/* contact bottom sheet */
.mwSheet {
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:85;display:none;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(16,24,39,.48)
}
.mwSheet.active {display:flex}
.mwSheetCard {
  width:min(540px,100%);background:#fff;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;padding:16px 14px 20px;
  max-height:88vh;overflow:auto
}
.mwSheetHead {
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px
}
.mwSheetHead h3 {margin:0;font-size:15px;color:var(--mw-ink)}
.mwSheetHead button {
  width:34px;height:34px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:#F3F4F6;color:#616A78
}

#screenCustomer .topbar,
#screenCustomer .hero,
#screenCustomer .customerIntro,
#screenCustomer .booking-card,
#screenCustomer .driverJoinCard,
#screenCustomer .mini-features,
#screenCustomer .whatsapp,
#screenCustomer .adminFooterLinkWrap {
  display:none!important
}

@media(max-width:420px) {
  .mwHero {min-height:350px}
  .mwBrand h1 {font-size:38px}
  .mwBrand p {font-size:11px}
  .mwHeroCopy {right:17px;bottom:20px;max-width:185px}
  .mwHeroCopy b {font-size:15px}
  .mwHeroCopy span {font-size:8px}
  .mwBooking {margin-left:10px;margin-right:10px;padding:14px 12px}
  .mwDriver {margin-left:10px;margin-right:10px}
  .mwFeatures {margin-left:10px;margin-right:10px}
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.9 | LOCATIONS / AIRPORT / NOTIFICATIONS / GUIDE MENU
========================================================= */
.mwAirportQuick{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;
  margin:0 0 10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;
  border:1px solid #F1DBA6;background:#FFF8E7;color:#76510B
}
.mwAirportQuick b{font-size:9px}
.mwAirportQuick span{font-size:7.5px;color:#987329}
.mwAirportQuick button{
  border:0;border-radius:10px;background:#E3B64B;color:#3E2A0B;
  padding:8px 10px;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap
}
.mwSubField{display:none;margin-top:7px}
.mwSubField.active{display:block}
.mwField select,.mwField input{cursor:pointer}
.mwField input[type="hidden"]{display:none}
.mwTopNotice{position:relative}
.mwTopNoticeDot{
  position:absolute;top:6px;left:7px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#E3B64B;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.3)
}
.mwNoticeList{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.mwNoticeItem{
  padding:12px;border:1px solid #E8E9ED;border-radius:14px;background:#FAFAFB
}
.mwNoticeItem b{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#202A3D}
.mwNoticeItem p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:8px;line-height:1.7;color:#747C89}
.mwNoticeItem small{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:7px;color:#A0A5AE}
.mwEmpty{text-align:center;padding:22px 8px;color:#8B919B;font-size:9px}
.mwSimpleScreen{padding:14px}
.mwGuideHero{
  padding:17px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#861128,#B91535);
  color:#fff;margin-bottom:12px
}
.mwGuideHero h2{margin:0;font-size:18px}
.mwGuideHero p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:8px;line-height:1.75;color:#F8EDEF}
.mwGuideCard{
  padding:14px;margin-bottom:9px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #E8E9ED;
  border-radius:17px;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(20,30,48,.04)
}
.mwGuideCard .num{
  width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:#FFE9ED;color:#B91535;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:7px
}
.mwGuideCard b{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#263047}
.mwGuideCard p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:8px;line-height:1.7;color:#7C8491}
.mwMenuGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px}
.mwMenuCard{
  border:1px solid #E8E9ED;border-radius:17px;background:#fff;padding:15px 11px;
  text-align:center;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(20,30,48,.04)
}
.mwMenuCard span{display:block;font-size:25px;margin-bottom:6px}
.mwMenuCard b{display:block;font-size:9px;color:#263047}
.mwMenuCard small{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:7px;color:#8A919C}
.mwPricePlaceholder{
  padding:28px 15px;border:1px dashed #D7DBE1;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;text-align:center
}
.mwPricePlaceholder span{font-size:32px}
.mwPricePlaceholder h3{margin:8px 0 4px;font-size:14px;color:#253047}
.mwPricePlaceholder p{margin:0;font-size:8px;line-height:1.7;color:#858C97}

/* bottom nav now four useful destinations */
.mwNav{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)!important}
.mwNav .mwHomeWrap{transform:translateY(-18px)}


/* =========================================================
   V1.9.1 | FIXED BOTTOM NAV + CENTER HOME + NOTICE CLOSE
========================================================= */
.mwNav{
  position:fixed !important;
  left:50% !important;
  transform:translateX(-50%) !important;
  bottom:0 !important;
  z-index:50 !important;
  width:min(540px,100%) !important;
  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr) !important;
  align-items:end !important;
  padding:9px 8px 10px !important;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.98) !important;
  border-radius:21px 21px 0 0 !important;
  border-top:1px solid #ECEEF1 !important;
  box-shadow:0 -8px 22px rgba(18,29,47,.08) !important;
}
.mwNav .mwHomeWrap{
  grid-column:3 !important;
  transform:translateY(-18px) !important;
}
.mwNav button:nth-child(1){grid-column:1}
.mwNav button:nth-child(2){grid-column:2}
.mwNav button:nth-child(4){grid-column:4}
.mwNav button:nth-child(5){grid-column:5}

/* Keep customer content clear of fixed nav */
#screenCustomer{padding-bottom:105px !important}

/* Notifications sheet close button */
#mwNotificationsSheet .mwSheetHead button{
  width:36px !important;
  height:36px !important;
  min-width:36px !important;
  border:0 !important;
  border-radius:11px !important;
  background:#F2F3F5 !important;
  color:#4E596A !important;
  font-size:18px !important;
  font-weight:900 !important;
  display:grid !important;
  place-items:center !important;
}
#mwNotificationsSheet .mwSheetHead button:active{
  transform:scale(.96);
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.9.2 | HARD FIXED MOBILE NAV (ALWAYS VISIBLE)
========================================================= */
.mwNav{
  position:fixed !important;
  right:0 !important;
  left:0 !important;
  bottom:0 !important;
  margin:0 auto !important;
  transform:none !important;
  width:100% !important;
  max-width:540px !important;
  z-index:9999 !important;

  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr) !important;
  align-items:end !important;

  padding:9px 8px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
  background:#fff !important;
  border-radius:22px 22px 0 0 !important;
  border-top:1px solid #ECEEF1 !important;
  box-shadow:0 -10px 28px rgba(18,29,47,.12) !important;

  -webkit-transform:translateZ(0) !important;
  transform:translateZ(0) !important;
  -webkit-backface-visibility:hidden !important;
  backface-visibility:hidden !important;
  will-change:transform !important;
  isolation:isolate !important;
}

#screenCustomer.active .mwNav{
  display:grid !important;
  visibility:visible !important;
  opacity:1 !important;
  pointer-events:auto !important;
}

/* never allow the fixed bar to be clipped by the main app shell */
.app,
#screenCustomer{
  overflow:visible !important;
}

#screenCustomer{
  padding-bottom:125px !important;
}

/* keep home exactly centered */
.mwNav .mwHomeWrap{
  grid-column:3 !important;
  transform:translateY(-18px) !important;
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.9.3 | MOBILE BOTTOM BAR FULLY VISIBLE
========================================================= */

/* bar itself */
.mwNav{
  position:fixed !important;
  left:50% !important;
  right:auto !important;
  bottom:14px !important;
  transform:translateX(-50%) !important;

  width:calc(100% - 18px) !important;
  max-width:522px !important;
  height:70px !important;
  min-height:70px !important;

  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr) !important;
  align-items:center !important;

  margin:0 !important;
  padding:5px 6px !important;
  box-sizing:border-box !important;

  background:#fff !important;
  border:1px solid rgba(225,228,233,.96) !important;
  border-radius:23px !important;
  box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(18,29,47,.16) !important;

  z-index:2147483000 !important;
  visibility:visible !important;
  opacity:1 !important;
  pointer-events:auto !important;

  -webkit-transform:translateX(-50%) translateZ(0) !important;
  -webkit-backface-visibility:hidden !important;
  backface-visibility:hidden !important;
}

/* all ordinary nav buttons must fit inside the bar */
.mwNav > button{
  position:relative !important;
  height:58px !important;
  min-height:58px !important;
  padding:4px 2px 3px !important;
  margin:0 !important;
  display:flex !important;
  flex-direction:column !important;
  align-items:center !important;
  justify-content:center !important;
  overflow:visible !important;
  color:#657083 !important;
  line-height:1.15 !important;
  font-size:7px !important;
}

.mwNav > button > span{
  display:block !important;
  margin:0 0 3px !important;
  font-size:19px !important;
  line-height:1 !important;
}

/* center home: fully visible, still elevated but not clipped */
.mwNav .mwHomeWrap{
  grid-column:3 !important;
  height:68px !important;
  min-height:68px !important;
  transform:translateY(-10px) !important;
  color:#B91535 !important;
  overflow:visible !important;
}

.mwNav .mwHome{
  width:50px !important;
  height:50px !important;
  min-width:50px !important;
  min-height:50px !important;
  margin:0 auto 2px !important;
  border-radius:50% !important;
  display:grid !important;
  place-items:center !important;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#C3193D,#A51131) !important;
  color:#fff !important;
  font-size:22px !important;
  box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(165,17,49,.23) !important;
}

/* leave enough real space under page content */
#screenCustomer{
  padding-bottom:110px !important;
}

/* extra protection for Android / browser gesture area */
@supports (padding: max(0px)){
  .mwNav{
    bottom:max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) !important;
  }
}

@media(max-width:420px){
  .mwNav{
    width:calc(100% - 12px) !important;
    bottom:10px !important;
    height:68px !important;
    min-height:68px !important;
    border-radius:21px !important;
  }
  .mwNav > button{
    height:55px !important;
    min-height:55px !important;
    font-size:6.8px !important;
  }
  .mwNav > button > span{
    font-size:18px !important;
  }
  .mwNav .mwHomeWrap{
    height:65px !important;
    min-height:65px !important;
    transform:translateY(-9px) !important;
  }
  .mwNav .mwHome{
    width:48px !important;
    height:48px !important;
    min-width:48px !important;
    min-height:48px !important;
  }
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.9.5 | VISUAL VIEWPORT NAV FIX
   Keeps bottom navigation inside the actually visible mobile viewport.
========================================================= */
:root{
  --mw-visible-bottom-gap: 10px;
}

#screenCustomer .mwNav{
  position:fixed !important;
  left:50% !important;
  right:auto !important;
  top:auto !important;

  width:calc(100% - 12px) !important;
  max-width:522px !important;
  height:68px !important;
  min-height:68px !important;

  margin:0 !important;
  padding:5px 6px !important;
  box-sizing:border-box !important;

  z-index:2147483000 !important;
  visibility:visible !important;
  opacity:1 !important;
  pointer-events:auto !important;
}

#screenCustomer.active .mwNav{
  display:grid !important;
  visibility:visible !important;
  opacity:1 !important;
}

/* keep the home button centered and completely visible */
#screenCustomer .mwNav .mwHomeWrap{
  grid-column:3 !important;
  transform:translateY(-9px) !important;
}

/* enough page room so content never sits behind nav */

}

/* Bottom bar removed completely */
#screenCustomer .mwNav{display:none!important}

/* Main form fields: larger and easier to use */
.mwField{
  min-height:58px !important;
  grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr) !important;
  gap:9px !important;
  padding:8px 11px !important;
  margin-bottom:8px !important;
  border-radius:14px !important;
}
.mwFieldIcon{
  width:34px !important;
  height:34px !important;
  font-size:17px !important;
}
.mwFieldBody label{
  font-size:11px !important;
  margin-bottom:3px !important;
}
.mwFieldBody input,
.mwFieldBody select{
  font-size:12px !important;
  min-height:24px !important;
}
.mwSubField{
  margin-top:7px !important;
}
.mwTripToggle button{
  font-size:9px !important;
  padding:8px !important;
}
.mwAirportQuick b{font-size:9px!important}
.mwAirportQuick span{font-size:7.5px!important}
.mwAirportQuick button{font-size:8px!important}

/* Generic form fields used in ride sheet and driver form */
.field{
  border-radius:15px !important;
}
.field .label{
  font-size:10px !important;
  padding:10px 13px 1px !important;
}
.field input,
.field select,
.field textarea{
  font-size:13px !important;
  padding:7px 13px 12px !important;
}
.field textarea{
  min-height:90px !important;
}

/* SIDE DRAWER */
.mwDrawerBackdrop{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:120;
  background:rgba(15,22,36,.48);
  display:none;
  overflow:hidden;
  touch-action:none;
}
.mwDrawerBackdrop.active{display:block}
.mwDrawer{
  position:absolute;
  top:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  width:min(310px,84vw);
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:-18px 0 42px rgba(10,18,30,.18);
  transform:translateX(105%);
  transition:transform .22s ease;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
}
.mwDrawerBackdrop.active .mwDrawer{transform:translateX(0)}
.mwDrawerHead{
  padding:18px 16px 14px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#861128,#B91535);
  color:#fff;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
}
.mwDrawerHead b{font-size:18px}
.mwDrawerHead span{display:block;font-size:8px;opacity:.85;margin-top:3px}
.mwDrawerClose{
  width:36px;height:36px;border:0;border-radius:11px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff;font-size:18px
}
.mwDrawerBody{
  flex:1;
  overflow-y:auto;
  overscroll-behavior:contain;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  padding:10px;
}
.mwDrawerItem{
  width:100%;border:0;background:#fff;
  min-height:54px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:5px;
  border-radius:14px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;
  text-align:right;color:#263047
}
.mwDrawerItem:active{background:#F5F5F7}
.mwDrawerItem i{
  width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:#FFE9ED;color:#B91535;
  font-style:normal;font-size:17px;flex:0 0 36px
}
.mwDrawerItem b{display:block;font-size:11px}
.mwDrawerItem small{display:block;font-size:7.5px;color:#89909C;margin-top:2px}

/* Modal/sheet: background MUST NOT scroll; sheet itself scrolls */
body.mwModalOpen{
  overflow:hidden !important;
  position:fixed !important;
  width:100% !important;
  left:0 !important;
  right:0 !important;
}
html.mwModalOpen{
  overflow:hidden !important;
}
.mwSheet{
  overflow:hidden !important;
  overscroll-behavior:none !important;
  touch-action:none;
}
.mwSheet.active{
  display:flex !important;
}
.mwSheetCard{
  max-height:min(88dvh,88vh) !important;
  overflow-y:auto !important;
  overscroll-behavior:contain !important;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch !important;
  touch-action:pan-y !important;
  padding-bottom:22px !important;
}
.mwSheetHead{
  position:sticky !important;
  top:-16px !important;
  z-index:5 !important;
  background:#fff !important;
  padding-top:16px !important;
  padding-bottom:10px !important;
}
.mwSheetHead button{
  width:38px !important;height:38px !important;
  font-size:18px !important;font-weight:900 !important;
}
.mwSheetActions{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:8px;
  margin-top:10px;
}
.mwCancelBtn{
  height:46px;border:1px solid #DEE1E6;border-radius:14px;
  background:#F5F6F7;color:#596273;font-size:11px;font-weight:900
}
.mwConfirmBtn{
  height:46px !important;
  margin:0 !important;
}

/* Lock underlying page while native select is focused */
body.mwSelectOpen{
  overflow:hidden !important;
  position:fixed !important;
  width:100% !important;
}

/* Driver back button made unmissable */
.driverHomeBack{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;
  width:100%;height:44px;margin:10px 0 0;
  border:1px solid #E3E5E9;border-radius:14px;
  background:#fff;color:#861128;font-size:11px;font-weight:900
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.10 | BOOKING LOGIC + CAPTAIN DOCUMENTS
========================================================= */

/* booking title must be visually RTL/right aligned */
.mwBookingHead{
  direction:ltr !important;
}
.mwBookingHead > div:last-child{
  direction:rtl !important;
  text-align:right !important;
  flex:1 !important;
}
.mwBookingHead h2,
.mwBookingHead p{
  text-align:right !important;
}

/* Entire date/time cards are tappable */
.mwClickableField{
  cursor:pointer !important;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
.mwClickableField:active{
  transform:scale(.995);
}
.mwClickableField input{
  pointer-events:none !important;
}

/* Round trip / waiting conditional rows */
.mwConditionalBlock{
  display:none;
  margin-top:2px;
}
.mwConditionalBlock.active{
  display:block;
}
.mwChoiceRow{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:7px;

}
.mwChoiceRow button{
  min-height:40px;
  border:1px solid #E5E7EB;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:#fff;
  color:#697386;
  font-size:9.5px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.mwChoiceRow button.active{
  background:#FFF0F3;
  border-color:#D87489;
  color:#A51131;
}

/* terms */
.mwTermsBox{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  gap:9px;
  padding:11px;
  margin-top:10px;
  border:1px solid #E6E8EC;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:#FAFAFB;
}
.mwTermsBox input{
  width:18px;height:18px;
  flex:0 0 18px;
  margin-top:1px;
  accent-color:#A51131;
}
.mwTermsBox label{
  font-size:8.5px;
  line-height:1.75;
  color:#596273;
}
.mwTermsBox button{
  border:0;
  background:transparent;
  color:#A51131;
  padding:0;
  font:inherit;
  font-weight:900;
  text-decoration:underline;
}

/* captain uploads */
.captainDocsTitle{
  margin:16px 0 7px;
  font-size:13px;
  color:#263047;
  font-weight:900;
}
.captainDocsNote{
  margin:-2px 0 10px;
  font-size:8px;
  line-height:1.65;
  color:#818896;
}
.captainUpload{
  position:relative;
  min-height:58px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:8px;
  padding:9px 11px;
  border:1px dashed #D5D9E0;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:#FBFBFC;
}
.captainUploadInfo b{
  display:block;
  font-size:10px;
  color:#2B3448;
}
.captainUploadInfo span{
  display:block;
  margin-top:3px;
  font-size:7.5px;
  color:#8C939E;
}
.captainUploadBtn{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  border:0;
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:8px 10px;
  background:#FFE9ED;
  color:#A51131;
  font-size:8px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.captainUpload input[type=file]{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  opacity:0;

}
.captainUpload.ready{
  border-style:solid;
  border-color:#B9DEC9;
  background:#F2FBF6;
}

  background:#DDF3E6;
  color:#197047;
}

/* Legal modal copy */
.mwLegalText h4{
  margin:12px 0 5px;
  font-size:11px;
  color:#263047;
}
.mwLegalText p{

  font-size:8.5px;

  color:#646D7B;
}

========================================================= */

/* Full screen sheets: customer info, terms, notifications */
.mwSheet{

}

}

/* Larger legal terms */

}

}

}

/* Fullscreen customer form */

}

#mwContactSheet .field select,
#mwContactSheet .field textarea{

}

}

}

}

/* Camera capture cards */
.captainUpload{
  min-height:64px !important;
}
.captainUpload input[type=file]{
  display:none !important;
}
.captainUploadBtn{

}
.captainCameraBtn{
  border:0;
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:9px 11px;
  background:#FFE9ED;
  color:#A51131;

}

/* Live camera full screen */
.cameraSheet{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:120000;
  display:none;
  background:#05070A;
  color:#fff;
}
.cameraSheet.active{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
}
.cameraTop{
  height:60px;
  flex:0 0 60px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;

}
.cameraTop b{
  font-size:14px;
}
.cameraTop button{

}
.cameraViewport{

  flex:1;
  min-height:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:#000;
}
.cameraViewport video{
  width:100%;
  height:100%;

}
.cameraGuide{
  position:absolute;
  left:8%;right:8%;top:24%;bottom:24%;

  border-radius:18px;

}

  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:18px;
  padding:12px;
  background:#101318;
}
.cameraCapture{

  background:#E21B3F;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.22);
}
.cameraHint{

  color:#CED3DC;
}

/* Waiting select bigger */
#rideWaitingDetails{

  min-height:32px !important;
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.11.1 | GOOGLE SITES CAMERA FALLBACK + CAPTAIN ALIGNMENT
========================================================= */

/* Captain join heading: icon at far right, then text */
.mwDriverContent{
  direction:rtl !important;
  text-align:right !important;
}
.mwDriverTitle{
  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns:34px 1fr !important;
  align-items:center !important;
  justify-content:stretch !important;
  gap:8px !important;
  direction:rtl !important;
  text-align:right !important;
}
.mwDriverTitle .mwDriverBadge{
  grid-column:1 !important;
  justify-self:end !important;
}

  text-align:right !important;
}

}

.nativeCameraInput{
  position:fixed !important;

  pointer-events:none !important;
  left:-9999px !important;
  top:-9999px !important;
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.12 | REQUEST DETAILS / CAPTAIN AGE / RECEIPT IMAGE
========================================================= */
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetCard{padding-bottom:92px!important}
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetActions{
  position:sticky!important;bottom:0!important;z-index:30!important;
  margin:14px -14px -22px!important;

  background:rgba(255,255,255,.98)!important;
  border-top:1px solid #ECEEF1!important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px)
}
#mwContactSheet .mwConfirmBtn,#mwContactSheet .mwCancelBtn{
  width:100%!important;height:48px!important;border-radius:14px!important
}
#mwContactSheet .mwConfirmBtn{
  display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;
  font-size:12px!important
}
.mwChecklist{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:8px
}
.mwCheckItem{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:9px 10px;

}

.mwDownloadReceipt{

}

}

========================================================= */
.mwLocalCaptainInfo{

}

.mwPriceHero{

}

}

}
.mwAdminPriceGrid{

}

}

.mwPriceAdminCard .card-actions{margin-top:8px}


/* =========================================================
   V1.14 | ESTIMATED PRICE + CLEAR FIELDS + FEATURE INFO
========================================================= */

/* Make form controls clearer without changing the overall identity */
.mwField{
  border:1.5px solid #D7DCE3 !important;
  box-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(27,38,56,.035) !important;
}
.mwField:focus-within{
  border-color:#B71E3B !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(165,17,49,.08) !important;
}
.field input,
.field select,
.field textarea{
  border:1.5px solid #D7DCE3 !important;
}
.field input:focus,
.field select:focus,
.field textarea:focus{
  border-color:#B71E3B !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(165,17,49,.08) !important;
}

/* Destination detail must be unmistakable after governorate selection */
#toDetailWrap.active{
  display:block !important;
  margin-top:10px !important;
  padding:9px !important;
  border:2px solid #D7A83F !important;
  border-radius:13px !important;
  background:#FFF9E9 !important;
  box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(181,132,28,.10) !important;
}
#toDetailWrap .mwToDetailHint{
  display:block;
  margin:0 2px 6px;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:900;
  color:#8D6511;
}
#toDetailWrap input{
  min-height:43px !important;
  background:#fff !important;
  border:1.5px solid #E0C36C !important;
  border-radius:10px !important;
  padding:0 11px !important;
  font-size:11px !important;
  font-weight:700 !important;
  color:#263047 !important;
}
#toDetailWrap input::placeholder{
  color:#9B7B32 !important;
  opacity:1 !important;
}

/* Estimated price result */
.mwEstimateCard{
  display:none;
  margin:10px 0 2px;
  padding:13px;
  border-radius:15px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FFF8E6,#FFFDF7);
  border:1px solid #ECD797;
}

.mwEstimateCard .priceLine{

}
.mwEstimateCard b{

}
.mwEstimateCard strong{
  font-size:17px;color:#A51131
}
