  margin:6px 0 0;font-size:7.5px;line-height:1.75;color:#7E6A3D
}

/* Feature cards are tappable */
.mwFeature{
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
.mwFeature:active{transform:scale(.98)}

/* Elegant feature explanation modal */
.mwFeatureInfo{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:110000;
  display:none;
  align-items:flex-end;
  justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(16,20,29,.48);
  padding:14px;
}
.mwFeatureInfo.active{display:flex}
.mwFeatureInfoCard{
  width:100%;
  max-width:520px;
  padding:16px;
  border-radius:22px;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
}
.mwFeatureInfoHead{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px
}
.mwFeatureInfoTitle{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px
}
.mwFeatureInfoIcon{
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:13px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:#FFF0F3;font-size:18px
}
.mwFeatureInfoTitle b{font-size:14px;color:#253047}
.mwFeatureInfoClose{
  width:38px;height:38px;border:0;border-radius:11px;
  background:#F1F2F4;color:#3F4857;font-size:18px
}
.mwFeatureInfoCard p{
  margin:13px 0 0;
  font-size:10.5px;
  line-height:1.95;
  color:#626C7A;
}
.mwFeatureInfoCard .primary{
  margin-top:14px;
  height:45px;
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.15 | STABILITY / SCROLL / FORM RESET / DATE FIX
========================================================= */

/* No bottom-nav anymore: remove the old reserved empty area */
#screenCustomer{
  padding-bottom:8px !important;
}
.mwCredit{
  margin-bottom:0 !important;
  padding-bottom:8px !important;
}

/* Date must be visually on the right in the Arabic interface */
.mwDateTimeRow{
  direction:rtl !important;
}
.mwDateTimeRow > *{
  direction:rtl !important;
}

/* Let the real date/time input receive taps.
   The surrounding card remains clickable as a convenience. */
.mwClickableField input{
  pointer-events:auto !important;
  position:relative !important;
  z-index:2 !important;
  user-select:none !important;
  -webkit-user-select:none !important;
}
.mwClickableField{
  position:relative !important;
  z-index:1 !important;
}

/* Keep result cards in normal flow; never let them cover form controls */
.mwEstimateCard,
.success-box,
.postSuccessActions{
  position:relative !important;
  z-index:1 !important;
  pointer-events:auto !important;
}

/* Reliable page lock without position:fixed.
   position:fixed was causing frozen scrolling / dead taps inside Google Sites. */
body.mwModalOpen,
body.mwSelectOpen{
  position:relative !important;
  top:auto !important;
  left:auto !important;
  right:auto !important;
  width:auto !important;
  overflow:hidden !important;
}
html.mwModalOpen{
  overflow:hidden !important;
}

/* Native selects on the main page must never freeze background scrolling */
body:not(.mwModalOpen).mwSelectOpen{
  overflow:auto !important;
}

/* clearer validation message */
#rideError{
  line-height:1.8 !important;
  font-size:9.5px !important;
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.16 | MOBILE FORM POLISH + RELIABLE DATE/TIME
========================================================= */

/* Date/time are intentionally full-width, one below the other */
.mwDateTimeRow{
  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns:1fr !important;
  gap:7px !important;
  direction:rtl !important;
}
.mwDateTimeRow .mwField{
  width:100% !important;
  margin-bottom:0 !important;
}

/* Native date/time values must read from the right in Arabic */
#rideDate,
#rideTime,
#rideReturnDate,
#rideReturnTime{
  direction:rtl !important;
  text-align:right !important;
  text-align-last:right !important;
  width:100% !important;
  min-width:0 !important;
  padding-right:0 !important;
  padding-left:0 !important;
  cursor:pointer !important;
}
#rideDate::-webkit-date-and-time-value,
#rideTime::-webkit-date-and-time-value,
#rideReturnDate::-webkit-date-and-time-value,
#rideReturnTime::-webkit-date-and-time-value{
  text-align:right !important;
  direction:rtl !important;
}
#rideDate::-webkit-datetime-edit,
#rideTime::-webkit-datetime-edit,
#rideReturnDate::-webkit-datetime-edit,
#rideReturnTime::-webkit-datetime-edit{
  display:flex !important;
  justify-content:flex-start !important;
  direction:rtl !important;
}

/* Restore the clean single-border form style in customer contact + captain forms.
   Previous generic rule gave every inner input its own border, causing double boxes. */
#mwContactSheet .field,
#screenDriver .field{
  border:1px solid #E6E8EC !important;
  border-radius:14px !important;
  background:#fff !important;
  box-shadow:none !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .field:focus-within,
#screenDriver .field:focus-within{
  border-color:#C9A7AF !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(134,17,40,.045) !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .field input,
#mwContactSheet .field select,
#mwContactSheet .field textarea,
#screenDriver .field input,
#screenDriver .field select,
#screenDriver .field textarea{
  border:0 !important;
  outline:0 !important;
  box-shadow:none !important;
  background:transparent !important;
  border-radius:0 !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwCheckItem{
  border:1px solid #E6E8EC !important;
  box-shadow:none !important;
}

/* Captain form validation states | Phone-first stable build */
#screenDriver .field{
  border:1.5px solid #BFC5CD !important;
  background:#fff !important;
  transition:border-color .16s ease,background-color .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease !important;
}
#screenDriver .field:focus-within{
  border-color:#861128 !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(134,17,40,.07) !important;
}
#screenDriver .field.mwFieldValid,
#screenDriver .field.mwFieldValid:focus-within{
  border-color:#63A978 !important;
  background:#F1FBF4 !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(99,169,120,.08) !important;
}
#screenDriver .field.mwFieldInvalid,
#screenDriver .field.mwFieldInvalid:focus-within{
  border-color:#D75A5A !important;
  background:#FFF3F3 !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(215,90,90,.08) !important;
}
#screenDriver .field.mwFieldValid .label{color:#35764A !important;}
#screenDriver .field.mwFieldInvalid .label{color:#B33A3A !important;}

/* Ride customer-contact validation | keeps the working name field untouched while typing */
#mwContactSheet .field{
  border:1.5px solid #BFC5CD !important;
  background:#fff !important;
  transition:border-color .16s ease,background-color .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .field:focus-within{
  border-color:#861128 !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(134,17,40,.07) !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .field.mwFieldValid,
#mwContactSheet .field.mwFieldValid:focus-within{
  border-color:#63A978 !important;
  background:#F1FBF4 !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(99,169,120,.08) !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .field.mwFieldInvalid,
#mwContactSheet .field.mwFieldInvalid:focus-within{
  border-color:#D75A5A !important;
  background:#FFF3F3 !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(215,90,90,.08) !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .field.mwFieldValid .label{color:#35764A !important;}
#mwContactSheet .field.mwFieldInvalid .label{color:#B33A3A !important;}
#mwContactSheet .mwTermsBox{
  border:1.5px solid #BFC5CD !important;
  transition:border-color .16s ease,background-color .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwTermsBox.mwFieldValid{
  border-color:#63A978 !important;
  background:#F1FBF4 !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(99,169,120,.08) !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwTermsBox.mwFieldInvalid{
  border-color:#D75A5A !important;
  background:#FFF3F3 !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(215,90,90,.08) !important;
}

/* Contact sheet header must always be inside the visible mobile viewport */
#mwContactSheet{
  padding-top:0 !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetCard{
  padding-top:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) !important;
  scroll-padding-top:72px !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetHead{
  top:0 !important;
  z-index:50 !important;
  min-height:58px !important;
  margin:0 -14px 14px !important;
  padding:7px 14px 9px !important;
  background:#fff !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetHead h3{
  font-size:17px !important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetHead button{
  position:relative !important;
  z-index:60 !important;
  flex:0 0 40px !important;
}

/* Prevent invisible result/overlay areas from ever intercepting booking controls */
#mwBooking{
  isolation:isolate !important;
}
#mwBooking .mwDateTimeRow{
  position:relative !important;
  z-index:8 !important;
}
#rideSuccess:not([style*="display: block"]),
#rideEstimateCard:not(.show),
#rideSuccessActions:not(.active){
  pointer-events:none !important;
}

/* No unnecessary space after JEKONIX credit */
#screenCustomer,
.app{
  margin-bottom:0 !important;
}
.mwCredit{
  margin-bottom:0 !important;
  padding-bottom:4px !important;
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.17 | DRAWER / HERO / 12H TIME / SCROLL PERFORMANCE
========================================================= */

/* Hero copy centered at the same vertical level */
.mwHeroCopy{
  right:14px !important;
  left:14px !important;
  bottom:24px !important;
  max-width:none !important;
  width:auto !important;
  text-align:center !important;
}
.mwHeroCopy b{
  white-space:nowrap !important;
  font-size:16px !important;
}
.mwHeroCopy span{
  white-space:nowrap !important;
  font-size:7.8px !important;
}
.mwHeroCopy i{
  margin:10px auto 0 !important;
}

/* Captain recruitment copy on one line */
.mwDriverContent p{
  white-space:nowrap !important;
  font-size:6.6px !important;
  letter-spacing:-.05px !important;
}

/* JEKONIX is an actual link */
.mwCredit a{
  color:#A51131 !important;
  font-weight:900 !important;
  text-decoration:none !important;
}

/* Custom 12-hour time field */
.mwTimeControls{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr .9fr;
  gap:6px;
  direction:ltr;
  margin-top:2px;
}
.mwTimeControls select{
  min-height:32px !important;
  padding:3px 6px !important;
  text-align:center !important;
  text-align-last:center !important;
  border:1px solid #E5E7EB !important;
  border-radius:9px !important;
  background:#FAFAFB !important;
  color:#263047 !important;
  font-size:9px !important;
  font-weight:800 !important;
}
.mwTimeHint{
  display:block;
  margin-top:4px;
  font-size:6.8px;
  color:#9A7A30;
  direction:rtl;
  text-align:right;
}

@media(max-width:380px){
  .mwHeroCopy b{font-size:14px !important}
  .mwHeroCopy span{font-size:6.8px !important}
  .mwDriverContent p{font-size:6px !important}
}


/* =========================================================
   V1.17.1 | PRICE BACK + FEATURE BUTTON ALIGNMENT
========================================================= */
#mwFeatureInfo .primary{
  display:flex !important;
  align-items:center !important;
  justify-content:center !important;
  text-align:center !important;
  padding:0 18px !important;
  line-height:1 !important;
}


/* =========================================================
   MASHWARAK CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE V2 | PREVIEW
   Burgundy | Warm Gold | White | Step-by-step
========================================================= */
:root{
  --v2-burgundy:#8F1734;
  --v2-burgundy-dark:#671024;
  --v2-burgundy-deep:#4B0A19;
  --v2-gold:#D7B85A;
  --v2-gold-soft:#FFF8E6;
  --v2-ink:#242734;
  --v2-muted:#747985;
  --v2-bg:#F7F6F7;
  --v2-card:#FFFFFF;
  --v2-line:#ECE7E9;
  --v2-green:#1D805F;
  --v2-shadow:0 16px 44px rgba(64,20,34,.08);
}

body{
  background:var(--v2-bg)!important;
  color:var(--v2-ink)!important;
}
.app{background:var(--v2-bg)!important}

/* Header becomes quiet and premium */
#screenCustomer .mwTop{
  top:10px!important;
  left:14px!important;
  right:14px!important;
  z-index:12!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwTopBtn{
  width:42px!important;
  height:42px!important;
  border-radius:14px!important;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.94)!important;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72)!important;
  color:var(--v2-burgundy)!important;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(42,10,21,.12)!important;
  font-size:17px!important;
}

/* New hero */
#screenCustomer .mwHero{
  min-height:390px!important;
  height:auto!important;
  border-radius:0 0 34px 34px!important;
  padding:74px 22px 34px!important;
  display:flex!important;
  flex-direction:column!important;
  justify-content:flex-end!important;
  background-position:center center!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwHero:after{
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(45,8,20,.12) 0%,rgba(61,7,24,.38) 38%,rgba(66,8,26,.88) 100%)!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwHero:before{
  content:""!important;
  position:absolute!important;
  inset:0!important;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 82% 20%,rgba(215,184,90,.18),transparent 28%)!important;
  z-index:1!important;
  pointer-events:none!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwBrand{
  position:relative!important;
  z-index:3!important;
  text-align:right!important;
  margin:0 0 18px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwBrand h1{
  font-size:35px!important;
  line-height:1.1!important;
  margin:0!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
  letter-spacing:-1px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwBrandLine{
  width:54px!important;
  height:4px!important;
  border-radius:99px!important;
  margin:9px 0 7px auto!important;
  background:var(--v2-gold)!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwBrand p{
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)!important;
  font-size:11px!important;
  font-weight:700!important;
  margin:0!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwHeroCopy{
  position:relative!important;
  z-index:3!important;
  margin:0!important;
  max-width:none!important;
  width:100%!important;
  text-align:right!important;
  bottom:auto!important;
  right:auto!important;
  left:auto!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwHeroCopy b{
  display:block!important;
  white-space:normal!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  font-size:23px!important;
  line-height:1.45!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
  letter-spacing:-.35px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwHeroCopy span{
  display:block!important;
  white-space:normal!important;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.83)!important;
  font-size:10.5px!important;
  line-height:1.9!important;
  margin-top:6px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwHeroCopy i{display:none!important}

.mwHeroActions{
  position:relative;
  z-index:3;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.45fr .9fr;
  gap:9px;
  margin-top:18px;
}
.mwHeroPrimary,.mwHeroSecondary{
  min-height:48px;
  border-radius:14px;
  font-family:Cairo,Tahoma,sans-serif;
  font-weight:900;
  font-size:11px;
}
.mwHeroPrimary{
  border:0;
  color:var(--v2-burgundy-deep);
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#F1D67D,var(--v2-gold));
  box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(215,184,90,.2);
}
.mwHeroSecondary{
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);
  color:#fff;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  backdrop-filter:blur(5px);
}

/* Main booking card */
#screenCustomer .mwBooking{
  position:relative!important;
  z-index:5!important;
  margin:-18px 13px 0!important;
  padding:19px 15px 17px!important;
  border-radius:24px!important;
  border:1px solid var(--v2-line)!important;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.985)!important;
  box-shadow:var(--v2-shadow)!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwBookingHead{
  padding:0 1px 13px!important;
  margin:0!important;
  border-bottom:0!important;
  align-items:center!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwBookingHead h2{
  color:var(--v2-ink)!important;
  font-size:18px!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
  margin:0 0 3px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwBookingHead p{
  color:var(--v2-muted)!important;
  font-size:8.8px!important;
  line-height:1.7!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwBookingIcon{
  width:46px!important;height:46px!important;
  border-radius:15px!important;
  background:#FFF1F4!important;
  font-size:21px!important;
}

/* Customer wizard */
.mwWizard{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:5px;
  margin:1px 0 15px;
  direction:rtl;
}
.mwWizardStep{
  position:relative;
  min-width:0;
  text-align:center;
  color:#9A9295;
}
.mwWizardStep:before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  top:14px;
  right:-50%;
  width:100%;
  height:2px;
  background:#EEE8EA;
  z-index:0;
}
.mwWizardStep:first-child:before{display:none}
.mwWizardDot{
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  width:29px;height:29px;
  border-radius:50%;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  margin:0 auto 5px;
  background:#F2EEF0;
  border:2px solid #F2EEF0;
  color:#81777B;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:900;
  transition:.2s ease;
}
.mwWizardStep b{
  display:block;
  font-size:7.4px;
  line-height:1.25;
  font-weight:900;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.mwWizardStep.active .mwWizardDot,
.mwWizardStep.done .mwWizardDot{
  background:var(--v2-burgundy);
  border-color:var(--v2-burgundy);
  color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 5px 13px rgba(143,23,52,.18);
}
.mwWizardStep.active b,.mwWizardStep.done b{color:var(--v2-burgundy)}
.mwWizardStep.done:before,.mwWizardStep.active:before{background:#D8AEB9}

.mwRideStep{display:none;animation:mwFadeStep .22s ease}
.mwRideStep.active{display:block}
@keyframes mwFadeStep{from{opacity:.35;transform:translateY(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.mwStepTitle{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  margin:3px 1px 11px;
}
.mwStepTitle div b{
  display:block;
  font-size:12px;
  color:var(--v2-ink);
  font-weight:900;
}
.mwStepTitle div span{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  color:var(--v2-muted);
  font-size:7.8px;
}
.mwStepBadge{
  min-width:54px;
  padding:5px 7px;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#FFF1F4;
  color:var(--v2-burgundy);
  font-size:7px;
  font-weight:900;
  text-align:center;
}
.mwStepActions{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  margin-top:12px;
}
.mwStepNext{
  flex:1;
  min-height:46px;
  border:0;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--v2-burgundy),var(--v2-burgundy-dark));
  color:#fff;
  font-size:10.5px;
  font-weight:900;
  box-shadow:0 10px 23px rgba(143,23,52,.14);
}
.mwStepBack{
  width:88px;
  min-height:46px;
  border:1px solid var(--v2-line);
  border-radius:14px;
  background:#fff;
  color:#6F6569;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:900;
}

/* Booking controls cleaner */
#screenCustomer .mwTripToggle{
  padding:4px!important;
  border-radius:13px!important;
  background:#F6F4F5!important;
  margin-bottom:10px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwTripToggle button{
  min-height:42px!important;
  border-radius:10px!important;
  font-size:9px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwTripToggle button.active{
  color:var(--v2-burgundy)!important;
  background:#fff!important;
  box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(61,25,38,.06)!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwAirportQuick{
  border:1px solid #EADBAF!important;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#FFFDF7,#FFF8E6)!important;
  border-radius:15px!important;
  margin-bottom:11px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwAirportQuick b{color:#7B5D13!important}
#screenCustomer .mwAirportQuick button{
  background:var(--v2-gold)!important;
  color:#5C4610!important;
  border-radius:10px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwField{
  border:1px solid var(--v2-line)!important;
  border-radius:16px!important;
  background:#fff!important;
  margin-bottom:9px!important;
  padding:11px 12px!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwField:focus-within{
  border-color:#D3A8B4!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(143,23,52,.055)!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwFieldIcon{
  width:39px!important;height:39px!important;
  border-radius:12px!important;
  background:#FFF1F4!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwFieldGold .mwFieldIcon{background:#FFF8E6!important}
#screenCustomer .mwFieldBody label{
  color:#31313B!important;
  font-size:9px!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwFieldBody select,
#screenCustomer .mwFieldBody input{
  color:#545863!important;
  font-size:10px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwChoiceRow button{
  min-height:42px!important;
  border-radius:12px!important;
  font-size:9px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwChoiceRow button.active{
  border-color:#CFA9B4!important;
  background:#FFF3F6!important;
  color:var(--v2-burgundy)!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwTimeControls select{
  min-height:38px!important;
  border-radius:10px!important;
  background:#F9F8F9!important;
}

/* Contact sheet becomes the third booking step */
#mwContactSheet{
  background:rgba(33,18,23,.58)!important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(4px)!important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetCard{
  border-radius:25px 25px 0 0!important;
  padding:15px!important;
  background:#FCFBFC!important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetHead{
  padding-bottom:10px!important;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--v2-line)!important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetHead h3{
  color:var(--v2-ink)!important;
  font-size:15px!important;
}
.mwContactSummary{
  padding:12px;
  margin:9px 0 12px;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#FFF7F9,#FFF);
  border:1px solid #EAD9DF;
}
.mwContactSummaryRoute{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;
  color:var(--v2-ink);font-size:9px;font-weight:900;
}
.mwContactSummary small{
  display:block;margin-top:5px;
  color:var(--v2-muted);font-size:7.7px;line-height:1.7
}

/* Captain recruitment section */
#screenCustomer .mwDriver{
  margin:14px 13px 0!important;
  border-radius:21px!important;
  padding:17px!important;
  border:0!important;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 10% 10%,rgba(215,184,90,.17),transparent 34%),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#651026,#8F1734)!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(80,14,36,.13)!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwDriverTitleText{color:#fff!important;font-size:13px!important}
#screenCustomer .mwDriverBadge{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.13)!important;
  color:#fff!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwDriverContent p{
  white-space:normal!important;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.76)!important;
  font-size:8px!important;
  line-height:1.7!important;
  max-width:230px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwDriverBtn{
  min-width:86px!important;
  height:42px!important;
  border-radius:12px!important;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25)!important;
  background:#fff!important;
  color:var(--v2-burgundy)!important;
  font-size:9px!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
}

/* Trust section */
#screenCustomer .mwFeatures{
  margin:13px 13px 0!important;
  gap:8px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwFeature{
  border:1px solid var(--v2-line)!important;
  border-radius:17px!important;
  background:#fff!important;
  padding:12px 6px!important;
  box-shadow:0 7px 20px rgba(54,24,35,.04)!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwFeatureIcon{
  width:34px!important;height:34px!important;
  border-radius:11px!important;
  background:#FFF3F6!important;
  color:var(--v2-burgundy)!important;
  margin-bottom:6px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwFeature b{font-size:8px!important;color:#31313B!important}
#screenCustomer .mwFeature span{font-size:6.4px!important;color:#8B8588!important;line-height:1.5!important}
#screenCustomer .mwCredit{
  color:#988E92!important;
  padding:16px 14px 25px!important;
  font-size:7px!important;
}

/* Driver registration becomes a 4-step flow */
#screenDriver{
  background:#F7F6F7!important;
}
#screenDriver .topbar{
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--v2-line)!important;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.97)!important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px)!important;
}
#screenDriver .section-pad{
  padding:14px 13px 26px!important;
}
#screenDriver .page-title{
  margin:0 0 11px!important;
  padding:15px!important;
  border-radius:18px!important;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#671024,#8F1734)!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  text-align:right!important;
}
#screenDriver .page-title .symbol{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)!important;
}
#screenDriver .page-title h2{color:#fff!important;font-size:17px!important}
#screenDriver .page-title p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)!important;font-size:8px!important}

.driverWizard{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:4px;
  margin:0 0 13px;
}
.driverWizardItem{text-align:center;color:#9C9497;position:relative}
.driverWizardItem:before{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:13px;right:-50%;width:100%;height:2px;background:#ECE5E8
}
.driverWizardItem:first-child:before{display:none}
.driverWizardItem i{
  position:relative;z-index:1;
  width:28px;height:28px;
  margin:0 auto 4px;
  border-radius:50%;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:#EFEAEC;
  color:#807578;
  font-style:normal;
  font-size:8px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.driverWizardItem b{display:block;font-size:6.4px;white-space:nowrap}
.driverWizardItem.active i,.driverWizardItem.done i{
  background:var(--v2-burgundy);
  color:#fff;
}
.driverWizardItem.active b,.driverWizardItem.done b{color:var(--v2-burgundy)}
.driverWizardItem.done:before,.driverWizardItem.active:before{background:#D6A9B5}
.driverStep{display:none;animation:mwFadeStep .2s ease}
.driverStep.active{display:block}
.driverStepCard{
  padding:13px;
  border:1px solid var(--v2-line);
  border-radius:17px;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(55,22,34,.045);
}
.driverStepIntro{
  margin-bottom:11px;
}
.driverStepIntro b{display:block;color:var(--v2-ink);font-size:12px;font-weight:900}
.driverStepIntro span{display:block;color:var(--v2-muted);font-size:7.7px;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.7}
.driverStepNav{
  display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px
}
.driverStepNav .primary{flex:1;min-height:45px!important;border-radius:13px!important}
.driverStepNav .secondary{
  width:86px;min-height:45px;border-radius:13px;
  border:1px solid var(--v2-line);
  background:#fff;color:#746A6D;font-weight:900;font-size:9px
}
#screenDriver .field{
  border-radius:13px!important;
  border-color:var(--v2-line)!important;
  background:#FCFBFC!important;
  padding:10px 11px!important;
}
#screenDriver .field:focus-within{
  border-color:#D3A8B4!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(143,23,52,.05)!important;
}
#screenDriver .captainUpload{
  border-radius:14px!important;
  border-color:#E8DFE2!important;
  background:#fff!important;
  margin-bottom:8px!important;
}
#screenDriver .captainCameraBtn{
  border-radius:10px!important;
  background:#FFF1F4!important;
  color:var(--v2-burgundy)!important;
  border:1px solid #ECD7DE!important;
}
#screenDriver .captainDocsTitle{
  color:var(--v2-ink)!important;
  font-size:12px!important;
  margin-top:0!important;
}
#screenDriver .captainDocsNote{
  padding:9px 10px!important;
  border-radius:11px!important;
  background:#FFF8E6!important;
  color:#77601E!important;
  font-size:7.4px!important;
  line-height:1.7!important;
}
#screenDriver .mwTermsBox{
  border-radius:13px!important;
  border-color:#E8DFE2!important;
  background:#FCFBFC!important;
}

/* Drawer */
.mwDrawer{
  background:#FCFBFC!important;
}
.mwDrawerHead{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#671024,#8F1734)!important;
}
.mwDrawerItem{
  border-radius:14px!important;
  background:#fff!important;
  border:1px solid var(--v2-line)!important;
  margin-bottom:7px!important;
}
.mwDrawerItem i{
  background:#FFF1F4!important;
  color:var(--v2-burgundy)!important;
}

/* Mobile fine tuning */
@media(max-width:380px){
  #screenCustomer .mwHero{min-height:370px!important;padding-left:18px!important;padding-right:18px!important}
  #screenCustomer .mwHeroCopy b{font-size:21px!important}
  .mwHeroActions{grid-template-columns:1.3fr .85fr}
  .mwHeroPrimary,.mwHeroSecondary{font-size:9.5px}
  #screenCustomer .mwBooking{margin-left:10px!important;margin-right:10px!important}
  .driverWizardItem b{font-size:5.8px}
}


/* =========================================================
   MASHWARAK V2.1 | LOCATION UX + HERO POLISH
========================================================= */

/* Hero subtitle stays on one clean line */
#screenCustomer .mwHeroCopy span{
  white-space:nowrap!important;
  font-size:clamp(7.4px,2.35vw,10px)!important;
  letter-spacing:-.1px!important;
}

/* Two hero actions equal size */
.mwHeroActions{
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important;
  width:100%!important;
  margin-left:0!important;
  margin-right:0!important;
}
.mwHeroPrimary,.mwHeroSecondary{
  width:100%!important;
  min-width:0!important;
  padding:0 7px!important;
}

/* Make the village/area prompt impossible to miss after center selection */
#fromVillageWrap.mwAttention{
  margin-top:8px!important;
  padding:5px!important;
  border-radius:13px!important;
  background:#FFF2F5!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(143,23,52,.08)!important;
}
#fromVillageWrap.mwAttention select{
  color:#8F1734!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
  background:#FFF8FA!important;
}
#fromVillageWrap.mwAttention select option{
  color:#333!important;
}
#fromVillageWrap.mwAttention:before{
  content:"اختر القرية / المنطقة";
  display:block;
  color:#8F1734;
  font-size:7.4px;
  font-weight:900;
  padding:0 5px 4px;
}

/* Destination hierarchy */
#toCenterWrap.active,#toVillageWrap.active{
  display:block!important;
}
#toCenterWrap select,#toVillageWrap select{
  width:100%;
  border:0;
  background:transparent;
  outline:0;
  color:#69636A;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:700;
  min-height:31px;
}
#toCenterWrap.mwAttention,
#toVillageWrap.mwAttention{
  margin-top:8px!important;
  padding:5px!important;
  border-radius:13px!important;
  background:#FFF8E8!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(215,184,90,.11)!important;
}
#toCenterWrap.mwAttention select,
#toVillageWrap.mwAttention select{
  color:#7B5D13!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
}
#toCenterWrap.mwAttention:before{
  content:"اختر المركز / المدينة";
  display:block;
  color:#7B5D13;
  font-size:7.4px;
  font-weight:900;
  padding:0 5px 4px;
}
#toVillageWrap.mwAttention:before{
  content:"اختر القرية / المنطقة";
  display:block;
  color:#7B5D13;
  font-size:7.4px;
  font-weight:900;
  padding:0 5px 4px;
}

/* Bring back the premium car image in Captain recruitment */
#screenCustomer .mwDriver{
  position:relative!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  min-height:164px!important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(88,6,24,.15) 0%,rgba(140,11,38,.73) 54%,rgba(115,8,31,.91) 100%),
    url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1630705344895-eb7b1bde9221?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1400&q=88') left 38% center/cover no-repeat!important;
  border:0!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwDriver::after{
  content:""!important;
  position:absolute!important;
  inset:0!important;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,rgba(140,10,38,.06) 43%,rgba(93,5,26,.22) 100%)!important;
  pointer-events:none!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwDriverContent{
  position:relative!important;
  z-index:3!important;
  margin-left:auto!important;
  width:57%!important;
  padding:18px 14px 60px!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwDriverBtn{
  position:absolute!important;
  z-index:4!important;
  right:14px!important;
  bottom:13px!important;
  width:calc(57% - 28px)!important;
  height:40px!important;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F4D66E,#E3B64B)!important;
  color:#3D2A0E!important;
  border:0!important;
}

/* Keep the hero compact on very small screens */
@media(max-width:355px){
  #screenCustomer .mwHeroCopy span{
    font-size:7px!important;
  }
  .mwHeroPrimary,.mwHeroSecondary{
    font-size:8.8px!important;
  }
}


/* =========================================================
   MASHWARAK V2.2 | AIRPORTS + CAPTAIN LOCATION + RECEIPTS
========================================================= */
.mwAirportChosen{
  display:none;
  margin-top:7px;
  padding:8px 10px;
  border-radius:11px;
  background:#FFF8E6;
  border:1px solid #EEDCA8;
  color:#705615;
  font-size:8px;
  font-weight:900;
  line-height:1.6;
}
.mwAirportChosen.active{display:block}
.mwAirportChosen b{color:#4C3810}

.mwAirportDirection{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:8px;
  margin:7px 0 12px;
}
.mwAirportDirection button{
  min-height:42px;
  border:1px solid var(--v2-line);
  border-radius:12px;
  background:#fff;
  color:#6F6669;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:900;
}

  border-color:#D3A8B4;

}
.mwAirportSelectBox{

}
.mwAirportSelectBox label{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:6px;

  font-weight:900;
}
.mwAirportSelectBox select{
  width:100%;
  min-height:46px;
  border:1px solid #E8E2E4;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:#fff;
  padding:0 10px;

  font-family:Cairo,Tahoma,sans-serif;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:800;
  outline:0;
}
.mwAirportHelp{
  margin:10px 0 0;
  padding:9px 10px;
  border-radius:11px;

  border:1px solid #F0DFAB;
}
.mwAirportConfirm{
  width:100%;
  min-height:46px;
  margin-top:11px;
  border:0;
  border-radius:13px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--v2-burgundy),var(--v2-burgundy-dark));
  color:#fff;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:900;
}

.driverProvinceFixed{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  min-height:48px;
  padding:10px 12px;
  border-radius:13px;
  border:1px solid #E8DFE2;
  background:#FFF8FA;
}
.driverProvinceFixed span{
  color:#797075;
  font-size:8px;
  font-weight:800;
}
.driverProvinceFixed b{
  color:var(--v2-burgundy);
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.driverLocationHint{
  margin:-2px 0 9px;
  padding:8px 10px;
  border-radius:11px;
  background:#FFF8E6;
  color:#79611E;
  font-size:7.3px;
  line-height:1.7;
  border:1px solid #F0DFAB;
}
#driverVillageField.mwAttention{
  background:#FFF2F5!important;
  border-color:#D8A8B5!important;
}
#driverVillageField.mwAttention .label{
  color:var(--v2-burgundy)!important;
}
#driverVillageField.mwAttention select{
  color:var(--v2-burgundy)!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
}

.driverReceiptNote{
  margin-top:9px;
  padding:10px 11px;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:#FFF8E6;
  color:#755B18;
  border:1px solid #EEDCA8;
  font-size:7.6px;
  font-weight:800;
  line-height:1.8;
}
#downloadDriverReceiptBtn{
  display:none;
  width:100%;
  min-height:46px;
  border:0;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F2D36A,#E3B64B);
  color:#3D2A0E;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:900;
}
#downloadDriverReceiptBtn.show{display:block}

#fromVillageWrap.mwAttention,

}

.mwDrawerItem{

}

}

}

/* AC selection */
.mwAcSection{
  margin-top:12px;
  padding:13px;
  border:2px solid #D2B052;
  border-radius:16px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFFDF8,#FFF8E7);
}
.mwAcSection.mwAttention{
  border-color:#9B1838!important;
  background:#FFF2F5!important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(143,23,52,.08)!important;
}
.mwAcHead{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
.mwAcHead b{
  display:block;
  color:#2D2930;
  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.mwAcHead span{
  display:block;
  margin-top:4px;
  color:#725D22;
  font-size:11.5px;
  line-height:1.65;
  font-weight:700;
}
.mwAcBadge{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  padding:7px 9px;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#F1D36F;
  color:#4C370D;

  font-weight:900;
}
.mwAcChoices{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  gap:8px;
}
.mwAcChoices button{
  min-height:68px;

  border-radius:13px;

}
.mwAcChoices button strong{
  display:block;
  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.mwAcChoices button small{
  display:block;

  line-height:1.4;
  font-weight:700;
}
.mwAcChoices button.active{
  border-color:var(--v2-burgundy);
  background:#FFF1F4;
  color:var(--v2-burgundy);
  box-shadow:0 4px 13px rgba(143,23,52,.08);
}
.mwAcChoices button.active small{
  color:#7B4050;
}

/* First-use interactive walkthrough */
.mwTourOverlay{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:200000;
  display:none;
  pointer-events:auto;
}
.mwTourOverlay.active{
  display:block;
}
.mwTourSpotlight{
  position:fixed;
  z-index:200001;
  border:3px solid #F3CF60;
  border-radius:16px;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 9999px rgba(20,14,17,.70),0 0 0 5px rgba(243,207,96,.18);
  pointer-events:none;
  transition:top .22s ease,left .22s ease,width .22s ease,height .22s ease;
}
.mwTourCard{
  position:fixed;
  z-index:200002;
  left:12px;
  right:12px;
  bottom:calc(var(--mw-tour-browser-safe, 0px) + max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)));
  max-width:520px;
  max-height:calc(var(--mw-tour-visible-height, 100dvh) - 28px);
  overflow-y:auto;
  overscroll-behavior:contain;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:15px;
  border-radius:20px;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
}
.mwTourCardTop{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
}
#mwTourCounter{
  display:inline-flex;
  padding:5px 8px;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#FFF1F4;
  color:var(--v2-burgundy);
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.mwTourSkip{
  min-height:40px;
  padding:0 9px;
  border:0;
  background:transparent;
  color:#7F7478;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:800;
}
.mwTourCard h3{
  margin:10px 0 4px;
  color:#2A2930;
  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.mwTourCard p{
  margin:0;
  color:#696169;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.8;
  font-weight:700;
}
.mwTourActions{
  position:sticky;
  z-index:3;
  bottom:-1px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;
  gap:8px;
  margin-top:13px;
  padding-top:10px;
  padding-bottom:max(2px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(255,255,255,.90),#fff 28%);
}
.mwTourBack,.mwTourNext{
  min-height:50px;
  border-radius:13px;
  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.mwTourBack{
  border:1px solid #DED6D9;
  background:#F8F5F6;
  color:#645B5F;
}
.mwTourNext{
  border:0;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--v2-burgundy),var(--v2-burgundy-dark));
  color:#fff;
}
.mwTourBack[disabled]{
  opacity:.45;
}

@media (max-width:760px) and (pointer:coarse){
  .mwTourCard{
    left:10px;
    right:10px;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================
   V2.4 | شاشة مستقلة لتأكيد طلب المشوار
========================================================== */
.mwRideDoneScreen{
  min-height:100dvh;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 0%,rgba(143,23,52,.08),transparent 34%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#FBF8F9 0%,#F5F0F2 100%);
  padding-bottom:28px
}
.mwRideDoneWrap{
  width:min(760px,calc(100% - 24px));

}
.mwRideDoneHero{
  position:relative;

  padding:24px 20px 21px;

  box-shadow:0 16px 38px rgba(74,13,35,.18);

.mwRideDoneCheck{

.mwRideDoneHero p{

}

.mwRideDonePrice{

}
.mwRideDonePriceTop{

}
.mwRideDonePriceTop span{

}
.mwRideDonePriceTop strong{

}
.mwRideDonePrice p{

}

.mwRideDoneSection{

}
.mwRideDoneSection h3{
  margin:0 0 11px;

}
.mwRideDoneRoute{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 46px 1fr;

}
.mwRideDonePlace{
  min-height:78px;
  padding:11px;

}
.mwRideDonePlace span{

}
.mwRideDonePlace b{

}

}
.mwRideDoneGrid{

}
.mwRideDoneItem{

.mwRideDoneNote{

}

.mwRideDoneHome{

@media(max-width:560px){

  .mwRideDoneHero{padding:21px 15px 18px;border-radius:18px}
  .mwRideDoneHero h2{font-size:19px}
  .mwRideDonePriceTop strong{font-size:20px}
  .mwRideDoneGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .mwRideDoneRoute{grid-template-columns:1fr 34px 1fr}

}



/* =========================================================
   V2.4 | RIDE CONFIRM SAFE AREA + PROCESSING OVERLAY
   V2.4.1 | DESTINATION "أخرى" + CUSTOM AREA INPUT
   Index-only: reserves the native APK help-button side
   without modifying Android/GitHub, and shows a dedicated
   save-progress overlay until the ride receipt screen is ready.
========================================================= */
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetActions{
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  gap:8px!important;
  direction:rtl!important;
  box-sizing:border-box!important;
  min-height:64px!important;
  padding-top:8px!important;
  padding-bottom:calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;
  padding-right:14px!important;
  padding-left:14px!important;
}

/* The native APK help control is 50dp wide + 14dp edge margin.
   Keep an additional cushion so neither action can sit beneath it. */
html.mwNativeHelpRtl #mwContactSheet .mwSheetActions{
  padding-right:78px!important;
  padding-left:14px!important;
}
html.mwNativeHelpLtr #mwContactSheet .mwSheetActions{
  padding-left:78px!important;
  padding-right:14px!important;
}

#mwContactSheet .mwCancelBtn{
  flex:0 0 31%!important;
  width:auto!important;
  min-width:76px!important;
  max-width:108px!important;
  height:46px!important;
  min-height:46px!important;
  padding:0 10px!important;
  border-radius:13px!important;
  font-size:11.5px!important;
  font-weight:800!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwConfirmBtn{
  flex:1 1 auto!important;
  width:auto!important;
  min-width:0!important;
  height:46px!important;
  min-height:46px!important;
  padding:0 12px!important;
  border-radius:13px!important;
  font-size:12.5px!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
}

.mwRideSubmitOverlay{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:100000;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  padding:22px;
  background:rgba(18,20,27,.58);
  backdrop-filter:blur(2.5px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(2.5px);
  opacity:0;
  visibility:hidden;
  pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .18s ease,visibility .18s ease;
}
.mwRideSubmitOverlay.active{
  opacity:1;
  visibility:visible;
  pointer-events:auto;
}
.mwRideSubmitCard{
  width:min(310px,calc(100vw - 44px));
  padding:22px 20px 19px;
  border-radius:22px;
  background:#fff;
  border:1px solid rgba(139,18,46,.08);
  box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.24);
  text-align:center;
  direction:rtl;
  transform:translateY(8px) scale(.985);
  transition:transform .2s ease;
}
.mwRideSubmitOverlay.active .mwRideSubmitCard{
  transform:translateY(0) scale(1);
}
.mwRideSubmitSpinner{
  width:42px;
  height:42px;
  margin:0 auto 13px;
  border-radius:50%;
  border:4px solid #F3E5E9;
  border-top-color:#981333;
  border-right-color:#D5B34F;
  animation:mwRideSubmitSpin .78s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes mwRideSubmitSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.mwRideSubmitCard b{
  display:block;
  color:#252936;
  font-size:16px;
  font-weight:900;
  line-height:1.45;
}
.mwRideSubmitCard span{
  display:block;
  margin-top:7px;
  color:#777E8B;
  font-size:10.5px;
  font-weight:700;
  line-height:1.8;
}
.mwRideSubmitTrack{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  height:4px;
  margin-top:16px;
  border-radius:99px;
  background:#F2E8EB;
}
.mwRideSubmitTrack::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0 auto 0 0;
  width:42%;
  border-radius:inherit;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8F1734,#D3AD45,#8F1734);
  animation:mwRideSubmitTrack 1.05s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes mwRideSubmitTrack{
  0%{transform:translateX(-115%)}
  100%{transform:translateX(340%)}
}
body.mwRideSubmitting{overflow:hidden!important}
@media(max-width:370px){
  html.mwNativeHelpRtl #mwContactSheet .mwSheetActions{padding-right:72px!important}
  html.mwNativeHelpLtr #mwContactSheet .mwSheetActions{padding-left:72px!important}
  #mwContactSheet .mwCancelBtn{flex-basis:29%!important;min-width:70px!important;font-size:10.5px!important}
  #mwContactSheet .mwConfirmBtn{font-size:11.5px!important;padding-inline:8px!important}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .mwRideSubmitSpinner,.mwRideSubmitTrack::after{animation-duration:1.6s!important}
  .mwRideSubmitOverlay,.mwRideSubmitCard{transition:none!important}
}



/* =========================================================
   RESPONSIVE RIDE CONFIRM + CENTERED TERMS + PROMO CAROUSEL
   Index-only. No APK / GitHub changes.
========================================================= */
:root{
  --mw-vv-height:100dvh;
  --mw-vv-top:0px;
  --mw-vv-bottom-gap:0px;
}

/* ---------- Home promo carousel ---------- */
#screenCustomer .mwPromoHero{
  position:relative!important;
  min-height:232px!important;
  height:232px!important;
  padding:0!important;
  display:block!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  border-radius:0 0 26px 26px!important;
  background:#2B1220!important;
}
#screenCustomer .mwPromoHero::before,
#screenCustomer .mwPromoHero::after{display:none!important}
.mwPromoTrack{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  display:flex;
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  overflow-x:auto;
  overflow-y:hidden;
  direction:ltr;
  scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;
  scroll-behavior:smooth;
  overscroll-behavior-x:contain;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  scrollbar-width:none;
  touch-action:pan-x pan-y;
}
.mwPromoTrack::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.mwPromoSlide{
  position:relative;
  flex:0 0 100%;
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  scroll-snap-align:start;
  scroll-snap-stop:always;
  direction:rtl;
  overflow:hidden;
  isolation:isolate;
  background-position:center!important;
  background-size:cover!important;
}
.mwPromoSlide::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  z-index:-2;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(23,15,22,.20),rgba(48,8,22,.48) 50%,rgba(61,7,24,.92)),
    url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1713559528444-c52d007022fe?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1800&q=88') center/cover no-repeat;
  transform:scale(1.025);
}
.mwPromoSlide::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  z-index:-1;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 16% 46%,rgba(255,213,91,.24),transparent 27%);
}
.mwPromoSlide2::before{background-position:center 38%!important;filter:saturate(.92) brightness(.88)}
.mwPromoSlide2::after{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(14,34,58,.70),rgba(92,12,38,.58) 55%,rgba(37,8,20,.16))}
.mwPromoSlide3::before{background-position:center 54%!important;filter:saturate(.76) brightness(.78)}
.mwPromoSlide3::after{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(104,16,42,.88),rgba(38,15,26,.30) 58%,rgba(209,166,57,.14))}
.mwPromoSlide4::before{background-position:center 48%!important;filter:saturate(.86) brightness(.76)}
.mwPromoSlide4::after{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(26,45,67,.84),rgba(76,10,29,.56) 62%,rgba(0,0,0,.12))}
.mwPromoContent{
  position:absolute;
  z-index:3;
  top:61px;
  right:18px;
  left:104px;
  color:#fff;
  text-align:right;
}
.mwPromoKicker{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:24px;
  padding:4px 10px;
  margin-bottom:5px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.11);
  backdrop-filter:blur(7px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px);
  color:#F7D66F;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.mwPromoContent h1{
  margin:0!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  font-size:22px!important;
  line-height:1.28!important;
  font-weight:900!important;
  letter-spacing:-.35px!important;
  text-shadow:0 2px 13px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
}
.mwPromoContent p{
  max-width:285px;
  margin:5px 0 0!important;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.88)!important;
  font-size:10.5px!important;
  line-height:1.7!important;
  font-weight:700!important;
}
.mwPromoTags{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:5px;
  margin-top:9px;
}
.mwPromoTags span{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:23px;
  padding:3px 8px;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  color:#5C1830;
  font-size:8px;
  font-weight:900;

}

/* ---------- Ride confirmation: use the real visible viewport ---------- */
#mwContactSheet{
  inset:auto 0 auto 0!important;

  width:100%!important;
  height:var(--mw-vv-height,100dvh)!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  max-height:var(--mw-vv-height,100dvh)!important;
  align-items:stretch!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetCard{
  position:relative!important;
  width:min(540px,100%)!important;
  height:100%!important;
  min-height:0!important;
  max-height:100%!important;
  overflow-y:auto!important;
  overflow-x:hidden!important;
  padding-bottom:calc(106px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;
  scroll-padding-bottom:118px!important;
  overscroll-behavior:contain!important;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch!important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetActions{
  position:fixed!important;
  z-index:99998!important;
  left:50%!important;
  right:auto!important;
  bottom:var(--mw-vv-bottom-gap,0px)!important;
  transform:translateX(-50%)!important;
  width:min(540px,100%)!important;

  margin:0!important;
  padding-top:9px!important;
  padding-bottom:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;
  border-top:1px solid #E7E8EC!important;
  border-radius:18px 18px 0 0!important;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.985)!important;
  box-shadow:0 -10px 28px rgba(31,20,25,.10)!important;

  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px)!important;
}

/* ---------- Terms consent: centered + much easier to tap ---------- */
#mwContactSheet .mwTermsBox{
  width:min(100%,390px)!important;
  margin:14px auto 0!important;
  padding:13px 16px!important;
  display:flex!important;
  flex-direction:column!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:center!important;
  gap:8px!important;
  text-align:center!important;
  cursor:pointer!important;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent!important;
  user-select:none;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwTermsBox input{
  width:24px!important;
  height:24px!important;
  flex:0 0 24px!important;
  margin:0!important;

}
#mwContactSheet .mwTermsBox label{
  display:block!important;
  width:100%!important;
  margin:0!important;
  text-align:center!important;
  font-size:10.5px!important;
  line-height:1.75!important;

}

  z-index:2;
}

@media(max-width:390px){

  #screenDriver .field input,
  #screenDriver .field select,
  #screenDriver .field textarea{font-size:13px!important}
  #screenDriver .driverStepNav .primary,
  #screenDriver .driverStepNav .secondary{min-height:50px!important;font-size:11px!important}

  #screenAdmin .stats{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    gap:12px;
    padding:18px 24px;
  }
  #screenAdmin .tabs{padding:0 24px 16px}
  #screenAdmin .list{padding:0 24px 30px}
  #screenAdminLogin .admin-login-wrap{max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;padding:58px 18px}

  .topbar{
    height:74px!important;
    margin-top:18px;
    border-radius:18px!important;
    padding-inline:22px!important;
  }
  .topbar .brand b{font-size:22px!important}
  .topbar .brand span{font-size:9px!important}

  /* Generic popups look like desktop dialogs, not mobile bottom sheets. */
  .modal{align-items:center!important;padding:28px!important}
  .modal-sheet{
    width:min(720px,calc(100vw - 56px))!important;
    max-height:calc(100dvh - 70px)!important;
    border-radius:24px!important;
    padding:24px!important;
  }
  .mwFeatureInfoCard{max-width:620px!important}

  /* Tutorial card remains readable on wide screens. */
  .mwTourCard{
    left:50%!important;
    right:auto!important;
    width:min(520px,calc(100vw - 48px))!important;
    transform:translateX(-50%);
    border-radius:22px!important;
  }
}

@media (min-width:1024px) and (max-width:1180px){
  #screenCustomer.active{
    grid-template-columns:minmax(410px,.86fr) minmax(500px,1.14fr);
    padding-inline:24px!important;
    column-gap:20px;
  }
  .mwDesktopHeader{margin-inline:-24px;padding-inline:24px;gap:14px}
  .mwDesktopBrandCopy span{display:none}
  .mwDesktopNav{gap:0}
  .mwDesktopNav button{padding-inline:8px;font-size:9.5px}
  .mwDesktopBookNow{min-width:120px;padding-inline:12px}
  #screenCustomer .mwPromoHero{height:500px!important;min-height:500px!important}
  #screenCustomer .mwPromoContent{right:28px!important;left:135px!important}
  #screenCustomer .mwPromoContent h1{font-size:31px!important}
  #screenCustomer .mwPromoContent p{font-size:12.5px!important}
  #screenCustomer .mwPromoVisual{left:28px;width:92px;height:92px}
}



/* =========================================================
   CAPTAIN DOCUMENTS — READY STATE VISUAL FIX
   Keep the captured-document card green after successful photo capture.
   This override intentionally comes after the general V2 driver-card styles.
========================================================= */
#screenDriver .captainUpload.ready{
  border-style:solid !important;
  border-color:#63A978 !important;
  background:#F1FBF4 !important;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(99,169,120,.08) !important;
}
#screenDriver .captainUpload.ready .captainUploadInfo b{
  color:#2F6F45 !important;
}
#screenDriver .captainUpload.ready .captainUploadInfo span{
  color:#35764A !important;
  font-weight:800 !important;
}
#screenDriver .captainUpload.ready .captainCameraBtn{
  background:#DDF3E6 !important;
  color:#197047 !important;
  border-color:#A9D9BC !important;
}



/* =========================================================
   V2.4.3 | LAUNCH + MOBILE WEB BUTTON VISIBILITY FIX
   - Confirmation actions stay in normal document flow so they
     cannot disappear below Google Sites / browser viewports.
   - Extra native-app clearance keeps the help FAB away.
========================================================= */
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetActions,
html.mwNativeHelpRtl #mwContactSheet .mwSheetActions,
html.mwNativeHelpLtr #mwContactSheet .mwSheetActions{
  position:static!important;
  left:auto!important;
  right:auto!important;
  top:auto!important;
  bottom:auto!important;
  transform:none!important;
  -webkit-transform:none!important;
  width:100%!important;
  min-height:68px!important;
  margin:16px 0 calc(20px + var(--mw-tour-browser-safe,0px))!important;
  padding:11px 0 calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + var(--mw-tour-browser-safe,0px))!important;
  background:#fff!important;
  border-top:1px solid #E7E8EC!important;
  border-radius:0!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
  backdrop-filter:none!important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important;
  z-index:2!important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwSheetCard{
  padding-bottom:calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + var(--mw-tour-browser-safe,0px))!important;
  scroll-padding-bottom:calc(40px + var(--mw-tour-browser-safe,0px))!important;
}
html.mwNativeAndroid #mwContactSheet .mwSheetActions{
  margin-bottom:calc(72px + var(--mw-tour-browser-safe,0px))!important;
}
#mwContactSheet .mwConfirmBtn,
#mwContactSheet .mwCancelBtn{
  min-height:48px!important;
}



/* =========================================================
   V2.5.0 | SMART LOCATION
   Map code is lazy-loaded only when the customer requests it.
========================================================= */
.mwMapPickBtn{
  width:100%;min-height:46px;margin-top:10px;border:1px solid #D8DFE8;
  border-radius:14px;background:#F7FAFE;color:#153B75;font-weight:900;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;
}
.mwMapPickBtnGold{background:#FFF9E7;border-color:#E6CC78;color:#694A05}
.mwMapPickBtn span{font-size:18px}
.mwMapChoice{display:none;margin-top:8px;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:12px;
  background:#EEF9F2;border:1px solid #9FD6B2;color:#17663C;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.65}
.mwMapChoice.show{display:block}
.mwMapChoice button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#A51131;font-weight:900;margin-inline-start:6px;cursor:pointer}
.mwMapPicker{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10050;background:rgba(13,22,38,.62);display:none;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;padding:0}
.mwMapPicker.active{display:flex}
.mwMapPickerPanel{width:min(760px,100%);height:min(92dvh,820px);background:#fff;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;
  padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 -16px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.mwMapPickerHead{display:flex;direction:rtl;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:2px 2px 10px}
.mwMapPickerHead>div{flex:1;text-align:right}.mwMapPickerHead b{display:block;font-size:18px;color:#281E23}.mwMapPickerHead span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#7C7277;margin-top:2px}
.mwMapPickerClose{width:42px;height:42px;border:0;border-radius:13px;background:#F3F4F6;font-size:21px;color:#30343B}
.mwMapCanvas{flex:1;min-height:330px;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #DDE3EA;background:#E9EEF4}
.mwMapStatus{direction:rtl;text-align:right;margin-top:8px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:11px;background:#F7F8FA;color:#45505E;font-size:10px;font-weight:800}
.mwMapTools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}.mwMapTools button{min-height:42px;border:1px solid #D9E0E8;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;font-weight:900;color:#183D75}
.mwMapLabelField{direction:rtl;margin-top:8px}.mwMapLabelField label{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;color:#494047;margin-bottom:4px}.mwMapLabelField small{font-weight:600;color:#8A8185}.mwMapLabelField input{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:44px;border:1px solid #D7DDE5;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 11px;font-family:inherit}
.mwMapPickerActions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:34% 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;padding-bottom:calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}.mwMapPickerActions button{min-height:48px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:900;border:0}.mwMapCancel{background:#F1F2F4;color:#555}.mwMapConfirm{background:#A51131;color:#fff}
html.mwMapOpen,body.mwMapOpen{overflow:hidden!important}
/* Automatic pricing is intentionally disabled in Smart Location phase 1. */
#rideEstimateCard,.mwRideDonePrice{display:none!important}
button[onclick*="openScreen('priceList')"],button[onclick*="drawerGo('priceList')"]{display:none!important}
@media (min-width:760px){.mwMapPicker{align-items:center;padding:24px}.mwMapPickerPanel{border-radius:24px;height:min(86vh,760px)}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">

  <!-- CUSTOMER -->
  <section id="screenCustomer" class="screen active">
    <header class="mwDesktopHeader" aria-label="التنقل الرئيسي">
      <div class="mwDesktopBrand">
        <div class="mwDesktopBrandIcon"><img id="mwDesktopBrandLogo" alt="شعار مشوارك"></div>
        <div class="mwDesktopBrandCopy"><b>مشوارك</b><span>احجز رحلتك بسهولة ووضوح</span></div>
      </div>
      <nav class="mwDesktopNav" aria-label="روابط مشوارك">
        <button type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('mwPromoHero').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})">الرئيسية</button>
        <button type="button" onclick="openScreen('priceList')">الأسعار</button>
        <button type="button" onclick="startUsageTour(true)">طريقة الاستخدام</button>
        <button type="button" onclick="openScreen('driver')">انضم كابتن</button>
        <button type="button" onclick="openPublicNotifications()">الإشعارات</button>
        <button type="button" onclick="window.location.href='tel:+201098505030'">تواصل معنا</button>
      </nav>
      <button type="button" class="mwDesktopBookNow" onclick="document.getElementById('mwBooking').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})">احجز مشوارك</button>
    </header>

    <div class="mwTop">
      <button type="button" class="mwTopBtn" onclick="openMainDrawer()" aria-label="فتح القائمة">☰</button>
      <button type="button" class="mwTopBtn mwTopNotice" onclick="openPublicNotifications()">🔔<span id="mwNoticeDot" class="mwTopNoticeDot" style="display:none"></span></button>
    </div>

    <div class="mwHero mwPromoHero" id="mwPromoHero" aria-label="مميزات مشوارك">
      <div class="mwPromoTrack" id="mwPromoTrack">
        <article class="mwPromoSlide mwPromoSlide1" aria-label="احجز مشوارك بسهولة">
          <div class="mwPromoContent">
            <span class="mwPromoKicker">مشوارك</span>
            <h1>احجز مشوارك بسهولة</h1>
            <p>حدد مكانك، اختار الموعد، وأكد الطلب في خطوات واضحة.</p>
            <div class="mwPromoTags"><span>📍 مكانك</span><span>📅 موعدك</span><span>✓ تأكيد سريع</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="mwPromoVisual mwPromoAppIcon" aria-hidden="true"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""></div>
        </article>

        <article class="mwPromoSlide mwPromoSlide2" aria-label="مشاوير المطار والمحافظات">
          <div class="mwPromoContent">
            <span class="mwPromoKicker">من المنوفية لأي مكان</span>
            <h1>المطار والمحافظات</h1>
            <p>احجز رحلتك للقاهرة، المطارات والمحافظات من مكان واحد.</p>
            <div class="mwPromoTags"><span>✈ مطارات</span><span>🛣 محافظات</span><span>⏰ حجز مسبق</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="mwPromoVisual" aria-hidden="true">✈</div>
        </article>

        <article class="mwPromoSlide mwPromoSlide3" aria-label="تفاصيل الرحلة على اختيارك">
          <div class="mwPromoContent">
            <span class="mwPromoKicker">رحلتك على اختيارك</span>
            <h1>حدد تفاصيل مشوارك</h1>
            <p>ذهاب أو عودة، انتظار، تكييف وعدد الركاب قبل تأكيد الطلب.</p>
            <div class="mwPromoTags"><span>❄ تكييف</span><span>⏱ انتظار</span><span>👥 ركاب</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="mwPromoVisual" aria-hidden="true">⚙</div>
        </article>

        <article class="mwPromoSlide mwPromoSlide4" aria-label="انضم كابتن في مشوارك">
          <div class="mwPromoContent">
            <span class="mwPromoKicker">انضم لشبكة مشوارك</span>
            <h1>سجّل كابتن مجانًا</h1>
            <p>اختر أوقاتك واستقبل طلبات المشاوير بعمولة 10% فقط.</p>
            <div class="mwPromoTags"><span>✓ تسجيل مجاني</span><span>🕘 وقتك</span><span>10% عمولة</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="mwPromoVisual mwPromoPercent" aria-hidden="true">10%</div>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="mwPromoDots" id="mwPromoDots" aria-label="التنقل بين الإعلانات">
        <button type="button" class="active" aria-label="الإعلان الأول" onclick="goToPromoSlide(0,true)"></button>
        <button type="button" aria-label="الإعلان الثاني" onclick="goToPromoSlide(1,true)"></button>
        <button type="button" aria-label="الإعلان الثالث" onclick="goToPromoSlide(2,true)"></button>
        <button type="button" aria-label="الإعلان الرابع" onclick="goToPromoSlide(3,true)"></button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="mwBooking" class="mwBooking">
      <div class="mwBookingHead">
        <div class="mwBookingIcon mwBookingAppIcon" aria-hidden="true"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""></div>
        <div style="text-align:right">
          <h2>احجز مشوارك</h2>
          <p>حدد تفاصيل الرحلة الأساسية وسيتم التواصل معك للتأكيد.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="mwWizard" id="rideWizard">
        <div class="mwWizardStep active" data-step="1"><span class="mwWizardDot">1</span><b>الرحلة</b></div>
        <div class="mwWizardStep" data-step="2"><span class="mwWizardDot">2</span><b>الموعد والتفاصيل</b></div>
        <div class="mwWizardStep" data-step="3"><span class="mwWizardDot">3</span><b>التأكيد</b></div>
      </div>

      <div id="rideStep1" class="mwRideStep active">
        <div class="mwStepTitle">
          <div><b>حدد مسار الرحلة</b><span>اختار نقطة الانطلاق والوجهة المطلوبة</span></div>
          <span class="mwStepBadge">الخطوة 1 من 3</span>
        </div>

      <div class="mwTripToggle">
        <button type="button" id="tripOneWay" class="active" onclick="setTripType('ONE_WAY')">ذهاب فقط</button>
        <button type="button" id="tripRound" onclick="setTripType('ROUND')">ذهاب وعودة</button>
      </div>

      <div class="mwAirportQuick">
        <div>
          <b>✈ مشاوير المطار</b>
          <span>اختر من مطارات مصر كنقطة انطلاق أو وجهة</span>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onclick="setAirportTrip()">من / إلى المطار</button>
      </div>

      <input id="rideFrom" type="hidden" value="">
      <input id="rideTo" type="hidden" value="">
      <input id="rideFromLat" type="hidden" value="">
      <input id="rideFromLng" type="hidden" value="">
      <input id="rideFromMapUrl" type="hidden" value="">
      <input id="rideFromMapLabel" type="hidden" value="">
      <input id="rideToLat" type="hidden" value="">
      <input id="rideToLng" type="hidden" value="">
      <input id="rideToMapUrl" type="hidden" value="">
      <input id="rideToMapLabel" type="hidden" value="">

      <div id="rideFromGroup" class="mwField mwLocationGroup mwLocationFrom">
        <div class="mwFieldIcon">📍</div>
        <div class="mwFieldBody">
          <label>من أين؟ | المنوفية</label>
          <select id="rideFromCenter" onchange="onFromCenterChange()">
            <option value="">اختر المركز</option>
            <option value="AIRPORT">✈ مطار في مصر</option>
            <option value="شبين الكوم">شبين الكوم</option>
            <option value="منوف">منوف</option>
            <option value="أشمون">أشمون</option>
            <option value="قويسنا">قويسنا</option>
            <option value="بركة السبع">بركة السبع</option>
            <option value="تلا">تلا</option>
            <option value="الباجور">الباجور</option>
            <option value="الشهداء">الشهداء</option>
            <option value="مدينة السادات">مدينة السادات</option>
          </select>
          <div id="fromAirportChosen" class="mwAirportChosen"></div>
          <div id="fromVillageWrap" class="mwSubField">
            <select id="rideFromVillage" onchange="onFromVillageChange()">
              <option value="">اختر القرية / المنطقة</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div id="fromOtherWrap" class="mwSubField">
            <input id="rideFromOther" placeholder="اكتب القرية أو المنطقة" oninput="syncRideFrom()">
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="mwMapPickBtn" onclick="openMashwarakMapPicker('FROM')">
            <span>🗺️</span><b>حدد نقطة الانطلاق على الخريطة</b>
          </button>
          <div id="rideFromMapChoice" class="mwMapChoice" aria-live="polite"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="rideToGroup" class="mwField mwFieldGold mwLocationGroup mwLocationTo">
        <div class="mwFieldIcon">📍</div>
        <div class="mwFieldBody">
          <label>إلى أين؟</label>
          <select id="rideToGovernorate" onchange="onToGovernorateChange()">
            <option value="">اختر المحافظة</option>
            <option value="AIRPORT">✈ مطار في مصر</option>
            <option>القاهرة</option><option>الجيزة</option><option>الإسكندرية</option>
            <option>الدقهلية</option><option>البحر الأحمر</option><option>البحيرة</option>
            <option>الفيوم</option><option>الغربية</option><option>الإسماعيلية</option>
            <option>المنوفية</option><option>المنيا</option><option>القليوبية</option>
            <option>الوادي الجديد</option><option>السويس</option><option>أسوان</option>
            <option>أسيوط</option><option>بني سويف</option><option>بورسعيد</option>
            <option>دمياط</option><option>الشرقية</option><option>جنوب سيناء</option>
            <option>كفر الشيخ</option><option>مطروح</option><option>الأقصر</option>
            <option>قنا</option><option>شمال سيناء</option><option>سوهاج</option>
          </select>
          <div id="toAirportChosen" class="mwAirportChosen"></div>
          <div id="toCenterWrap" class="mwSubField">
            <select id="rideToCenter" onchange="onToCenterChange()">
              <option value="">اختر المركز / المدينة</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div id="toVillageWrap" class="mwSubField">
            <select id="rideToVillage" onchange="onToVillageChange()">
              <option value="">اختر القرية / المنطقة</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div id="toOtherWrap" class="mwSubField">
            <input id="rideToOther" placeholder="اكتب القرية أو المنطقة" oninput="syncRideTo()">
          </div>
          <input id="rideToDetail" type="hidden" value="">
          <button type="button" class="mwMapPickBtn mwMapPickBtnGold" onclick="openMashwarakMapPicker('TO')">
            <span>📍</span><b>حدد الوجهة على الخريطة</b>
          </button>
          <div id="rideToMapChoice" class="mwMapChoice" aria-live="polite"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="mwStepActions">
        <button type="button" class="mwStepNext" onclick="rideWizardNextFromRoute()">متابعة للموعد</button>
      </div>
      </div>

      <div id="rideStep2" class="mwRideStep">
        <div class="mwStepTitle">
          <div><b>حدد الموعد والتفاصيل</b><span>اختار التاريخ والوقت وأي انتظار مطلوب</span></div>
          <span class="mwStepBadge">الخطوة 2 من 3</span>
        </div>

      <div id="rideDateTimeGroup" class="two mwDateTimeRow">
        <div class="mwField mwClickableField" onclick="openNativePicker('rideDate')">
          <div class="mwFieldIcon">📅</div>
          <div class="mwFieldBody">
            <label>التاريخ</label>
            <input id="rideDate" type="date">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="mwField">
          <div class="mwFieldIcon">🕘</div>
          <div class="mwFieldBody">
            <label>الوقت</label>
            <input id="rideTime" type="hidden">
            <div class="mwTimeControls">
              <select id="rideTimeHour" onchange="sync12HourTime('ride')"></select>
              <select id="rideTimeMinute" onchange="sync12HourTime('ride')"></select>
              <select id="rideTimePeriod" onchange="sync12HourTime('ride')">
                <option value="AM">AM</option>
                <option value="PM">PM</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <span id="rideTimeHint" class="mwTimeHint"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="roundTripDetails" class="mwConditionalBlock">
        <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:900;color:#263047;margin:4px 2px 7px">تفاصيل رحلة العودة</div>
        <div class="two mwDateTimeRow">
          <div class="mwField mwClickableField" onclick="openNativePicker('rideReturnDate')">
            <div class="mwFieldIcon">📅</div>
            <div class="mwFieldBody">
              <label>تاريخ العودة</label>
              <input id="rideReturnDate" type="date">
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="mwField">
            <div class="mwFieldIcon">🕘</div>
            <div class="mwFieldBody">
              <label>وقت العودة</label>
              <input id="rideReturnTime" type="hidden">
              <div class="mwTimeControls">
                <select id="rideReturnTimeHour" onchange="sync12HourTime('return')"></select>
                <select id="rideReturnTimeMinute" onchange="sync12HourTime('return')"></select>
                <select id="rideReturnTimePeriod" onchange="sync12HourTime('return')">
                  <option value="AM">AM</option>
                  <option value="PM">PM</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <span id="rideReturnTimeHint" class="mwTimeHint"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="font-size:9px;font-weight:900;color:#263047;margin:7px 2px 5px">هل يوجد انتظار أثناء المشوار؟</div>
      <div class="mwChoiceRow">
        <button type="button" id="waitNo" class="active" onclick="setWaiting(false)">لا يوجد انتظار</button>
        <button type="button" id="waitYes" onclick="setWaiting(true)">يوجد انتظار</button>
      </div>
      <div id="waitingDetailsWrap" class="mwConditionalBlock">
        <div class="mwField">
          <div class="mwFieldIcon">⏱</div>
          <div class="mwFieldBody">
            <label>مدة الانتظار المتوقعة</label>
            <select id="rideWaitingDetails">
              <option value="">اختر مدة الانتظار</option>
