<script>
let publicBoot=null;
let tripType='ONE_WAY';
let rideAcPreference='';
let adminToken='';
let adminData=null;
let adminRides=[];
let adminDrivers=[];
let adminNotifications=[];
let publicNotifications=[];
let publicPrices=[];
let priceConfig={};
let adminPrices=[];

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
  const tomorrow=new Date(Date.now()+86400000);
  document.getElementById('rideDate').value=tomorrow.toISOString().slice(0,10);
  fill12HourSelects('ride');
  fill12HourSelects('return');

  ['rideName','rideMobile','rideFrom','rideTo','rideDate','rideTime','ridePassengers','rideNotes'].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!el)return;
    el.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
      if(e.key==='Enter'){
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
      }
    });
  });
  initRideContactValidation();
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(r=>{
      publicBoot=r||{};
      loadPublicNotifications();
      handleMashwarakLaunchAction();
      maybeStartFirstUseTour();
    })
    .withFailureHandler(()=>{
      loadPublicNotifications();
      handleMashwarakLaunchAction();
      maybeStartFirstUseTour();
    })
    .getPublicBootstrap();
});


/* =========================================================
   FIRST USE WALKTHROUGH V2.3
========================================================= */
const MASHWARAK_TOUR_KEY='mashwarak_usage_tour_v23_done';
let usageTourIndex=0;
let usageTourActive=false;

const usageTourSteps=[
  {
    step:1,
    target:'#rideFromGroup',
    title:'ابدأ من مكان الانطلاق',
    text:'اختر المكان من القوائم أو اضغط «حدد نقطة الانطلاق على الخريطة» لتسجيل الموقع بدقة.'
  },
  {
    step:1,
    target:'#rideToGroup',
    title:'حدد وجهتك',
    text:'اختر الوجهة من القوائم أو اضغط «حدد الوجهة على الخريطة». ويمكن استيراد لوكيشن مشترك من تطبيق مشوارك.'
  },
  {
    step:2,
    target:'#rideDateTimeGroup',
    title:'حدد موعد المشوار',
    text:'اختر التاريخ والوقت بدقة. لو المشوار ذهاب وعودة ستظهر لك بيانات العودة أيضًا.'
  },
  {
    step:2,
    target:'#rideAcSection',
    title:'اختر التكييف',
    text:'حدد هل تريد سيارة بتكييف شغال أم بدون تكييف ليظهر تفضيلك ضمن تفاصيل الطلب.'
  },
  {
    step:2,
    target:'#rideContinueConfirmBtn',
    title:'أكمل بيانات التواصل',
    text:'بعد مراجعة الموعد والتفاصيل اضغط متابعة للتأكيد، ثم اكتب اسمك ورقم الموبايل وأرسل الطلب.'
  }
];

function maybeStartFirstUseTour(){
  try{
    const params=new URLSearchParams(window.location.search||'');
    if(params.get('open'))return;
    if(localStorage.getItem(MASHWARAK_TOUR_KEY)==='1')return;
  }catch(e){}

  setTimeout(function(){
    startUsageTour(false);
  },800);
}

function startUsageTour(force){
  try{closeMainDrawer();}catch(e){}
  try{openScreen('customer');}catch(e){}

  usageTourActive=true;
  usageTourIndex=0;
  syncUsageTourViewport();

  const overlay=document.getElementById('mwTourOverlay');
  if(overlay){
    overlay.classList.add('active');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
  }

  showUsageTourStep();
}

function showUsageTourStep(){
  if(!usageTourActive)return;

  const step=usageTourSteps[usageTourIndex];
  if(!step){
    finishUsageTour();
    return;
  }

  rideWizardGo(step.step);

  const title=document.getElementById('mwTourTitle');
  const text=document.getElementById('mwTourText');
  const count=document.getElementById('mwTourCounter');
  const back=document.getElementById('mwTourBack');
  const next=document.getElementById('mwTourNext');

  if(title)title.textContent=step.title;
  if(text)text.textContent=step.text;
  if(count)count.textContent=(usageTourIndex+1)+' من '+usageTourSteps.length;
  if(back)back.disabled=usageTourIndex===0;
  if(next)next.textContent=usageTourIndex===usageTourSteps.length-1?'تمام، فهمت':'التالي';

  setTimeout(function(){
    const target=document.querySelector(step.target);
    if(!target)return;

    target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});

    setTimeout(function(){
      updateUsageTourSpotlight();
    },350);
  },80);
}

function updateUsageTourSpotlight(){
  if(!usageTourActive)return;

  const step=usageTourSteps[usageTourIndex];
  const target=step?document.querySelector(step.target):null;
  const spot=document.getElementById('mwTourSpotlight');
  if(!target || !spot)return;

  const r=target.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pad=7;

  spot.style.top=Math.max(7,r.top-pad)+'px';
  spot.style.left=Math.max(7,r.left-pad)+'px';
  spot.style.width=Math.max(40,Math.min(window.innerWidth-14,r.width+pad*2))+'px';
  spot.style.height=Math.max(40,r.height+pad*2)+'px';
}

function usageTourNext(){
  if(usageTourIndex>=usageTourSteps.length-1){
    finishUsageTour();
    return;
  }
  usageTourIndex++;
  showUsageTourStep();
}

function usageTourPrev(){
  if(usageTourIndex<=0)return;
  usageTourIndex--;
  showUsageTourStep();
}

function finishUsageTour(){
  usageTourActive=false;

  const overlay=document.getElementById('mwTourOverlay');
  if(overlay){
    overlay.classList.remove('active');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  }

  try{
    localStorage.setItem(MASHWARAK_TOUR_KEY,'1');
  }catch(e){}

  rideWizardGo(1);
}


window.addEventListener('message',function(event){
  const data=event.data||{};

  if(data.type==='mashwarak-start-tour'){
    startUsageTour(true);

    try{
      window.top.postMessage({type:'mashwarak-tour-started'},'*');
    }catch(e){}

    try{
      window.parent.postMessage({type:'mashwarak-tour-started'},'*');
    }catch(e){}
  }

  if(data.type==='mashwarak-native-back'){
    const handled=handleMashwarakNativeBack();
    const response={type:'mashwarak-native-back-result',handled:handled===true};

    try{window.top.postMessage(response,'*');}catch(e){}
    try{window.parent.postMessage(response,'*');}catch(e){}
  }
});

function syncUsageTourViewport(){
  try{
    const vv=window.visualViewport;
    const visibleHeight=vv?Math.max(280,Math.round(vv.height)):Math.max(280,window.innerHeight||600);
    const coveredBottom=vv?Math.max(0,Math.round((window.innerHeight||visibleHeight)-(vv.height+vv.offsetTop))):0;
    // Android browsers can visually cover the last pixels with their bottom controls even when safe-area is zero.
    const coarse=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches;
    const browserSafety=coarse?Math.max(28,coveredBottom+10):coveredBottom;
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--mw-tour-visible-height',visibleHeight+'px');
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--mw-tour-browser-safe',browserSafety+'px');
  }catch(e){}
}

syncUsageTourViewport();
if(window.visualViewport){
  window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize',function(){
    syncUsageTourViewport();
    if(usageTourActive)updateUsageTourSpotlight();
  });
  window.visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
    syncUsageTourViewport();
    if(usageTourActive)updateUsageTourSpotlight();
  });
}

window.addEventListener('resize',function(){
  syncUsageTourViewport();
  if(usageTourActive)updateUsageTourSpotlight();
});
window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
  if(usageTourActive)updateUsageTourSpotlight();
},{passive:true});


function handleMashwarakLaunchAction(){
  try{
    const params=new URLSearchParams(window.location.search||'');
    const action=String(params.get('open')||'').toLowerCase().trim();

    if(action==='notifications'){
      setTimeout(function(){
        openPublicNotifications();
      },180);
    }
  }catch(e){}
}





/* =========================================================
   CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE V2 | WIZARDS
========================================================= */
let rideWizardStep=1;
let driverWizardStep=1;

function focusBookingV2(){
  try{
    rideWizardGo(1);
    const box=document.getElementById('mwBooking');
    if(box) box.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
  }catch(e){}
}

function updateRideWizardUi(){
  document.querySelectorAll('#rideWizard .mwWizardStep').forEach(function(node){
    const s=Number(node.dataset.step||0);
    node.classList.toggle('active',s===rideWizardStep);
    node.classList.toggle('done',s<rideWizardStep);
  });

  [1,2].forEach(function(s){
    const el=document.getElementById('rideStep'+s);
    if(el)el.classList.toggle('active',s===rideWizardStep);
  });
}

function rideWizardGo(step){
  rideWizardStep=Math.max(1,Math.min(3,Number(step||1)));
  updateRideWizardUi();

  if(rideWizardStep<3){
    const box=document.getElementById('mwBooking');
    if(box)box.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
  }
}

function rideWizardNextFromRoute(){
  hideBox('rideError');
  syncRideFrom();
  syncRideTo();

  const from=document.getElementById('rideFrom').value.trim();
  const gov=document.getElementById('rideToGovernorate').value;
  const toCenter=document.getElementById('rideToCenter').value;
  const toVillage=document.getElementById('rideToVillage').value;
  const toOther=document.getElementById('rideToOther').value.trim();
  const to=document.getElementById('rideTo').value.trim();
  const missing=[];

  if(!from)missing.push(document.getElementById('rideFromCenter').value==='AIRPORT'?'اختيار مطار الانطلاق':'مكان الانطلاق');
  if(!gov)missing.push('المحافظة / الوجهة');
  if(gov && gov!=='AIRPORT' && !toCenter)missing.push('المركز / المدينة');
  if(gov && gov!=='AIRPORT' && !toVillage)missing.push('القرية / المنطقة');
  if(gov && gov!=='AIRPORT' && toVillage==='أخرى' && !toOther)missing.push('كتابة القرية / المنطقة');
  if(!to)missing.push('الوجهة');

  if(missing.length){
    showBox('rideError','يرجى استكمال: '+missing.join(' | ')+'.');
    const err=document.getElementById('rideError');
    if(err)err.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});
    return;
  }

  rideWizardGo(2);
}

function updateRideConfirmSummaryV2(){
  const from=document.getElementById('rideFrom').value||'—';
  const to=document.getElementById('rideTo').value||'—';
  const date=document.getElementById('rideDate').value||'';
  const time=document.getElementById('rideTime').value||'';

  const f=document.getElementById('mwConfirmFrom');
  const t=document.getElementById('mwConfirmTo');
  const m=document.getElementById('mwConfirmMeta');

  if(f)f.textContent=from;
  if(t)t.textContent=to;

  let meta=(tripType==='ROUND'?'ذهاب وعودة':'ذهاب فقط');
  if(date)meta+=' | '+date;
  if(time)meta+=' | '+time;
  if(waitingRequired)meta+=' | يوجد انتظار';
  if(rideAcPreference==='WITH_AC')meta+=' | تكييف شغال';
  if(rideAcPreference==='WITHOUT_AC')meta+=' | بدون تكييف';

  if(m)m.textContent=meta;
}

/* Ride customer-contact field validation | same visual language as captain form */
function rideContactFieldBox(id){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  return el ? el.closest('.field') : null;
}

function setRideContactFieldVisual(id,state){
  const box=rideContactFieldBox(id);
  if(!box)return;
  box.classList.remove('mwFieldValid','mwFieldInvalid');
  if(state==='valid')box.classList.add('mwFieldValid');
  if(state==='invalid')box.classList.add('mwFieldInvalid');
}

function getRideContactFieldState(id,forceInvalid){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el)return 'neutral';
  const value=String(el.value||'').trim();

  if(id==='rideMobile'){
    if(/^[0-9]{11}$/.test(value))return 'valid';
    return (forceInvalid || value.length>0) ? 'invalid' : 'neutral';
  }

  if(id==='captainAgeMin' || id==='captainAgeMax'){
    if(!captainAgePreference)return 'neutral';
    if(value)return 'valid';
    return forceInvalid ? 'invalid' : 'neutral';
  }

  if(id==='rideName' || id==='ridePassengers'){
    if(value)return 'valid';
    return forceInvalid ? 'invalid' : 'neutral';
  }

  return value ? 'valid' : 'neutral';
}

function validateRideContactField(id,forceInvalid){
  const state=getRideContactFieldState(id,!!forceInvalid);
  setRideContactFieldVisual(id,state);
  return state!=='invalid';
}

function validateRideAgeRange(forceInvalid){
  if(!captainAgePreference){
    setRideContactFieldVisual('captainAgeMin','neutral');
    setRideContactFieldVisual('captainAgeMax','neutral');
    return true;
  }

  const min=String(document.getElementById('captainAgeMin')?.value||'').trim();
  const max=String(document.getElementById('captainAgeMax')?.value||'').trim();
  let ok=true;

  if(!min){setRideContactFieldVisual('captainAgeMin',forceInvalid?'invalid':'neutral');ok=false;}
  else setRideContactFieldVisual('captainAgeMin','valid');

  if(!max){setRideContactFieldVisual('captainAgeMax',forceInvalid?'invalid':'neutral');ok=false;}
  else setRideContactFieldVisual('captainAgeMax','valid');

  if(min && max && Number(min)>Number(max)){
    setRideContactFieldVisual('captainAgeMin','invalid');
    setRideContactFieldVisual('captainAgeMax','invalid');
    ok=false;
  }

  return ok || !forceInvalid;
}

function setRideTermsVisual(forceInvalid){
  const terms=document.getElementById('rideTerms');
  const box=terms ? terms.closest('.mwTermsBox') : null;
  if(!box)return true;
  box.classList.remove('mwFieldValid','mwFieldInvalid');
  if(terms.checked){
    box.classList.add('mwFieldValid');
    return true;
  }
  if(forceInvalid)box.classList.add('mwFieldInvalid');
  return !forceInvalid;
}

function validateRideContactFields(forceInvalid){
  let ok=true;
  ['rideName','rideMobile','ridePassengers'].forEach(function(id){
    if(!validateRideContactField(id,forceInvalid))ok=false;
  });
  if(captainAgePreference && !validateRideAgeRange(forceInvalid))ok=false;
  if(!setRideTermsVisual(forceInvalid))ok=false;
  return ok;
}

function refreshRideContactFieldStates(){
  ['rideName','rideMobile','ridePassengers'].forEach(function(id){
    validateRideContactField(id,false);
  });
  validateRideAgeRange(false);
  setRideTermsVisual(false);
}

function resetRideContactValidation(){
  document.querySelectorAll('#mwContactSheet .field').forEach(function(box){
    box.classList.remove('mwFieldValid','mwFieldInvalid');
  });
  const terms=document.querySelector('#mwContactSheet .mwTermsBox');
  if(terms)terms.classList.remove('mwFieldValid','mwFieldInvalid');
}

function scrollToFirstInvalidRideContact(){
  const bad=document.querySelector('#mwContactSheet .mwFieldInvalid');
  if(bad){
    try{bad.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});}catch(e){}
  }
}

function initRideContactValidation(){
  const mobile=document.getElementById('rideMobile');
  if(mobile && mobile.dataset.rideValidationBound!=='1'){
    mobile.dataset.rideValidationBound='1';
    mobile.maxLength=11;
    mobile.addEventListener('input',function(){
      const cleaned=String(this.value||'').replace(/[^0-9]/g,'').slice(0,11);
      if(this.value!==cleaned)this.value=cleaned;
      const box=rideContactFieldBox('rideMobile');
      if(box)box.classList.remove('mwFieldInvalid');
      if(cleaned.length===11)setRideContactFieldVisual('rideMobile','valid');
      else if(box)box.classList.remove('mwFieldValid');
    });
    mobile.addEventListener('blur',function(){validateRideContactField('rideMobile',true);});
  }

  /* Name stays exactly like the working ride-name field: validation only after leaving it. */
  const name=document.getElementById('rideName');
  if(name && name.dataset.rideValidationBound!=='1'){
    name.dataset.rideValidationBound='1';
    name.addEventListener('blur',function(){validateRideContactField('rideName',true);});
  }

  const passengers=document.getElementById('ridePassengers');
  if(passengers && passengers.dataset.rideValidationBound!=='1'){
    passengers.dataset.rideValidationBound='1';
    passengers.addEventListener('change',function(){validateRideContactField('ridePassengers',true);});
  }

  ['captainAgeMin','captainAgeMax'].forEach(function(id){
    const el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!el || el.dataset.rideValidationBound==='1')return;
    el.dataset.rideValidationBound='1';
    el.addEventListener('change',function(){validateRideAgeRange(false);});
  });

  const terms=document.getElementById('rideTerms');
  if(terms && terms.dataset.rideValidationBound!=='1'){
    terms.dataset.rideValidationBound='1';
    terms.addEventListener('change',function(){setRideTermsVisual(false);});
  }
}

/* Captain form field validation | avoids touching Arabic text while typing */
const DRIVER_REQUIRED_FIELDS_STEP1=['dMobile','dName','dAge','dCenter','dVillage'];
const DRIVER_REQUIRED_FIELDS_STEP2=['dCarType','dBrand','dModel','dYear','dColor','dSeats','dAc','dAvailability'];

function driverFieldBox(id){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  return el ? el.closest('.field') : null;
}

function setDriverFieldVisual(id,state){
  const box=driverFieldBox(id);
  if(!box)return;
  box.classList.remove('mwFieldValid','mwFieldInvalid');
  if(state==='valid')box.classList.add('mwFieldValid');
  if(state==='invalid')box.classList.add('mwFieldInvalid');
}

function getDriverFieldState(id,forceInvalid){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el)return 'neutral';
  const value=String(el.value||'').trim();

  if(id==='dMobile'){
    if(/^[0-9]{11}$/.test(value))return 'valid';
    return (forceInvalid || value.length>0) ? 'invalid' : 'neutral';
  }

  if(id==='dAvailabilityDetails'){
    const limited=document.getElementById('dAvailability') && document.getElementById('dAvailability').value==='LIMITED';
    if(!limited)return 'neutral';
    if(value)return 'valid';
    return forceInvalid ? 'invalid' : 'neutral';
  }

  if(id==='dNotes'){
    return value ? 'valid' : 'neutral';
  }

  const required=DRIVER_REQUIRED_FIELDS_STEP1.includes(id) || DRIVER_REQUIRED_FIELDS_STEP2.includes(id);
  if(required){
    if(value)return 'valid';
    return forceInvalid ? 'invalid' : 'neutral';
  }

  return value ? 'valid' : 'neutral';
}

function validateDriverField(id,forceInvalid){
  const state=getDriverFieldState(id,!!forceInvalid);
  setDriverFieldVisual(id,state);
  return state!=='invalid';
}

function validateDriverFields(ids,forceInvalid){
  let ok=true;
  (ids||[]).forEach(function(id){
    if(!validateDriverField(id,forceInvalid))ok=false;
  });
  return ok;
}

function resetDriverFieldValidation(){
  document.querySelectorAll('#screenDriver .field').forEach(function(box){
    box.classList.remove('mwFieldValid','mwFieldInvalid');
  });
}

function refreshDriverDefaultFieldStates(){
  ['dSeats','dAc','dAvailability'].forEach(function(id){ validateDriverField(id,false); });
}

function initDriverFieldValidation(){
  const mobile=document.getElementById('dMobile');
  if(mobile && mobile.dataset.validationBound!=='1'){
    mobile.dataset.validationBound='1';
    mobile.maxLength=11;
    mobile.addEventListener('input',function(){
      const cleaned=String(this.value||'').replace(/[^0-9]/g,'').slice(0,11);
      if(this.value!==cleaned)this.value=cleaned;
      const box=driverFieldBox('dMobile');
      if(box)box.classList.remove('mwFieldInvalid');
      if(cleaned.length===11)setDriverFieldVisual('dMobile','valid');
      else if(box)box.classList.remove('mwFieldValid');
    });
    mobile.addEventListener('blur',function(){ validateDriverField('dMobile',true); });
  }

  /* Text fields are validated only after blur so Arabic IME is never changed while composing. */
  ['dName','dYear','dAvailabilityDetails','dNotes'].forEach(function(id){
    const el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!el || el.dataset.validationBound==='1')return;
    el.dataset.validationBound='1';
    el.addEventListener('blur',function(){
      validateDriverField(id,id!=='dNotes');
    });
  });

  ['dAge','dCenter','dVillage','dCarType','dBrand','dModel','dColor','dSeats','dAc','dAvailability'].forEach(function(id){
    const el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!el || el.dataset.validationBound==='1')return;
    el.dataset.validationBound='1';
    el.addEventListener('change',function(){
      validateDriverField(id,true);
      if(id==='dAvailability'){
        validateDriverField('dAvailabilityDetails',false);
      }
      if(id==='dCenter'){
        setTimeout(function(){ validateDriverField('dVillage',false); },0);
      }
    });
  });

  refreshDriverDefaultFieldStates();
}

function updateDriverWizardUi(){
  document.querySelectorAll('#driverWizard .driverWizardItem').forEach(function(node){
    const s=Number(node.dataset.step||0);
    node.classList.toggle('active',s===driverWizardStep);
    node.classList.toggle('done',s<driverWizardStep);
  });

  [1,2,3,4].forEach(function(s){
    const el=document.getElementById('driverStep'+s);
    if(el)el.classList.toggle('active',s===driverWizardStep);
  });
}

function driverWizardGo(step){
  driverWizardStep=Math.max(1,Math.min(4,Number(step||1)));
  updateDriverWizardUi();

  const screen=document.getElementById('screenDriver');
  if(screen)window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
}

function driverWizardNextFromIdentity(){
  hideBox('driverError');

  const name=document.getElementById('dName').value.trim();
  const mobile=document.getElementById('dMobile').value.trim();
  const age=document.getElementById('dAge').value;
  const center=document.getElementById('dCenter').value;
  const village=document.getElementById('dVillage').value;
  syncDriverCity();
  const missing=[];

  validateDriverFields(DRIVER_REQUIRED_FIELDS_STEP1,true);

  if(!name)missing.push('الاسم');
  if(!/^[0-9]{11}$/.test(mobile))missing.push('رقم الموبايل يجب أن يكون 11 رقم');
  if(!age)missing.push('السن');
  if(!center)missing.push('المركز');
  if(!village)missing.push('القرية / المنطقة');

  if(missing.length){
    showBox('driverError','يرجى استكمال: '+missing.join(' | ')+'.');
    return;
  }

  driverWizardGo(2);
}

function driverWizardNextFromCar(){
  hideBox('driverError');

  const required=[
    ['dCarType','نوع السيارة'],
    ['dBrand','ماركة السيارة'],
    ['dModel','الموديل'],
    ['dYear','سنة الصنع'],
    ['dColor','اللون'],
    ['dSeats','عدد المقاعد'],
    ['dAc','التكييف'],
    ['dAvailability','التوفر']
  ];

  const missing=[];
  required.forEach(function(x){
    const el=document.getElementById(x[0]);
    if(!el || !String(el.value||'').trim())missing.push(x[1]);
  });

  if(document.getElementById('dAvailability').value==='LIMITED' &&
     !document.getElementById('dAvailabilityDetails').value.trim()){
    missing.push('مواعيد التوفر');
  }

  validateDriverFields(DRIVER_REQUIRED_FIELDS_STEP2,true);
  validateDriverField('dAvailabilityDetails',document.getElementById('dAvailability').value==='LIMITED');

  if(missing.length){
    showBox('driverError','يرجى استكمال: '+missing.join(' | ')+'.');
    return;
  }

  driverWizardGo(3);
}

function driverWizardNextFromDocs(){
  hideBox('driverError');

  const required=[
    ['nationalFront','البطاقة أمامي'],
    ['nationalBack','البطاقة خلفي'],
    ['driverLicenseFront','رخصة القيادة أمامي'],
    ['driverLicenseBack','رخصة القيادة خلفي'],
    ['carLicenseFront','رخصة السيارة أمامي'],
    ['carLicenseBack','رخصة السيارة خلفي'],
    ['liveSelfie','الصورة الشخصية الحية'],
    ['carPhoto','صورة السيارة'],
    ['captainWithCar','صورة الكابتن بجانب السيارة']
  ];

  const missing=required.filter(function(x){
    return !captainFiles[x[0]];
  }).map(function(x){return x[1]});

  if(missing.length){
    showBox('driverError','مطلوب تصوير: '+missing.join(' | ')+'.');
    return;
  }

  driverWizardGo(4);
}


let captainCameraStream=null;
let captainCameraTarget=null;

const captainCameraLabels={
  nationalFront:'البطاقة الشخصية | الوجه الأمامي',
  nationalBack:'البطاقة الشخصية | الوجه الخلفي',
  driverLicenseFront:'رخصة القيادة | الوجه الأمامي',
  driverLicenseBack:'رخصة القيادة | الوجه الخلفي',
  carLicenseFront:'رخصة السيارة | الوجه الأمامي',
  carLicenseBack:'رخصة السيارة | الوجه الخلفي',
  liveSelfie:'صورة شخصية حية للكابتن',
  carPhoto:'صورة السيارة',
  captainWithCar:'الكابتن بجانب السيارة'
};


const nativeCameraIds = {
  nationalFront:'cameraNationalFront',
  nationalBack:'cameraNationalBack',
  driverLicenseFront:'cameraDriverLicenseFront',
  driverLicenseBack:'cameraDriverLicenseBack',
  carLicenseFront:'cameraCarLicenseFront',
  carLicenseBack:'cameraCarLicenseBack',
  liveSelfie:'cameraLiveSelfie',
  carPhoto:'cameraCarPhoto',
  captainWithCar:'cameraCaptainWithCar'
};

function captainCameraFacing(target){
  return target==='liveSelfie' ? 'front' : 'rear';
}

function hasMashwarakNativeCamera(){
  try{
    return !!(window.MashwarakCamera && typeof window.MashwarakCamera.setCaptureMode==='function');
  }catch(e){
    return false;
  }
}

function openCaptainCamera(target){
  captainCameraTarget=target;

  if(hasMashwarakNativeCamera()){
    triggerNativeCamera(target);
    return;
  }

  if(navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia){
    openLiveCamera(target).catch(function(){
      alert('تعذر فتح الكاميرا من المتصفح. افتح التسجيل من تطبيق مشوارك لإتمام التصوير بالكاميرا فقط.');
    });
    return;
  }

  alert('التصوير المباشر غير متاح في هذا المتصفح. استخدم تطبيق مشوارك.');
}

function triggerNativeCamera(target){
  const id=nativeCameraIds[target];
  const input=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!input){
    alert('تعذر تجهيز الكاميرا لهذا المستند.');
    return;
  }

  try{
    if(hasMashwarakNativeCamera()){
      window.MashwarakCamera.setCaptureMode(captainCameraFacing(target));
    }
  }catch(e){}

  input.value='';
  input.click();
}

async function nativeCameraCaptured(input,target){
  if(!input || !input.files || !input.files[0]) return;

  try{
    const meta=captainUploadMeta(target);
    if(meta) document.getElementById(meta[1]).textContent='جاري تجهيز الصورة...';

    const packed=await compressCaptainImage(input.files[0]);
    captainFiles[target]=packed;

    if(meta){
      document.getElementById(meta[0]).classList.add('ready');
      document.getElementById(meta[1]).textContent='تم التصوير ✓';
    }
  }catch(e){
    captainFiles[target]=null;
    const meta=captainUploadMeta(target);
    if(meta){
      document.getElementById(meta[0]).classList.remove('ready');
      document.getElementById(meta[1]).textContent='لم يتم التصوير';
    }
    alert(e.message||'تعذر تجهيز الصورة.');
  }
}

async function openLiveCamera(target){
  captainCameraTarget=target;
  const sheet=document.getElementById('captainCameraSheet');
  const video=document.getElementById('captainCameraVideo');
  document.getElementById('cameraTitle').textContent='تصوير '+(captainCameraLabels[target]||'المستند');
  const hint=document.getElementById('cameraHint');
  if(hint){
    hint.textContent = target==='liveSelfie'
      ? 'استخدم الكاميرا الأمامية | اجعل الوجه واضحًا وفي منتصف الإطار'
      : target==='captainWithCar'
        ? 'يجب أن يظهر الكابتن والسيارة بوضوح في نفس الصورة'
        : 'ضع المطلوب داخل الإطار بوضوح ثم اضغط زر التصوير';
  }

  lockBackgroundScroll('modal');
  sheet.classList.add('active');

  try{
    if(captainCameraStream){
      captainCameraStream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());
      captainCameraStream=null;
    }

    const facing = target==='liveSelfie' ? 'user' : 'environment';
    captainCameraStream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video:{
        facingMode:{ideal:facing},
        width:{ideal:1920},
        height:{ideal:1080}
      },
      audio:false
    });
    video.srcObject=captainCameraStream;
    await video.play();
    return true;
  }catch(e){
    sheet.classList.remove('active');
    if(captainCameraStream){
      captainCameraStream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());
      captainCameraStream=null;
    }
    unlockBackgroundScroll();
    throw e;
  }
}

function closeLiveCamera(){
  const sheet=document.getElementById('captainCameraSheet');
  sheet.classList.remove('active');
  if(captainCameraStream){
    captainCameraStream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());
    captainCameraStream=null;
  }
  captainCameraTarget=null;
  unlockBackgroundScroll();
}

function captureLiveCamera(){
  if(!captainCameraTarget)return;
  const video=document.getElementById('captainCameraVideo');
  const canvas=document.getElementById('captainCameraCanvas');
  if(!video.videoWidth || !video.videoHeight){
    alert('الكاميرا لم تصبح جاهزة بعد.');
    return;
  }

  const maxSide=1400;
  let w=video.videoWidth,h=video.videoHeight;
  if(Math.max(w,h)>maxSide){
    const r=maxSide/Math.max(w,h);
    w=Math.round(w*r);h=Math.round(h*r);
  }

  canvas.width=w;canvas.height=h;
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.drawImage(video,0,0,w,h);

  const dataUrl=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.78);
  captainFiles[captainCameraTarget]={
    name:captainCameraTarget+'.jpg',
    mimeType:'image/jpeg',
    data:dataUrl.split(',')[1]
  };

  const meta=captainUploadMeta(captainCameraTarget);
  if(meta){
    document.getElementById(meta[0]).classList.add('ready');
    document.getElementById(meta[1]).textContent='تم التصوير ✓';
  }

  closeLiveCamera();
}

  document.getElementById('captainAgeYes').classList.toggle('active',captainAgePreference);

}

function buildRideReceiptData(payload,rideId,estimatedPrice,estimateNote){
  return {
    rideId:rideId||'',name:payload.customerName||payload.name||'',mobile:payload.mobile||'',
    from:payload.from||'',to:payload.to||'',
    tripType:payload.tripType==='ROUND'?'ذهاب وعودة':'ذهاب فقط',
    date:payload.date||'',time:payload.time||'',
    returnDate:payload.returnDate||'',returnTime:payload.returnTime||'',
    waiting:payload.waiting==='YES'?'نعم':'لا',waitingDetails:payload.waitingDetails||'',
    passengers:payload.passengers||'',extras:(payload.extras||[]).join(' - '),
    captainAgePreference:payload.captainAgePreference==='YES'
      ? ((payload.captainAgeMin||'')+' إلى '+(payload.captainAgeMax||'')+' سنة')
      : 'لا يوجد تفضيل',
    acPreference:payload.acPreference||'',
    estimatedPrice:estimatedPrice||'',
    estimateNote:estimateNote||''
  };
}

function saveCanvasImageSmart(canvas,fileName){
  const dataUrl=canvas.toDataURL('image/png');

  // Android app: native bridge saves the PNG to Pictures/Mashwarak.
  try{
    if(
      window.MashwarakDownload &&
      typeof window.MashwarakDownload.saveBase64Image==='function'
    ){
      window.MashwarakDownload.saveBase64Image(fileName,dataUrl);
      return;
    }
  }catch(e){}

  // Browser fallback keeps the normal download behavior.
  const link=document.createElement('a');
  link.download=fileName;
  link.href=dataUrl;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();
}

function receiptTextLtr(ctx,text,x,y,size,weight,color,align){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.direction='ltr';
  ctx.textAlign=align||'center';
  ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  ctx.fillStyle=color||'#252832';
  ctx.font=(weight||'700')+' '+size+'px Cairo, Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(String(text==null?'':text),x,y);
  ctx.restore();
}

function rr(ctx,x,y,w,h,r,fill,stroke){
  const radius=Math.min(r,w/2,h/2);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+radius,y);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,radius);
  ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,radius);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,radius);
  ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,radius);
  ctx.closePath();
  if(fill){ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill();}
  if(stroke){ctx.strokeStyle=stroke;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.stroke();}
}

function receiptText(ctx,text,x,y,size,weight,color,align){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.direction='rtl';
  ctx.textAlign=align||'right';
  ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  ctx.fillStyle=color||'#252832';
  ctx.font=(weight||'700')+' '+size+'px Cairo, Arial, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(String(text==null?'':text),x,y);
  ctx.restore();
}

function receiptWrap(ctx,text,x,y,maxWidth,lineHeight,size,weight,color,maxLines){
  const words=String(text||'').split(/\s+/);
  let line='', lines=[], test='';
  ctx.save();
  ctx.font=(weight||'700')+' '+size+'px Cairo, Arial, sans-serif';
  for(const word of words){
    test=line?line+' '+word:word;
    if(ctx.measureText(test).width>maxWidth && line){
      lines.push(line);
      line=word;
      if(maxLines && lines.length>=maxLines)break;
    }else{
      line=test;
    }
  }
  if((!maxLines || lines.length<maxLines) && line)lines.push(line);
  ctx.restore();
  lines.forEach(function(l,i){
    receiptText(ctx,l,x,y+i*lineHeight,size,weight,color,'right');
  });
  return lines.length*lineHeight;
}

function drawReceiptInfo(ctx,label,value,x,y,w){
  rr(ctx,x,y,w,94,18,'#FAF8F9','#EEE5E8');
  receiptText(ctx,label,x+w-22,y+31,20,'800','#887A7F','right');
  receiptText(ctx,value||'—',x+w-22,y+67,25,'900','#262831','right');
}

function downloadRideReceipt(){
  if(!lastRideReceipt){alert('لا توجد بيانات طلب متاحة للتحميل.');return;}
  const d=lastRideReceipt;
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width=1080;canvas.height=1350;
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');

  ctx.fillStyle='#F7F4F5';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,1080,1350);

  // Premium header
  const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,1080,280);
  grad.addColorStop(0,'#4B0A19');
  grad.addColorStop(.58,'#76142D');
  grad.addColorStop(1,'#9A1C3D');
  ctx.fillStyle=grad;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,1080,285);

  rr(ctx,70,48,86,86,24,'#F0D46F');
  receiptText(ctx,'✓',113,108,48,'900','#4B0A19','center');

  receiptText(ctx,'مشوارك',990,85,58,'900','#FFFFFF','right');
  receiptText(ctx,'تم استلام طلب المشوار بنجاح',990,135,28,'800','#F4E9ED','right');
  receiptText(ctx,'سيتم التواصل معك لتأكيد تفاصيل الرحلة والتنسيق',990,176,22,'600','#DCC8D0','right');

  rr(ctx,755,210,235,46,23,'rgba(255,255,255,.14)','rgba(255,255,255,.18)');
  receiptText(ctx,'رقم الطلب  '+(d.rideId||'—'),970,241,20,'900','#FFFFFF','right');

  // Route card
  rr(ctx,58,320,964,190,26,'#FFFFFF','#E8DFE2');
  receiptText(ctx,'مسار الرحلة',982,365,22,'900','#7D7075','right');
  receiptWrap(ctx,d.from||'—',982,411,405,35,27,'900','#24262F',2);
  receiptText(ctx,'←',540,424,42,'900','#D7B85A','center');
  receiptWrap(ctx,d.to||'—',492,411,405,35,27,'900','#24262F',2);

  // Main details
  drawReceiptInfo(ctx,'نوع الرحلة',d.tripType,558,540,464);
  drawReceiptInfo(ctx,'موعد الذهاب',(d.date||'—')+' | '+(d.time||'—'),58,540,464);
  drawReceiptInfo(
    ctx,
    'الركاب والتكييف',
    String(d.passengers||'—')+' راكب | '+(d.acPreference==='WITH_AC'?'تكييف شغال':'بدون تكييف'),
    558,650,464
  );
  drawReceiptInfo(ctx,'الانتظار',d.waiting+(d.waitingDetails?' | '+d.waitingDetails:''),58,650,464);

  let y=760;
  if(d.tripType==='ذهاب وعودة'){
    drawReceiptInfo(ctx,'موعد العودة',(d.returnDate||'—')+' | '+(d.returnTime||'—'),58,y,964);
    y+=110;
  }

  // Extras
  rr(ctx,58,y,964,112,18,'#FFFFFF','#E8DFE2');
  receiptText(ctx,'تفاصيل إضافية',982,y+34,20,'800','#887A7F','right');
  receiptWrap(ctx,d.extras||'لا توجد إضافات',982,y+73,880,28,22,'800','#33363F',2);
  y+=132;

  // Price highlight

function dismissKeyboard(){
  const el=document.activeElement;
  if(el && /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(el.tagName) && el.type!=='file'){
    try{el.blur();}catch(e){}
  }
}

document.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
  const t=e.target;
  if(!t)return;
  if(t.closest && (t.closest('input,textarea,select,button,label,.mwSheetCard,.mwDrawer'))) return;
  dismissKeyboard();
},{passive:true});

function openNativePicker(id){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el || el.disabled)return;

  try{
    // Keep the original tap activation alive. Blurring another control before
    // showPicker() can make mobile browsers ignore the request.
    if(document.activeElement && document.activeElement!==el &&
       /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(document.activeElement.tagName)){
      document.activeElement.blur();
    }

    try{el.focus({preventScroll:true});}
    catch(_){try{el.focus();}catch(__){}}

    if(typeof el.showPicker==='function'){
      el.showPicker();
      return;
    }

    // Older mobile browsers: a direct click on the native control is the best fallback.
    el.click();
  }catch(e){
    try{el.click();}catch(_){}
  }
}


function fill12HourSelects(prefix){
  const isReturn=prefix==='return';
  const h=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTimeHour':'rideTimeHour');
  const m=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTimeMinute':'rideTimeMinute');
  const p=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTimePeriod':'rideTimePeriod');
  const hint=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTimeHint':'rideTimeHint');
  if(!h||!m||!p)return;

  h.innerHTML='<option value="">ساعة</option>';
  for(let i=1;i<=12;i++){
    const o=document.createElement('option');
    o.value=String(i).padStart(2,'0');
    o.textContent=String(i).padStart(2,'0');
    h.appendChild(o);
  }

  m.innerHTML='<option value="">دقيقة</option>';
  for(let i=0;i<60;i+=5){
    const o=document.createElement('option');
    o.value=String(i).padStart(2,'0');
    o.textContent=String(i).padStart(2,'0');
    m.appendChild(o);
  }

  const now=new Date();
  let hour=now.getHours();
  const period=hour>=12?'PM':'AM';
  hour=hour%12||12;
  const minute=Math.round(now.getMinutes()/5)*5;
  const normalizedMinute=minute===60?55:minute;

  if(!isReturn){
    h.value=String(hour).padStart(2,'0');
    m.value=String(normalizedMinute).padStart(2,'0');
    p.value=period;
    sync12HourTime('ride');
  }else{
    h.value='';
    m.value='';
    p.value=period;
    sync12HourTime('return');
  }

  if(hint){
    const mm=String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
    hint.textContent='مثال حسب الوقت الحالي: '+String(hour).padStart(2,'0')+':'+mm+' '+period;
  }
}

function sync12HourTime(prefix){
  const isReturn=prefix==='return';
  const h=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTimeHour':'rideTimeHour');
  const m=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTimeMinute':'rideTimeMinute');
  const p=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTimePeriod':'rideTimePeriod');
  const hidden=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTime':'rideTime');
  if(!h||!m||!p||!hidden)return;

  hidden.value=(h.value&&m.value) ? (h.value+':'+m.value+' '+p.value) : '';
}

function reset12HourTime(prefix){
  const isReturn=prefix==='return';
  const h=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTimeHour':'rideTimeHour');
  const m=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTimeMinute':'rideTimeMinute');
  const p=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTimePeriod':'rideTimePeriod');
  const hidden=document.getElementById(isReturn?'rideReturnTime':'rideTime');
  if(h)h.value='';
  if(m)m.value='';
  if(p)p.value='AM';
  if(hidden)hidden.value='';
}

function readFileAsDataURL(file){
  return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
    const r=new FileReader();
    r.onload=function(){resolve(r.result)};
    r.onerror=reject;
    r.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

async function compressCaptainImage(file){
  if(!file || !file.type.startsWith('image/')) throw new Error('اختر صورة صحيحة.');
  if(file.size>12*1024*1024) throw new Error('حجم الصورة كبير جدًا. الحد الأقصى 12 MB قبل الضغط.');

  const src=await readFileAsDataURL(file);
  const img=await new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
    const im=new Image();
    im.onload=function(){resolve(im)};
    im.onerror=function(){reject(new Error('تعذر قراءة الصورة.'))};
    im.src=src;
  });

  const maxSide=1400;
  let w=img.width,h=img.height;
  if(Math.max(w,h)>maxSide){
    const ratio=maxSide/Math.max(w,h);
    w=Math.round(w*ratio);h=Math.round(h*ratio);
  }

  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width=w;canvas.height=h;
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
  const dataUrl=canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.72);
  return {
    name:(file.name||'image').replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'')+'.jpg',
    mimeType:'image/jpeg',
    data:dataUrl.split(',')[1]
  };
}

function captainUploadMeta(key){
  return {
    nationalFront:['upNationalFrontWrap','upNationalFrontName'],
    nationalBack:['upNationalBackWrap','upNationalBackName'],
    driverLicenseFront:['upDriverLicenseFrontWrap','upDriverLicenseFrontName'],
    driverLicenseBack:['upDriverLicenseBackWrap','upDriverLicenseBackName'],
    carLicenseFront:['upCarLicenseFrontWrap','upCarLicenseFrontName'],
    carLicenseBack:['upCarLicenseBackWrap','upCarLicenseBackName'],
    liveSelfie:['upLiveSelfieWrap','upLiveSelfieName'],
    carPhoto:['upCarPhotoWrap','upCarPhotoName'],
    captainWithCar:['upCaptainWithCarWrap','upCaptainWithCarName']
  }[key];
}

async function handleCaptainFile(input,key){
  const meta=captainUploadMeta(key);
  if(!input.files || !input.files[0]) return;
  try{
    if(meta)document.getElementById(meta[1]).textContent='جاري تجهيز الصورة...';
    const packed=await compressCaptainImage(input.files[0]);
    captainFiles[key]=packed;
    if(meta){
      document.getElementById(meta[0]).classList.add('ready');
      document.getElementById(meta[1]).textContent='تم اختيار الصورة ✓';
    }
  }catch(e){
    input.value='';
    captainFiles[key]=null;
    if(meta){
      document.getElementById(meta[0]).classList.remove('ready');
      document.getElementById(meta[1]).textContent='لم يتم اختيار صورة';
    }
    alert(e.message||'تعذر تجهيز الصورة');
  }
}

  Object.keys(captainFiles).forEach(function(k){captainFiles[k]=null;});
  Object.keys(nativeCameraIds).forEach(function(k){

  [
    ['upNationalFrontWrap','upNationalFrontName'],
    ['upNationalBackWrap','upNationalBackName'],
    ['upDriverLicenseFrontWrap','upDriverLicenseFrontName'],
    ['upDriverLicenseBackWrap','upDriverLicenseBackName'],
    ['upCarLicenseFrontWrap','upCarLicenseFrontName'],
    ['upCarLicenseBackWrap','upCarLicenseBackName'],
    ['upLiveSelfieWrap','upLiveSelfieName'],
    ['upCarPhotoWrap','upCarPhotoName'],
    ['upCaptainWithCarWrap','upCaptainWithCarName']

    const wrap=document.getElementById(a[0]); if(wrap)wrap.classList.remove('ready');

let mwScrollLockCount=0;

function lockBackgroundScroll(mode){
  // Only full-screen overlays should lock the page.
  // Native <select> controls must never lock the main Google Sites iframe.
  if(mode==='select') return;

  mwScrollLockCount++;
  document.body.classList.add('mwModalOpen');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('mwModalOpen');
}

function unlockBackgroundScroll(force){
  if(force===true){
    mwScrollLockCount=0;
  }else{
    mwScrollLockCount=Math.max(0,mwScrollLockCount-1);
  }

  if(mwScrollLockCount===0){
    document.body.classList.remove('mwModalOpen','mwSelectOpen');
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('mwModalOpen');
    document.body.style.top='';
  }
}

let mwBackDrawerMode=false;

function openMainDrawer(fromNativeBack){
  mwBackDrawerMode=(fromNativeBack===true);
  lockBackgroundScroll('modal');
  document.getElementById('mwMainDrawerBackdrop').classList.add('active');
}
function closeMainDrawer(){
  const el=document.getElementById('mwMainDrawerBackdrop');
  if(el)el.classList.remove('active');
  mwBackDrawerMode=false;
  unlockBackgroundScroll();
}
function drawerBackdropClick(e){
  if(e.target && e.target.id==='mwMainDrawerBackdrop') closeMainDrawer();
}
function drawerGo(name){
  closeMainDrawer();
  setTimeout(function(){openScreen(name);},20);
}

function handleMashwarakNativeBack(){
  try{
    const camera=document.getElementById('captainCameraSheet');
    if(camera && camera.classList.contains('active')){
      closeLiveCamera();
      return true;
    }

    const contact=document.getElementById('mwContactSheet');
    if(contact && contact.classList.contains('active')){
      closeRideContactSheet();
      return true;
    }

    const terms=document.getElementById('mwTermsSheet');
    if(terms && terms.classList.contains('active')){
      closeTermsModal();
      return true;
    }

    const notifications=document.getElementById('mwNotificationsSheet');
    if(notifications && notifications.classList.contains('active')){
      closePublicNotifications();
      return true;
    }

    const feature=document.getElementById('mwFeatureInfo');
    if(feature && feature.classList.contains('active')){
      closeFeatureInfo();
      return true;
    }

    if(typeof usageTourActive!=='undefined' && usageTourActive){
      finishUsageTour();
      return true;
    }

    const drawer=document.getElementById('mwMainDrawerBackdrop');
    if(drawer && drawer.classList.contains('active')){
      const cameFromInnerScreen=mwBackDrawerMode===true;
      closeMainDrawer();
      if(cameFromInnerScreen)openScreen('customer');
      return true;
    }

    const activeScreen=document.querySelector('.screen.active');
    if(activeScreen && activeScreen.id!=='screenCustomer'){
      openMainDrawer(true);
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }catch(e){
    return false;
  }
}

function enableSelectScrollProtection(){
  // Intentionally disabled.
  // Locking the page while a native select is focused caused intermittent
  // frozen scroll and dead taps inside Google Sites/mobile browsers.
}

function openScreen(name){
  if(name==='driver'){
    driverWizardStep=1;
    setTimeout(updateDriverWizardUi,0);
  }

  releaseUi();
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
  const map={
    customer:'screenCustomer',
    rideSuccess:'screenRideSuccess',
    driver:'screenDriver',
    instructions:'screenInstructions',
    more:'screenMore',
    priceList:'screenPriceList',
    adminLogin:'screenAdminLogin',
    admin:'screenAdmin'
  };
  document.getElementById(map[name]||'screenCustomer').classList.add('active');
  if(name==='priceList') renderPublicPrices();
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
}

function showBox(id,msg){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  el.textContent=msg;
  el.style.display='block';
}
function hideBox(id){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);

}

function releaseUi(){
  loading(false);
  const active=document.activeElement;
  if(active && typeof active.blur==='function') active.blur();

  const overlayActive =
    document.querySelector('.mwSheet.active') ||
    document.querySelector('.mwDrawerBackdrop.active') ||
    document.querySelector('.mwFeatureInfo.active') ||
    document.querySelector('.cameraSheet.active');

  if(!overlayActive) unlockBackgroundScroll(true);
}

function resetRideForm(keepIdentity){
  // A completed request must never leak its values into the next request.
  // keepIdentity remains accepted for backwards compatibility but is ignored.
  [
    'rideName','rideMobile','rideFrom','rideTo','rideTime',
    'rideReturnDate','rideReturnTime','rideWaitingDetails',
    'rideFromOther','rideToOther','rideToDetail'
  ].forEach(function(id){
    const el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(el)el.value='';
  });

  reset12HourTime('ride');
  reset12HourTime('return');
  fill12HourSelects('ride');
  fill12HourSelects('return');

  const passengers=document.getElementById('ridePassengers');
  if(passengers)passengers.value='1';

  const tomorrow=new Date(Date.now()+86400000);
  const date=document.getElementById('rideDate');
  if(date)date.value=tomorrow.toISOString().slice(0,10);

  selectedFromAirport='';
  selectedToAirport='';
  refreshAirportChosen();

  const fc=document.getElementById('rideFromCenter');
  const fv=document.getElementById('rideFromVillage');
  const tg=document.getElementById('rideToGovernorate');
  const tc=document.getElementById('rideToCenter');
  const tv=document.getElementById('rideToVillage');
  if(fc)fc.value='';
  if(fv){
    fv.innerHTML='<option value="">اختر القرية / المنطقة</option>';
    fv.value='';
  }
  if(tg)tg.value='';
  if(tc){
    tc.innerHTML='<option value="">اختر المركز / المدينة</option>';
    tc.value='';
  }
  if(tv){
    tv.innerHTML='<option value="">اختر القرية / المنطقة</option>';
    tv.value='';
  }

  ['fromVillageWrap','fromOtherWrap','toCenterWrap','toVillageWrap','toOtherWrap','roundTripDetails','waitingDetailsWrap']
    .forEach(function(id){
      const el=document.getElementById(id);
      if(el)el.classList.remove('active','mwAttention');
    });

  const rtc=document.getElementById('rideTerms');
  if(rtc)rtc.checked=false;

  document.querySelectorAll('.rideExtra').forEach(function(x){x.checked=false;});
  setCaptainAgePreference(false);
  setWaiting(false);
  setRideAcPreference('');
  setTripType('ONE_WAY');
  rideWizardStep=1;
  updateRideWizardUi();

  hideBox('rideError');
  if(typeof resetRideContactValidation==='function')resetRideContactValidation();

  // Previous success/receipt remain available only until the user starts editing a new request.
  releaseUi();
}
function resetDriverForm(){
  ['dName','dMobile','dCity','dBrand','dModel','dYear','dColor','dAvailabilityDetails','dNotes'].forEach(id=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(el)el.value='';
  });

  const dCenter=document.getElementById('dCenter');
  const dVillage=document.getElementById('dVillage');
  if(dCenter)dCenter.value='';
  if(dVillage){
    dVillage.innerHTML='<option value="">اختر المركز أولًا</option>';
    dVillage.value='';
  }
  const driverVillageField=document.getElementById('driverVillageField');
  if(driverVillageField)driverVillageField.classList.remove('mwAttention');

  const carType=document.getElementById('dCarType');
  const seats=document.getElementById('dSeats');
  const ac=document.getElementById('dAc');
  const availability=document.getElementById('dAvailability');

  if(carType)carType.value='';
  if(seats)seats.value='5';
  if(ac)ac.value='YES';
  if(availability)availability.value='FULL_TIME';

  toggleAvailabilityDetails();
  resetDriverFieldValidation();
  refreshDriverDefaultFieldStates();
  const dt=document.getElementById('driverTerms');
  if(dt)dt.checked=false;
  resetCaptainFiles();
  driverWizardStep=1;
  updateDriverWizardUi();
  hideBox('driverError');
  releaseUi();
}




let rideHasCompletedResult=false;

function clearPreviousRideResultOnNewInput(){
  const success=document.getElementById('rideSuccess');
  const estimate=document.getElementById('rideEstimateCard');
  const actions=document.getElementById('rideSuccessActions');
  const dl=document.getElementById('downloadRideReceiptBtn');

  if(success && success.style.display!=='none'){
    hideBox('rideSuccess');
    if(estimate)estimate.classList.remove('show');
    if(actions)actions.classList.remove('active');
    if(dl)dl.classList.remove('show');
    lastRideReceipt=null;
  }
}

function bindRideFreshStart(){
  [
    'rideFromCenter','rideFromVillage','rideFromOther',
    'rideToGovernorate','rideToCenter','rideToVillage','rideToOther','rideToDetail','rideDate','rideTime',
    'rideReturnDate','rideReturnTime','rideWaitingDetails','ridePassengers'
  ].forEach(function(id){
    const el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!el || el.dataset.freshBound==='1')return;
    el.dataset.freshBound='1';
    el.addEventListener('input',clearPreviousRideResultOnNewInput,{passive:true});
    el.addEventListener('change',clearPreviousRideResultOnNewInput,{passive:true});
  });
}

function fillAirportSelect(){
  const select=document.getElementById('airportSelect');
  if(!select || select.dataset.ready==='1')return;
  select.dataset.ready='1';
  EGYPT_AIRPORTS.forEach(function(name){
    const o=document.createElement('option');
    o.value=name;
    o.textContent=name;
    select.appendChild(o);
  });
}

function setAirportDirection(dir){
  airportDirection=dir==='FROM'?'FROM':'TO';
  document.getElementById('airportDirectionFrom').classList.toggle('active',airportDirection==='FROM');
  document.getElementById('airportDirectionTo').classList.toggle('active',airportDirection==='TO');

  const current=airportDirection==='FROM'?selectedFromAirport:selectedToAirport;
  const select=document.getElementById('airportSelect');
  if(select)select.value=current||'';
}

function openAirportSheet(dir){
  fillAirportSelect();
  setAirportDirection(dir||'TO');
  const sheet=document.getElementById('mwAirportSheet');
  if(!sheet)return;
  lockBackgroundScroll('modal');
  sheet.classList.add('active');
}

function closeAirportSheet(){
  const sheet=document.getElementById('mwAirportSheet');
  if(sheet)sheet.classList.remove('active');
  unlockBackgroundScroll(true);
}

function refreshAirportChosen(){
  const fromBox=document.getElementById('fromAirportChosen');
  const toBox=document.getElementById('toAirportChosen');

  if(fromBox){
    fromBox.classList.toggle('active',!!selectedFromAirport);
    fromBox.innerHTML=selectedFromAirport?'<b>المطار المختار:</b> '+selectedFromAirport:'';
  }
  if(toBox){
    toBox.classList.toggle('active',!!selectedToAirport);
    toBox.innerHTML=selectedToAirport?'<b>المطار المختار:</b> '+selectedToAirport:'';
  }
}

function confirmAirportSelection(){
  const airport=document.getElementById('airportSelect').value;
  if(!airport){
    alert('اختر المطار أولًا.');
    return;
  }

  if(airportDirection==='FROM'){
    selectedFromAirport=airport;
    const from=document.getElementById('rideFromCenter');
    from.value='AIRPORT';
    document.getElementById('rideFrom').value=airport;
    document.getElementById('fromVillageWrap').classList.remove('active','mwAttention');
    document.getElementById('fromOtherWrap').classList.remove('active');
  }else{
    selectedToAirport=airport;
    const to=document.getElementById('rideToGovernorate');
    to.value='AIRPORT';
    document.getElementById('rideTo').value=airport;
    document.getElementById('rideToDetail').value=airport;
    document.getElementById('toCenterWrap').classList.remove('active','mwAttention');
    document.getElementById('toVillageWrap').classList.remove('active','mwAttention');
    document.getElementById('toOtherWrap').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('rideToOther').value='';
  }

  refreshAirportChosen();
  closeAirportSheet();
  clearPreviousRideResultOnNewInput();
}

function onDriverCenterChange(){
  const center=document.getElementById('dCenter').value;
  const village=document.getElementById('dVillage');
  const field=document.getElementById('driverVillageField');

  village.innerHTML='<option value="">اختر القرية / المنطقة</option>';
  document.getElementById('dCity').value='';

  if(!center){
    village.innerHTML='<option value="">اختر المركز أولًا</option>';
    field.classList.remove('mwAttention');
    return;
  }

  (DRIVER_MENOUFIA_PLACES[center]||[center]).forEach(function(name){
    const o=document.createElement('option');
    o.value=name;
    o.textContent=name;
    village.appendChild(o);
  });

  field.classList.add('mwAttention');
}

function syncDriverCity(){
  const center=document.getElementById('dCenter').value;
  const village=document.getElementById('dVillage').value;
  document.getElementById('driverVillageField').classList.toggle('mwAttention',!village);
  document.getElementById('dCity').value=(center&&village)
    ? 'المنوفية - '+center+' - '+village
    : '';
}


function onFromCenterChange(){
  const center=document.getElementById('rideFromCenter').value;
  const vw=document.getElementById('fromVillageWrap');
  const ow=document.getElementById('fromOtherWrap');
  const village=document.getElementById('rideFromVillage');
  const other=document.getElementById('rideFromOther');

  vw.classList.remove('active','mwAttention');
  ow.classList.remove('active');
  village.innerHTML='<option value="">اختر القرية / المنطقة</option>';
  other.value='';

  if(center==='AIRPORT'){
    document.getElementById('rideFrom').value=selectedFromAirport||'';
    refreshAirportChosen();
    if(!selectedFromAirport)setTimeout(function(){openAirportSheet('FROM')},0);
    return;
  }
  if(!center){
    document.getElementById('rideFrom').value='';
    return;
  }

  (MENOUFIA_PLACES[center]||[center,'أخرى']).forEach(function(name){
    const o=document.createElement('option');
    o.value=name;o.textContent=name;
    village.appendChild(o);
  });
  vw.classList.add('active','mwAttention');
  document.getElementById('rideFrom').value='المنوفية - '+center;
}

function onFromVillageChange(){
  const v=document.getElementById('rideFromVillage').value;
  document.getElementById('fromVillageWrap').classList.toggle('mwAttention',!v);
  document.getElementById('fromOtherWrap').classList.toggle('active',v==='أخرى');
  syncRideFrom();
}

function syncRideFrom(){
  const center=document.getElementById('rideFromCenter').value;
  if(center==='AIRPORT'){
    document.getElementById('rideFrom').value=selectedFromAirport||'';
    refreshAirportChosen();
    return;
  }
  const village=document.getElementById('rideFromVillage').value;
  const other=document.getElementById('rideFromOther').value.trim();
  const area=village==='أخرى'?other:village;
  document.getElementById('rideFrom').value=center
    ? 'المنوفية - '+center+(area?' - '+area:'')
    : '';
}

function defaultAreasForCenter(center){
  return [
    center,
    'وسط '+center,
    'المنطقة الرئيسية',
    'سيتم تحديد القرية / المنطقة هاتفيًا'
  ];
}

function fillSelectOptions(select,placeholder,items){
  select.innerHTML='';
  const first=document.createElement('option');
  first.value='';
  first.textContent=placeholder;
  select.appendChild(first);

  (items||[]).forEach(function(name){
    const o=document.createElement('option');
    o.value=name;
    o.textContent=name;
    select.appendChild(o);
  });
}

function onToGovernorateChange(){
  const gov=document.getElementById('rideToGovernorate').value;
  const centerWrap=document.getElementById('toCenterWrap');
  const villageWrap=document.getElementById('toVillageWrap');
  const otherWrap=document.getElementById('toOtherWrap');
  const center=document.getElementById('rideToCenter');
  const village=document.getElementById('rideToVillage');
  const other=document.getElementById('rideToOther');
  const detail=document.getElementById('rideToDetail');

  fillSelectOptions(center,'اختر المركز / المدينة',[]);
  fillSelectOptions(village,'اختر القرية / المنطقة',[]);
  detail.value='';
  other.value='';

  centerWrap.classList.remove('active','mwAttention');
  villageWrap.classList.remove('active','mwAttention');
  otherWrap.classList.remove('active');

  if(gov==='AIRPORT'){
    document.getElementById('rideTo').value=selectedToAirport||'';
    document.getElementById('rideToDetail').value=selectedToAirport||'';
    refreshAirportChosen();
    if(!selectedToAirport)setTimeout(function(){openAirportSheet('TO')},0);
    return;
  }

  if(!gov){
    document.getElementById('rideTo').value='';
    return;
  }

  fillSelectOptions(center,'اختر المركز / المدينة',EGYPT_DESTINATIONS[gov]||[gov]);
  centerWrap.classList.add('active','mwAttention');
  document.getElementById('rideTo').value=gov;
}

function onToCenterChange(){
  const gov=document.getElementById('rideToGovernorate').value;
  const center=document.getElementById('rideToCenter').value;
  const centerWrap=document.getElementById('toCenterWrap');
  const villageWrap=document.getElementById('toVillageWrap');
  const otherWrap=document.getElementById('toOtherWrap');
  const village=document.getElementById('rideToVillage');
  const other=document.getElementById('rideToOther');

  centerWrap.classList.toggle('mwAttention',!center);
  fillSelectOptions(village,'اختر القرية / المنطقة',[]);
  otherWrap.classList.remove('active');
  other.value='';

  if(!center){
    villageWrap.classList.remove('active','mwAttention');
    syncRideTo();
    return;
  }

  const key=gov+'|'+center;
  const areas=(EGYPT_AREA_OVERRIDES[key]||defaultAreasForCenter(center)).slice();
  if(!areas.includes('أخرى'))areas.push('أخرى');
  fillSelectOptions(village,'اختر القرية / المنطقة',areas);
  villageWrap.classList.add('active','mwAttention');
  syncRideTo();
}

function onToVillageChange(){
  const village=document.getElementById('rideToVillage').value;
  const otherWrap=document.getElementById('toOtherWrap');
  const other=document.getElementById('rideToOther');
  document.getElementById('toVillageWrap').classList.toggle('mwAttention',!village);
  otherWrap.classList.toggle('active',village==='أخرى');
  if(village!=='أخرى')other.value='';
  syncRideTo();
}

function syncRideTo(){
  const gov=document.getElementById('rideToGovernorate').value;

  if(gov==='AIRPORT'){
    document.getElementById('rideToDetail').value=selectedToAirport||'';
    document.getElementById('rideTo').value=selectedToAirport||'';
    refreshAirportChosen();
    return;
  }

  const center=document.getElementById('rideToCenter').value;
  const village=document.getElementById('rideToVillage').value;
  const other=document.getElementById('rideToOther').value.trim();
  const area=village==='أخرى'?other:village;
  const detail=[center,area].filter(Boolean).join(' - ');

  document.getElementById('rideToDetail').value=detail;
  document.getElementById('rideTo').value=gov
    ? gov+(center?' - '+center:'')+(area?' - '+area:'')
    : '';
}

function setAirportTrip(){
  openAirportSheet('TO');
}

  },
  fast:{
    icon:'☎',
    title:'تواصل سريع',

  },

  document.getElementById('mwFeatureInfoTitle').textContent=d.title;
  document.getElementById('mwFeatureInfoText').textContent=d.text;

}
function closeFeatureInfo(){
  document.getElementById('mwFeatureInfo').classList.remove('active');
  unlockBackgroundScroll();

function featureBackdropClick(e){
