}

function showRideEstimate(result){
  const card=document.getElementById('rideEstimateCard');
  const amount=document.getElementById('rideEstimateAmount');
  const note=document.getElementById('rideEstimateNote');
  if(!card||!amount||!note)return;

  if(result && result.estimatedPrice){
    amount.textContent=Number(result.estimatedPrice).toLocaleString('ar-EG')+' جنيه';
    note.textContent=result.estimateNote||'السعر مبدئي ويتم تأكيد السعر النهائي هاتفيًا.';
  }else{
    amount.textContent='يتم التأكيد هاتفيًا';
    note.textContent=(result&&result.estimateNote)||
      'الوجهة غير موجودة حاليًا في قائمة الأسعار، وسيتم تأكيد التكلفة عند التواصل.';
  }
  card.classList.add('show');
}

function loadPublicPrices(){
  Promise.all([
    callGas('getPublicPrices',[]),
    callGas('getPublicPriceConfig',[])
  ]).then(function(res){
    publicPrices=res[0]||[];
    priceConfig=res[1]||{};
    renderPublicPrices();
  }).catch(function(){});
}

function renderPublicPrices(){
  const box=document.getElementById('publicPriceList');
  if(!box)return;
  const q=(document.getElementById('priceSearch')?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const rows=publicPrices.filter(function(p){
    return !q || (p.destination+' '+p.serviceType+' '+(p.notes||'')).toLowerCase().includes(q);
  });
  const iw=document.getElementById('publicIncludedWait');
  const ew=document.getElementById('publicExtraWait');
  if(iw)iw.textContent=(priceConfig.includedWaitMinutes||60)+' دقيقة';
  if(ew)ew.textContent=(priceConfig.extraWaitHourPrice||75)+' جنيه / ساعة';

  if(!rows.length){
    box.innerHTML='<div class="mwEmpty">لا توجد وجهات مطابقة.</div>';
    return;
  }
  box.innerHTML=rows.map(function(p){
    return '<div class="mwPublicPriceRow"><div><b>'+esc(p.destination)+'</b><small>'+
      esc(p.serviceType||'توصيلة')+
      (p.includedWaitMinutes===0?' • بدون انتظار':' • يشمل '+esc(p.includedWaitMinutes)+' دقيقة انتظار')+
      (p.notes?' • '+esc(p.notes):'')+
      '</small></div><div class="mwPublicPriceAmount">'+esc(p.price)+' جنيه</div></div>';
  }).join('');
}

function loadPublicNotifications(){
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(function(rows){
      publicNotifications=Array.isArray(rows)?rows:[];
      const dot=document.getElementById('mwNoticeDot');
      if(dot)dot.style.display=publicNotifications.length?'block':'none';
      renderPublicNotifications();
    })
    .withFailureHandler(function(){})
    .getPublicNotifications();
}

function renderPublicNotifications(){
  const box=document.getElementById('mwNotificationsList');
  if(!box)return;
  if(!publicNotifications.length){
    box.innerHTML='<div class="mwEmpty">لا توجد إشعارات جديدة حاليًا.</div>';
    return;
  }
  box.innerHTML=publicNotifications.map(function(n){
    return '<div class="mwNoticeItem"><b>'+esc(n.title)+'</b><p>'+esc(n.message)+'</p><small>'+esc(n.createdAt||'')+'</small></div>';
  }).join('');
}

function openPublicNotifications(){
  renderPublicNotifications();
  lockBackgroundScroll('modal');
  document.getElementById('mwNotificationsSheet').classList.add('active');
}
function closePublicNotifications(){
  document.getElementById('mwNotificationsSheet').classList.remove('active');
  unlockBackgroundScroll();
}

function openRideContactSheet(){
  hideBox('rideError');

  const from=document.getElementById('rideFrom').value.trim();
  const to=document.getElementById('rideTo').value.trim();
  const gov=document.getElementById('rideToGovernorate').value;
  const toCenter=document.getElementById('rideToCenter').value;
  const toVillage=document.getElementById('rideToVillage').value;
  const date=document.getElementById('rideDate').value;
  const time=document.getElementById('rideTime').value;
  const missing=[];

  if(!from) missing.push(document.getElementById('rideFromCenter').value==='AIRPORT'?'اختيار مطار الانطلاق':'مكان الانطلاق');
  if(!gov) missing.push('المحافظة / الوجهة');
  if(gov && gov!=='AIRPORT' && !toCenter) missing.push('المركز / المدينة');
  if(gov && gov!=='AIRPORT' && !toVillage) missing.push('القرية / المنطقة');
  if(!to) missing.push('الوجهة');
  if(!date) missing.push('تاريخ المشوار');
  if(!time) missing.push('وقت المشوار');

  if(tripType==='ROUND'){
    if(!document.getElementById('rideReturnDate').value) missing.push('تاريخ العودة');
    if(!document.getElementById('rideReturnTime').value) missing.push('وقت العودة');
  }

  if(waitingRequired && !document.getElementById('rideWaitingDetails').value){
    missing.push('مدة الانتظار');
  }

  if(missing.length){
    showBox('rideError','يرجى استكمال البيانات التالية: '+missing.join(' | ')+'.');
    const err=document.getElementById('rideError');
    if(err) err.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});
    return;
  }

  rideWizardStep=3;
  updateRideWizardUi();
  updateRideConfirmSummaryV2();

  dismissKeyboard();
  syncMashwarakVisualViewport();
  const sheet=document.getElementById('mwContactSheet');
  const card=sheet ? sheet.querySelector('.mwSheetCard') : null;
  if(card) card.scrollTop=0;

  lockBackgroundScroll('modal');
  if(sheet) sheet.classList.add('active');
  if(typeof refreshRideContactFieldStates==='function')refreshRideContactFieldStates();

  requestAnimationFrame(function(){
    if(card) card.scrollTop=0;
  });
}

function closeRideContactSheet(){
  const sheet=document.getElementById('mwContactSheet');
  const active=document.activeElement;
  if(active && sheet && sheet.contains(active) && typeof active.blur==='function'){
    try{active.blur();}catch(e){}
  }
  if(sheet)sheet.classList.remove('active');
  rideWizardStep=2;
  updateRideWizardUi();
  unlockBackgroundScroll(true);
}


function rideAcLabelV24(value){
  if(value==='WITH_AC')return 'تكييف شغال';
  if(value==='WITHOUT_AC')return 'بدون تكييف';
  return '—'
}

function setRideDoneText(id,value){
  const node=document.getElementById(id);
  if(node)node.textContent=(value===null||value===undefined||value==='')?'—':String(value)
}

function renderRideSuccessScreenV24(){
  const d=lastRideReceipt;
  if(!d)return false;

  setRideDoneText('rideDoneId',d.rideId);
  setRideDoneText('rideDoneName',d.name);
  setRideDoneText('rideDoneMobile',d.mobile);
  setRideDoneText('rideDoneFrom',d.from);
  setRideDoneText('rideDoneTo',d.to);
  setRideDoneText('rideDoneTripType',d.tripType);
  setRideDoneText(
    'rideDoneDateTime',
    [d.date,d.time].filter(Boolean).join(' | ')
  );

  const returnItem=document.getElementById('rideDoneReturnItem');
  const hasReturn=!!(d.returnDate||d.returnTime);
  if(returnItem)returnItem.style.display=hasReturn?'block':'none';
  setRideDoneText(
    'rideDoneReturn',
    [d.returnDate,d.returnTime].filter(Boolean).join(' | ')
  );

  setRideDoneText('rideDonePassengers',d.passengers||'1');
  setRideDoneText('rideDoneAc',rideAcLabelV24(d.acPreference));

  const waitingText=d.waiting==='نعم'
    ? ('نعم'+(d.waitingDetails?' | '+d.waitingDetails:''))
    : 'لا يوجد انتظار';
  setRideDoneText('rideDoneWaiting',waitingText);

  setRideDoneText('rideDoneExtras',d.extras||'لا توجد إضافات');
  setRideDoneText('rideDoneCaptainAge',d.captainAgePreference||'لا يوجد تفضيل');

  const price=document.getElementById('rideDonePrice');
  if(price){
    price.textContent=d.estimatedPrice
      ? Number(d.estimatedPrice).toLocaleString('ar-EG')+' جنيه'
      : 'يتم التأكيد هاتفيًا';
  }

  const note=document.getElementById('rideDonePriceNote');
  if(note){
    note.textContent=d.estimateNote||
      'السعر مبدئي ويتم تأكيد السعر النهائي هاتفيًا.';
  }

  return true
}

function openRideSuccessScreenV24(){
  if(!renderRideSuccessScreenV24())return;
  openScreen('rideSuccess');
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'auto'})
}

function rideSuccessNewRequest(){
  lastRideReceipt=null;

  const oldSuccess=document.getElementById('rideSuccess');
  const oldEstimate=document.getElementById('rideEstimateCard');
  const oldActions=document.getElementById('rideSuccessActions');
  const oldDownload=document.getElementById('downloadRideReceiptBtn');

  if(oldSuccess)oldSuccess.style.display='none';
  if(oldEstimate)oldEstimate.classList.remove('show');
  if(oldActions)oldActions.classList.remove('active');
  if(oldDownload)oldDownload.classList.remove('show');

  resetRideForm(false);
  openScreen('customer');

  setTimeout(function(){
    const booking=document.getElementById('mwBooking');
    if(booking)booking.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})
  },80)
}

function rideSuccessGoHome(){
  openScreen('customer');
}



function syncMashwarakNativeHelpSafeSide(){
  try{
    const langs=(navigator.languages&&navigator.languages.length?navigator.languages:[navigator.language||'']);
    const lang=String(langs[0]||'').trim();
    const rtl=/^(ar|he|fa|ur)(-|$)/i.test(lang);
    const root=document.documentElement;
    const nativeAndroid=/MashwarakAndroid\//i.test(String(navigator.userAgent||''));
    root.classList.toggle('mwNativeAndroid',nativeAndroid);
    root.classList.toggle('mwNativeHelpRtl',rtl);
    root.classList.toggle('mwNativeHelpLtr',!rtl);
  }catch(_){
    document.documentElement.classList.add('mwNativeHelpRtl');
  }
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',syncMashwarakNativeHelpSafeSide);
window.addEventListener('languagechange',syncMashwarakNativeHelpSafeSide);


let activeRideRequestIdV242='';
let rideSubmitAttemptV242=0;

function getRideRequestIdV242(){
  if(activeRideRequestIdV242)return activeRideRequestIdV242;
  try{
    if(window.crypto && typeof window.crypto.randomUUID==='function'){
      activeRideRequestIdV242='MW-'+window.crypto.randomUUID();
      return activeRideRequestIdV242;
    }
  }catch(_){ }
  activeRideRequestIdV242='MW-'+Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10);
  return activeRideRequestIdV242;
}

function showRideConnectionErrorV242(message){
  setRideSubmitting(false);
  showBox('rideError',message);
  const err=document.getElementById('rideError');
  if(err && typeof err.scrollIntoView==='function'){
    try{err.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});}catch(_){ }
  }
}

function setRideSubmitting(active){
  const overlay=document.getElementById('rideSubmitOverlay');
  const submit=document.getElementById('rideSubmitBtn');
  const cancel=document.querySelector('#mwContactSheet .mwCancelBtn');
  const on=!!active;

  if(overlay){
    overlay.classList.toggle('active',on);
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden',on?'false':'true');
  }
  document.body.classList.toggle('mwRideSubmitting',on);

  if(submit){
    submit.disabled=on;
    submit.textContent=on?'جاري التسجيل...':'تأكيد طلب المشوار';
  }
  if(cancel)cancel.disabled=on;
}

function submitRideFromButton(btn){
  if(!btn || btn.id!=='rideSubmitBtn') return;
  submitRide();
}

function submitRide(){
  hideBox('rideSuccess');hideBox('rideError');

  if(!validateRideContactFields(true)){
    scrollToFirstInvalidRideContact();
    return;
  }

  const payload={
    customerName:document.getElementById('rideName').value,
    mobile:document.getElementById('rideMobile').value,
    tripType:tripType,
    from:document.getElementById('rideFrom').value,
    to:document.getElementById('rideTo').value,
    fromLat:document.getElementById('rideFromLat').value,
    fromLng:document.getElementById('rideFromLng').value,
    fromMapUrl:document.getElementById('rideFromMapUrl').value,
    fromMapLabel:document.getElementById('rideFromMapLabel').value,
    toLat:document.getElementById('rideToLat').value,
    toLng:document.getElementById('rideToLng').value,
    toMapUrl:document.getElementById('rideToMapUrl').value,
    toMapLabel:document.getElementById('rideToMapLabel').value,
    date:document.getElementById('rideDate').value,
    time:document.getElementById('rideTime').value,
    returnDate:document.getElementById('rideReturnDate').value,
    returnTime:document.getElementById('rideReturnTime').value,
    waiting:waitingRequired ? 'YES' : 'NO',
    waitingDetails:document.getElementById('rideWaitingDetails').value,
    termsAccepted:document.getElementById('rideTerms').checked,
    passengers:document.getElementById('ridePassengers').value,
    extras:selectedRideExtras(),
    captainAgePreference:captainAgePreference ? 'YES' : 'NO',
    captainAgeMin:document.getElementById('captainAgeMin').value,
    captainAgeMax:document.getElementById('captainAgeMax').value,
    acPreference:rideAcPreference,
    requestId:getRideRequestIdV242(),
    notes:''
  };

  if(!payload.acPreference){
    showBox('rideError','اختر هل تريد سيارة بتكييف شغال أم بدون تكييف.');
    return;
  }

  if(!payload.termsAccepted){
    showBox('rideError','يجب الموافقة على الشروط والأحكام قبل تأكيد الطلب.');
    return;
  }
  if(captainAgePreference){
    if(!payload.captainAgeMin || !payload.captainAgeMax){
      showBox('rideError','اختر نطاق سن الكابتن المفضل.');return;
    }
    if(Number(payload.captainAgeMin)>Number(payload.captainAgeMax)){
      showBox('rideError','سن البداية يجب أن يكون أقل من أو يساوي سن النهاية.');return;
    }
  }

  if(!payload.time){
    showBox('rideError','من فضلك حدد وقت المشوار أولاً.');
    return;
  }

  const submitBtn=document.getElementById('rideSubmitBtn');
  setRideSubmitting(true);

  if(!(window.google && google.script && google.script.run)){
    showRideConnectionErrorV242('تعذر الاتصال بخدمة مشوارك من هذه الصفحة. حدّث الصفحة وحاول مرة أخرى.');
    return;
  }

  const attemptV242=++rideSubmitAttemptV242;
  let settledV242=false;
  const timeoutV242=setTimeout(function(){
    if(settledV242 || attemptV242!==rideSubmitAttemptV242)return;
    showRideConnectionErrorV242('الاتصال بالخدمة استغرق وقتًا أطول من المعتاد. لم يتم إنشاء طلب إضافي تلقائيًا؛ اضغط «تأكيد طلب المشوار» مرة أخرى لإعادة المحاولة بأمان.');
  },25000);

  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(r=>{
      settledV242=true;
      clearTimeout(timeoutV242);
      activeRideRequestIdV242='';
      // Keep a clean snapshot for the downloadable receipt before clearing the form.
      lastRideReceipt=buildRideReceiptData(payload,r.rideId,r.estimatedPrice,r.estimateNote);

      closeRideContactSheet();
      unlockBackgroundScroll(true);

      // Clear the booking form only after preserving the completed request
      // in lastRideReceipt, then move to a clean standalone confirmation screen.
      resetRideForm(false);

      const oldSuccess=document.getElementById('rideSuccess');
      const oldEstimate=document.getElementById('rideEstimateCard');
      const oldActions=document.getElementById('rideSuccessActions');
      const oldDownload=document.getElementById('downloadRideReceiptBtn');

      if(oldSuccess)oldSuccess.style.display='none';
      if(oldEstimate)oldEstimate.classList.remove('show');
      if(oldActions)oldActions.classList.remove('active');
      if(oldDownload)oldDownload.classList.remove('show');

      openRideSuccessScreenV24();
      requestAnimationFrame(function(){setRideSubmitting(false);});
    })
    .withFailureHandler(e=>{
      if(attemptV242!==rideSubmitAttemptV242)return;
      settledV242=true;
      clearTimeout(timeoutV242);
      showRideConnectionErrorV242((e&&e.message)?e.message:'تعذر إرسال الطلب. حاول مرة أخرى.');
    })
    .submitRideRequest(payload);
}

function submitDriver(){
  hideBox('driverSuccess');hideBox('driverError');
  const oldActions=document.getElementById('driverSuccessActions');
  if(oldActions)oldActions.classList.remove('active');
  const oldReceipt=document.getElementById('downloadDriverReceiptBtn');
  if(oldReceipt)oldReceipt.classList.remove('show');
  const oldNote=document.getElementById('driverReceiptNote');
  if(oldNote)oldNote.style.display='none';
  syncDriverCity();
  const payload={
    fullName:document.getElementById('dName').value,
    mobile:document.getElementById('dMobile').value,
    cityArea:document.getElementById('dCity').value,
    age:document.getElementById('dAge').value,
    carType:document.getElementById('dCarType').value,
    brand:document.getElementById('dBrand').value,
    model:document.getElementById('dModel').value,
    brandModel:(document.getElementById('dBrand').value+' '+document.getElementById('dModel').value).trim(),
    year:document.getElementById('dYear').value,
    color:document.getElementById('dColor').value,
    seats:document.getElementById('dSeats').value,
    acWorking:document.getElementById('dAc').value,
    availabilityType:document.getElementById('dAvailability').value,
    availabilityDetails:document.getElementById('dAvailabilityDetails').value,
    notes:document.getElementById('dNotes').value,
    termsAccepted:document.getElementById('driverTerms').checked,
    documents:{
      nationalFront:captainFiles.nationalFront,
      nationalBack:captainFiles.nationalBack,
      driverLicenseFront:captainFiles.driverLicenseFront,
      driverLicenseBack:captainFiles.driverLicenseBack,
      carLicenseFront:captainFiles.carLicenseFront,
      carLicenseBack:captainFiles.carLicenseBack,
      liveSelfie:captainFiles.liveSelfie,
      carPhoto:captainFiles.carPhoto,
      captainWithCar:captainFiles.captainWithCar
    }
  };

  if(!payload.termsAccepted){
    showBox('driverError','يجب الموافقة على شروط وأحكام الكابتن قبل التسجيل.');
    return;
  }
  const missingDocs=Object.keys(payload.documents).filter(function(k){return !payload.documents[k];});
  if(missingDocs.length){
    showBox('driverError','من فضلك ارفع جميع المستندات والصور المطلوبة.');
    return;
  }

  loading(true);
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(r=>{
      lastDriverReceipt=buildDriverReceiptData(payload,r.driverId);

      resetDriverForm();

      showBox(
        'driverSuccess',
        (r.message||'تم تسجيل البيانات بنجاح.')+' رقم الطلب: '+(r.driverId||'—')
      );

      const actions=document.getElementById('driverSuccessActions');
      if(actions)actions.classList.add('active');

      const dl=document.getElementById('downloadDriverReceiptBtn');
      if(dl)dl.classList.add('show');

      const note=document.getElementById('driverReceiptNote');
      if(note)note.style.display='block';

      document.getElementById('driverSuccess').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});
    })
    .withFailureHandler(e=>{
      releaseUi();
      showBox('driverError',e.message||'تعذر تسجيل البيانات');
    })
    .registerDriver(payload);
}

function adminLogin(){
  hideBox('adminLoginError');
  const pin=document.getElementById('adminPin').value;
  loading(true);
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(r=>{
      loading(false);
      adminToken=r.token;
      adminData=r.dashboard;
      openScreen('admin');
      renderDashboard();
      loadAdminLists();
    })
    .withFailureHandler(e=>{loading(false);showBox('adminLoginError',e.message||'تعذر الدخول');})
    .adminLogin(pin);
}

function refreshAdmin(){
  if(!adminToken)return;
  loading(true);
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(r=>{adminData=r;renderDashboard();loadAdminLists();})
    .withFailureHandler(e=>{loading(false);alert(e.message||'تعذر التحديث');})
    .getAdminDashboard(adminToken);
}

function renderDashboard(){
  if(!adminData)return;
  const s=adminData.stats||{};
  document.getElementById('sNew').textContent=s.newRides||0;
  document.getElementById('sCompleted').textContent=s.completed||0;
  document.getElementById('sDrivers').textContent=s.drivers||0;
  document.getElementById('sReview').textContent=s.driversUnderReview||0;
}

function loadAdminLists(){
  Promise.all([
    callGas('getAdminRides',[adminToken,'ALL']),
    callGas('getAdminDrivers',[adminToken,'ALL']),
    callGas('getAdminNotifications',[adminToken]),
    callGas('getAdminPrices',[adminToken]),
    callGas('getAdminPriceConfig',[adminToken])
  ]).then(([rides,drivers,notices,prices,config])=>{
    adminRides=rides||[];
    adminDrivers=drivers||[];
    adminNotifications=notices||[];
    adminPrices=prices||[];
    priceConfig=config||{};
    renderAdminRides();
    renderAdminDrivers();
    renderAdminNotifications();
    renderAdminPrices();
    fillAdminPriceConfig();
    loading(false);
  }).catch(e=>{
    loading(false);alert(e.message||e);
  });
}

function callGas(fn,args){
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(resolve).withFailureHandler(reject)[fn].apply(google.script.run,args||[]);
  });
}

function showAdminTab(tab){
  const rides=tab==='rides';
  const drivers=tab==='drivers';
  const notices=tab==='notifications';
  const prices=tab==='prices';
  document.getElementById('adminRides').classList.toggle('hidden',!rides);
  document.getElementById('adminDrivers').classList.toggle('hidden',!drivers);
  document.getElementById('adminNotifications').classList.toggle('hidden',!notices);
  document.getElementById('adminPrices').classList.toggle('hidden',!prices);
  document.getElementById('tabRides').classList.toggle('active',rides);
  document.getElementById('tabDrivers').classList.toggle('active',drivers);
  document.getElementById('tabNotifications').classList.toggle('active',notices);
  document.getElementById('tabPrices').classList.toggle('active',prices);
}

function statusLabel(s){
  return {NEW:'جديد',CONFIRMED:'مؤكد',ASSIGNED:'تم إسناد كابتن',COMPLETED:'تمت',CANCELLED:'ملغاة'}[s]||s;
}
function statusClass(s){
  return s==='NEW'?'b-new':s==='COMPLETED'?'b-ok':s==='CANCELLED'?'b-red':'b-blue';
}
function driverStatusLabel(s){
  return {UNDER_REVIEW:'تحت المراجعة',APPROVED:'معتمد',REJECTED:'مرفوض',INACTIVE:'غير نشط'}[s]||s;
}
function driverStatusClass(s){
  return s==='UNDER_REVIEW'?'b-new':s==='APPROVED'?'b-ok':s==='REJECTED'?'b-red':'b-blue';
}
function esc(s){
  return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
}

function renderAdminRides(){
  const box=document.getElementById('adminRides');
  if(!adminRides.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="muted" style="text-align:center;padding:30px">لا توجد طلبات حتى الآن.</div>';return;}
  box.innerHTML=adminRides.map(r=>`
    <div class="list-card">
      <div class="list-card-head">
        <div>
          <h3>${esc(r.customerName)} <span class="muted">#${esc(r.rideId)}</span></h3>
          <div class="meta">${esc(r.date)} • ${esc(r.time)} • ${esc(r.passengers)} راكب</div>
        </div>
        <span class="badge ${statusClass(r.status)}">${statusLabel(r.status)}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="route">${esc(r.from)} ← ${esc(r.to)}</div>
      <div class="meta">📞 ${esc(r.mobile)}${r.assignedDriverName?' • 🚘 '+esc(r.assignedDriverName):''}</div>
      <div class="card-actions">
        <button type="button" onclick="location.href='tel:${esc(r.mobile)}'">اتصال</button>
        <button type="button" class="primary-mini" onclick="openRideAdmin('${esc(r.rideId)}')">إدارة الطلب</button>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}

function renderAdminDrivers(){
  const box=document.getElementById('adminDrivers');
  if(!adminDrivers.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="muted" style="text-align:center;padding:30px">لا يوجد كابتنون مسجلون حتى الآن.</div>';return;}
  box.innerHTML=adminDrivers.map(d=>`
    <div class="list-card">
      <div class="list-card-head">
        <div>
          <h3>${esc(d.fullName)} <span class="muted">#${esc(d.driverId)}</span></h3>
          <div class="meta">${esc(d.cityArea)} • ${esc(d.brandModel)} ${esc(d.year)}</div>
        </div>
        <span class="badge ${driverStatusClass(d.adminStatus)}">${driverStatusLabel(d.adminStatus)}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="route">${esc(d.carType)} • ${esc(d.color)} • ${esc(d.seats)} مقاعد • تكييف: ${d.acWorking==='YES'?'شغال':'غير شغال'}</div>
      <div class="meta">📞 ${esc(d.mobile)} • ${d.availabilityType==='FULL_TIME'?'متاح طوال الوقت':esc(d.availabilityDetails||'أوقات محددة')}</div>
      <div class="card-actions">
        <button type="button" onclick="location.href='tel:${esc(d.mobile)}'">اتصال</button>
        <button type="button" class="primary-mini" onclick="openDriverAdmin('${esc(d.driverId)}')">مراجعة البيانات</button>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}


function renderAdminNotifications(){
  const box=document.getElementById('adminNoticeList');
  if(!box)return;
  if(!adminNotifications.length){
    box.innerHTML='<div class="meta" style="text-align:center;padding:20px">لا توجد إشعارات منشورة حتى الآن.</div>';
    return;
  }
  box.innerHTML=adminNotifications.map(function(n){
    return '<div class="list-card"><div class="list-card-head"><div><h3>'+esc(n.title)+'</h3><div class="meta">'+esc(n.createdAt||'')+'</div></div><span class="badge '+(n.active?'b-ok':'b-red')+'">'+(n.active?'نشط':'موقوف')+'</span></div><div class="route">'+esc(n.message)+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');
}

function createAdminNotice(){
  const title=document.getElementById('adminNoticeTitle').value.trim();
  const message=document.getElementById('adminNoticeMessage').value.trim();
  if(!title||!message){alert('اكتب عنوان ونص الإشعار.');return;}
  loading(true);
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(function(){
      document.getElementById('adminNoticeTitle').value='';
      document.getElementById('adminNoticeMessage').value='';
      loadPublicNotifications();
      refreshAdmin();
    })
    .withFailureHandler(function(e){loading(false);alert(e.message||'تعذر نشر الإشعار');})
    .createAdminNotification(adminToken,title,message);
}


function fillAdminPriceConfig(){
  const base=document.getElementById('priceBaseArea');
  const wait=document.getElementById('priceIncludedWait');
  const extra=document.getElementById('priceExtraWait');
  if(base)base.value=priceConfig.baseArea||'بركة السبع - المنوفية';
  if(wait)wait.value=priceConfig.includedWaitMinutes||60;
  if(extra)extra.value=priceConfig.extraWaitHourPrice||75;
}

function renderAdminPrices(){
  const box=document.getElementById('adminPriceList');
  if(!box)return;
  if(!adminPrices.length){
    box.innerHTML='<div class="meta" style="text-align:center;padding:20px">لا توجد أسعار.</div>';
    return;
  }

  box.innerHTML=adminPrices.map(function(p){
    const waitText=p.includedWaitMinutes===0
      ? ' • بدون انتظار'
      : ' • انتظار '+esc(p.includedWaitMinutes)+' دقيقة';

    return `
      <div class="mwPriceAdminCard">
        <div class="list-card-head">
          <div>
            <h3>${esc(p.destination)}</h3>
            <div class="meta">${esc(p.serviceType)} • ${esc(p.price)} جنيه${waitText}</div>
          </div>
          <span class="badge ${p.active?'b-ok':'b-red'}">${p.active?'نشط':'موقوف'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="card-actions">
          <button type="button" class="primary-mini" data-price-id="${esc(p.priceId)}" onclick="openPriceAdmin(this.dataset.priceId)">تعديل</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function savePriceConfig(){
  const payload={
    baseArea:document.getElementById('priceBaseArea').value,
    includedWaitMinutes:document.getElementById('priceIncludedWait').value,
    extraWaitHourPrice:document.getElementById('priceExtraWait').value
  };
  loading(true);
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(function(){loadPublicPrices();refreshAdmin();})
    .withFailureHandler(function(e){loading(false);alert(e.message||'تعذر حفظ إعدادات التسعير');})
    .updateAdminPriceConfig(adminToken,payload);
}

function createAdminPrice(){
  const payload={
    destination:document.getElementById('newPriceDestination').value,
    serviceType:document.getElementById('newPriceService').value||'توصيلة',
    price:document.getElementById('newPriceAmount').value,
    notes:document.getElementById('newPriceNotes').value,
    active:true
  };
  if(!payload.destination||!payload.price){alert('اكتب الوجهة والسعر.');return;}
  loading(true);
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(function(){
      document.getElementById('newPriceDestination').value='';
      document.getElementById('newPriceAmount').value='';
      document.getElementById('newPriceNotes').value='';
      loadPublicPrices();refreshAdmin();
    })
    .withFailureHandler(function(e){loading(false);alert(e.message||'تعذر إضافة السعر');})
    .saveAdminPrice(adminToken,payload);
}

function openPriceAdmin(id){
  const p=adminPrices.find(x=>x.priceId===id);if(!p)return;
  document.getElementById('mPriceId').value=p.priceId;
  document.getElementById('mPriceDestination').value=p.destination||'';
  document.getElementById('mPriceService').value=p.serviceType||'توصيلة';
  document.getElementById('mPriceAmount').value=p.price||'';
  document.getElementById('mPriceWait').value=p.includedWaitMinutes==null?60:p.includedWaitMinutes;
  document.getElementById('mPriceExtraWait').value=p.extraWaitHourPrice==null?75:p.extraWaitHourPrice;
  document.getElementById('mPriceNotes').value=p.notes||'';
  document.getElementById('mPriceActive').value=p.active?'TRUE':'FALSE';
  document.getElementById('priceModal').classList.add('active');
}

function saveAdminPrice(){
  const payload={
    priceId:document.getElementById('mPriceId').value,
    destination:document.getElementById('mPriceDestination').value,
    serviceType:document.getElementById('mPriceService').value,
    price:document.getElementById('mPriceAmount').value,
    includedWaitMinutes:document.getElementById('mPriceWait').value,
    extraWaitHourPrice:document.getElementById('mPriceExtraWait').value,
    notes:document.getElementById('mPriceNotes').value,
    active:document.getElementById('mPriceActive').value==='TRUE'
  };
  loading(true);
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(function(){closeModal('priceModal');loadPublicPrices();refreshAdmin();})
    .withFailureHandler(function(e){loading(false);alert(e.message||'تعذر حفظ السعر');})
    .saveAdminPrice(adminToken,payload);
}

function openRideAdmin(id){
  const r=adminRides.find(x=>x.rideId===id);if(!r)return;
  document.getElementById('mRideId').value=r.rideId;
  document.getElementById('mRideStatus').value=r.status;
  document.getElementById('mRidePrice').value=r.finalPrice||'';
  document.getElementById('mRideNotes').value=r.adminNotes||'';
  document.getElementById('mRideSummary').innerHTML=
    '<b>'+esc(r.customerName)+'</b><br>'+esc(r.from)+' ← '+esc(r.to)+'<br>'+esc(r.date)+' • '+esc(r.time);

  const sel=document.getElementById('mRideDriver');
  const approved=adminDrivers.filter(d=>d.adminStatus==='APPROVED');
  sel.innerHTML='<option value="">بدون كابتن</option>'+approved.map(d=>`<option value="${esc(d.driverId)}">${esc(d.fullName)} - ${esc(d.brandModel)}</option>`).join('');
  sel.value=r.assignedDriverId||'';
  document.getElementById('rideModal').classList.add('active');
}

function openDriverAdmin(id){
  const d=adminDrivers.find(x=>x.driverId===id);if(!d)return;
  document.getElementById('mDriverId').value=d.driverId;
  document.getElementById('mDriverStatus').value=d.adminStatus;
  document.getElementById('mDriverNotes').value=d.adminNotes||'';
  document.getElementById('mDriverSummary').innerHTML=
    '<b>'+esc(d.fullName)+'</b><br>'+esc(d.brandModel)+' '+esc(d.year)+' • '+esc(d.color)+'<br>'+esc(d.cityArea)+' • '+esc(d.mobile);
  document.getElementById('driverModal').classList.add('active');
}

function closeModal(id){document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('active')}

function saveDriverAdmin(){
  loading(true);
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(()=>{closeModal('driverModal');refreshAdmin();})
    .withFailureHandler(e=>{loading(false);alert(e.message||'تعذر الحفظ');})
    .updateDriverAdminStatus(
      adminToken,
      document.getElementById('mDriverId').value,
      document.getElementById('mDriverStatus').value,
      document.getElementById('mDriverNotes').value
    );
}

function saveRideAdmin(){
  const payload={
    rideId:document.getElementById('mRideId').value,
    status:document.getElementById('mRideStatus').value,
    assignedDriverId:document.getElementById('mRideDriver').value,
    finalPrice:document.getElementById('mRidePrice').value,
    adminNotes:document.getElementById('mRideNotes').value
  };
  loading(true);
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(()=>{closeModal('rideModal');refreshAdmin();})
    .withFailureHandler(e=>{loading(false);alert(e.message||'تعذر الحفظ');})
    .updateRide(adminToken,payload);
}
</script>
<script>


/* =========================================================
   RESPONSIVE VIEWPORT + TERMS TAP TARGET + PROMO CAROUSEL
========================================================= */
function syncMashwarakVisualViewport(){
  try{
    const root=document.documentElement;
    const vv=window.visualViewport;
    const layoutH=Math.max(1,Math.round(window.innerHeight||document.documentElement.clientHeight||0));
    const visibleH=Math.max(280,Math.round(vv&&vv.height ? vv.height : layoutH));
    const top=Math.max(0,Math.round(vv&&Number.isFinite(vv.offsetTop) ? vv.offsetTop : 0));
    const bottomGap=Math.max(0,layoutH-(top+visibleH));
    root.style.setProperty('--mw-vv-height',visibleH+'px');
    root.style.setProperty('--mw-vv-top',top+'px');
    root.style.setProperty('--mw-vv-bottom-gap',bottomGap+'px');
  }catch(_){ }
}

function toggleRideTermsFromBox(ev){
  const box=ev&&ev.currentTarget ? ev.currentTarget : null;
  const target=ev&&ev.target ? ev.target : null;
  const terms=document.getElementById('rideTerms');
  if(!box||!terms||!target)return;
  if(target===terms)return;
  if(target.closest && target.closest('button'))return;
  /* Native <label for="rideTerms"> already toggles the checkbox by itself. */
  if(target.closest && target.closest('label'))return;
  terms.checked=!terms.checked;
  terms.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));
}

let mwPromoIndex=0;
let mwPromoTimer=null;
let mwPromoResumeTimer=null;
let mwPromoScrollRaf=0;
const MW_PROMO_INTERVAL=4500;

function getMwPromoTrack(){return document.getElementById('mwPromoTrack')}
function getMwPromoSlides(){
  const track=getMwPromoTrack();
  return track ? Array.from(track.querySelectorAll('.mwPromoSlide')) : [];
}
function updateMwPromoDots(index){
  const dots=document.querySelectorAll('#mwPromoDots button');
  dots.forEach(function(dot,i){dot.classList.toggle('active',i===index)});
}
function goToPromoSlide(index,userAction){
  const track=getMwPromoTrack();
  const slides=getMwPromoSlides();
  if(!track||!slides.length)return;
  mwPromoIndex=((Number(index)||0)%slides.length+slides.length)%slides.length;
  const reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  track.scrollTo({left:mwPromoIndex*track.clientWidth,behavior:reduce?'auto':'smooth'});
  updateMwPromoDots(mwPromoIndex);
  if(userAction)pauseMwPromoThenResume();
}
function stopMwPromo(){
  if(mwPromoTimer){clearInterval(mwPromoTimer);mwPromoTimer=null}
}
function startMwPromo(){
  stopMwPromo();
  if(document.hidden)return;
  if(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)return;
  const slides=getMwPromoSlides();
  if(slides.length<2)return;
  mwPromoTimer=setInterval(function(){goToPromoSlide(mwPromoIndex+1,false)},MW_PROMO_INTERVAL);
}
function pauseMwPromoThenResume(){
  stopMwPromo();
  if(mwPromoResumeTimer)clearTimeout(mwPromoResumeTimer);
  mwPromoResumeTimer=setTimeout(startMwPromo,6500);
}
function syncMwPromoIndexFromScroll(){
  const track=getMwPromoTrack();
  if(!track||!track.clientWidth)return;
  const next=Math.max(0,Math.min(getMwPromoSlides().length-1,Math.round(track.scrollLeft/track.clientWidth)));
  if(next!==mwPromoIndex){mwPromoIndex=next;updateMwPromoDots(next)}
}
function initMwPromoCarousel(){
  const track=getMwPromoTrack();
  if(!track||track.dataset.ready==='1')return;
  track.dataset.ready='1';
  track.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
    if(mwPromoScrollRaf)return;
    mwPromoScrollRaf=requestAnimationFrame(function(){mwPromoScrollRaf=0;syncMwPromoIndexFromScroll()});
  },{passive:true});
  ['touchstart','pointerdown'].forEach(function(type){
    track.addEventListener(type,function(){stopMwPromo()},{passive:true});
  });
  ['touchend','pointerup','pointercancel'].forEach(function(type){
    track.addEventListener(type,pauseMwPromoThenResume,{passive:true});
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize',function(){
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){goToPromoSlide(mwPromoIndex,false)});
  },{passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){if(document.hidden)stopMwPromo();else startMwPromo()});
  updateMwPromoDots(0);
  startMwPromo();
}


document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
  syncMashwarakVisualViewport();
  initMwPromoCarousel();
  enableSelectScrollProtection();
  bindRideFreshStart();
  initDriverFieldValidation();
  fillAirportSelect();
  unlockBackgroundScroll(true);
});
window.addEventListener('resize',syncMashwarakVisualViewport,{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('orientationchange',function(){setTimeout(syncMashwarakVisualViewport,80)},{passive:true});
if(window.visualViewport){
  window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize',syncMashwarakVisualViewport,{passive:true});
  window.visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll',syncMashwarakVisualViewport,{passive:true});
}
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
  try{
    var desktopLogo=document.getElementById('mwDesktopBrandLogo');
    var approvedLogo=document.querySelector('.mwBookingAppIcon img') || document.querySelector('.mwPromoAppIcon img');
    if(desktopLogo && approvedLogo && approvedLogo.src){ desktopLogo.src=approvedLogo.src; }
  }catch(_){ }
});
</script>


<script>
/* =========================================================
   MASHWARAK V2.5.2 | SMART LOCATION AUTO AREA
   - Lazy Leaflet/OpenStreetMap picker for FROM / TO.
   - Exact lat/lng + map URL saved with ride.
   - Can import coordinates from map links.
   - Receives Android shared/opened locations by postMessage.
   - Auto-fills governorate / center from native reverse-geocode when reliable.
   - No automatic price calculation in this phase.
========================================================= */
(function(){
  const MW_MAP_DEFAULT=[30.55,30.90];
  let mwMap=null,mwMapMarker=null,mwMapMode='TO',mwPendingPoint=null,mwPendingLocationMeta=null;
  let mwLeafletPromise=null;

  function num(v){const n=Number(v);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:null}
  function fmt(v){return Number(v).toFixed(6)}
  function mapUrl(lat,lng){return 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query='+encodeURIComponent(fmt(lat)+','+fmt(lng))}
  function sidePrefix(mode){return mode==='FROM'?'rideFrom':'rideTo'}
  function getExisting(mode){
    const p=sidePrefix(mode),lat=num(document.getElementById(p+'Lat')?.value),lng=num(document.getElementById(p+'Lng')?.value);
    return lat!==null&&lng!==null?{lat,lng}:null;
  }
  function setStatus(text,error){const el=document.getElementById('mwMapStatus');if(el){el.textContent=text;el.style.color=error?'#A51131':'#45505E'}}

  function normArabicPlace(v){
    return String(v||'').toLowerCase()
      .replace(/محافظة/g,'').replace(/governorate/g,'')
      .replace(/[أإآ]/g,'ا').replace(/ى/g,'ي').replace(/ة/g,'ه')
      .replace(/[ًٌٍَُِّْـ]/g,'').replace(/[^a-z0-9\u0600-\u06ff]+/g,' ').trim();
  }

  const MW_GOV_ALIASES={
    'cairo':'القاهرة','al qahirah':'القاهرة','القاهره':'القاهرة',
    'giza':'الجيزة','al jizah':'الجيزة','الجيزه':'الجيزة',
    'alexandria':'الإسكندرية','al iskandariyah':'الإسكندرية','الاسكندريه':'الإسكندرية',
    'dakahlia':'الدقهلية','daqahlia':'الدقهلية','الدقهليه':'الدقهلية',
    'red sea':'البحر الأحمر','البحر الاحمر':'البحر الأحمر',
    'beheira':'البحيرة','البحيره':'البحيرة','fayoum':'الفيوم','faiyum':'الفيوم',
    'gharbia':'الغربية','gharbiyah':'الغربية','الغربيه':'الغربية',
    'ismailia':'الإسماعيلية','الاسماعيليه':'الإسماعيلية',
    'monufia':'المنوفية','menofia':'المنوفية','minufiya':'المنوفية','monufiya':'المنوفية','المنوفيه':'المنوفية',
    'minya':'المنيا','qalyubia':'القليوبية','qaliubiya':'القليوبية','القليوبيه':'القليوبية',
    'new valley':'الوادي الجديد','suez':'السويس','aswan':'أسوان','اسوان':'أسوان',
    'asyut':'أسيوط','assiut':'أسيوط','اسيوط':'أسيوط','beni suef':'بني سويف','bani suwayf':'بني سويف',
    'port said':'بورسعيد','damietta':'دمياط','sharqia':'الشرقية','sharqiyah':'الشرقية','الشرقيه':'الشرقية',
    'south sinai':'جنوب سيناء','kafr el sheikh':'كفر الشيخ','kafr ash shaykh':'كفر الشيخ',
    'matrouh':'مطروح','matruh':'مطروح','luxor':'الأقصر','الاقصر':'الأقصر','qena':'قنا',
    'north sinai':'شمال سيناء','sohag':'سوهاج'
  };

  function matchSelectValue(select,candidates){
    if(!select)return '';
    const wanted=(candidates||[]).map(normArabicPlace).filter(Boolean); if(!wanted.length)return '';
    const options=Array.from(select.options||[]).filter(function(o){return o.value&&o.value!=='AIRPORT'});
    for(const o of options){const n=normArabicPlace(o.value);if(wanted.includes(n))return o.value;}
    for(const o of options){const n=normArabicPlace(o.value);if(n&&wanted.some(function(w){return w.includes(n)||n.includes(w)}))return o.value;}
    return '';
  }

  function resolveGovernorateName(raw){
    const n=normArabicPlace(raw); if(!n)return '';
    const direct=matchSelectValue(document.getElementById('rideToGovernorate'),[raw]); if(direct)return direct;
    for(const key of Object.keys(MW_GOV_ALIASES)){const nk=normArabicPlace(key);if(n===nk||n.includes(nk)||nk.includes(n))return MW_GOV_ALIASES[key];}
    return '';
  }

  function autoFillLocationSelectors(mode,data){
    data=data||{}; mode=mode==='FROM'?'FROM':'TO';
    const governorate=resolveGovernorateName(data.governorate||data.adminArea||'');
    const centerCandidates=[data.center,data.subAdminArea,data.locality,data.city,data.district].filter(Boolean);
    const areaCandidates=[data.area,data.subLocality,data.neighborhood].filter(Boolean);
    if(mode==='TO'){
      const govSel=document.getElementById('rideToGovernorate');
      if(governorate&&govSel){
        govSel.value=governorate;
        if(govSel.value===governorate){
          onToGovernorateChange();
          const centerSel=document.getElementById('rideToCenter');
          const matchedCenter=matchSelectValue(centerSel,centerCandidates);
          if(matchedCenter){
            centerSel.value=matchedCenter; onToCenterChange();
            const villageSel=document.getElementById('rideToVillage');
            const matchedArea=matchSelectValue(villageSel,areaCandidates);
            if(matchedArea){villageSel.value=matchedArea;onToVillageChange();}
          }
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    if(!governorate||governorate==='المنوفية'){
      const fromCenter=document.getElementById('rideFromCenter');
      const matchedFrom=matchSelectValue(fromCenter,centerCandidates);
      if(matchedFrom){fromCenter.value=matchedFrom;onFromCenterChange();}
    }
  }

  function ensureLeaflet(){
    if(window.L)return Promise.resolve(window.L);
    if(mwLeafletPromise)return mwLeafletPromise;
    mwLeafletPromise=new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
      if(!document.querySelector('link[data-mw-leaflet]')){
        const link=document.createElement('link');link.rel='stylesheet';link.dataset.mwLeaflet='1';
        link.href='https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css';document.head.appendChild(link);
      }
      const sc=document.createElement('script');sc.src='https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js';sc.async=true;
      sc.onload=function(){window.L?resolve(window.L):reject(new Error('Leaflet unavailable'))};
      sc.onerror=function(){reject(new Error('تعذر تحميل الخريطة'))};document.head.appendChild(sc);
    });
    return mwLeafletPromise;
  }

  function placeMarker(lat,lng,pan){
    lat=num(lat);lng=num(lng);if(lat===null||lng===null)return;
    mwPendingPoint={lat:lat,lng:lng};
    if(mwMap){
      if(!mwMapMarker){
        mwMapMarker=L.marker([lat,lng],{draggable:true}).addTo(mwMap);
        mwMapMarker.on('dragend',function(e){const p=e.target.getLatLng();placeMarker(p.lat,p.lng,false)});
      }else mwMapMarker.setLatLng([lat,lng]);
      if(pan!==false)mwMap.setView([lat,lng],Math.max(mwMap.getZoom(),15));
    }
    setStatus('الموقع المحدد: '+fmt(lat)+', '+fmt(lng),false);
  }

  window.openMashwarakMapPicker=function(mode,initialPoint){
    mwMapMode=String(mode||'TO').toUpperCase()==='FROM'?'FROM':'TO';
    mwPendingLocationMeta=null;
    const modal=document.getElementById('mwMapPicker');
    const title=document.getElementById('mwMapPickerTitle');
    const label=document.getElementById('mwMapLabelInput');
    if(title)title.textContent=mwMapMode==='FROM'?'حدد نقطة الانطلاق':'حدد الوجهة';
    if(label)label.value=document.getElementById(sidePrefix(mwMapMode)+'MapLabel')?.value||'';
    if(modal){modal.classList.add('active');modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false')}
    document.documentElement.classList.add('mwMapOpen');document.body.classList.add('mwMapOpen');
    setStatus('جاري تحميل الخريطة...',false);
    ensureLeaflet().then(function(){
      if(!mwMap){
        mwMap=L.map('mwMapCanvas',{zoomControl:true}).setView(MW_MAP_DEFAULT,9);
        const osmTiles=L.tileLayer('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png',{
          maxZoom:19,
          attribution:'© OpenStreetMap contributors',
          crossOrigin:true
        }).addTo(mwMap);
        let mwTileErrors=0;
        osmTiles.on('tileload',function(){mwTileErrors=0});
        osmTiles.on('tileerror',function(){
          mwTileErrors++;
          if(mwTileErrors===3)setStatus('الخريطة لم تكتمل بعد. تحقق من الاتصال ثم افتحها مرة أخرى.',true);
        });
        mwMap.on('click',function(e){placeMarker(e.latlng.lat,e.latlng.lng,false)});
      }
      setTimeout(function(){mwMap.invalidateSize()},80);
      const current=initialPoint||getExisting(mwMapMode);
      if(current)placeMarker(current.lat,current.lng,true);
      else {
        mwPendingPoint=null;
        if(mwMapMode==='FROM'&&window.MashwarakLocation&&typeof window.MashwarakLocation.requestCurrentLocation==='function'){
          setStatus('جاري تحديد موقعك الحالي...',false);
          setTimeout(function(){try{window.MashwarakLocation.requestCurrentLocation()}catch(_){ }},120);
        }else{
          setStatus('استخدم «موقعي الحالي» أو اضغط على الخريطة لتحديد النقطة.',false);
        }
      }
    }).catch(function(){setStatus('تعذر تحميل الخريطة. تحقق من الإنترنت وحاول مرة أخرى.',true)});
  };

  window.closeMashwarakMapPicker=function(){
    const modal=document.getElementById('mwMapPicker');if(modal){modal.classList.remove('active');modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')}
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('mwMapOpen');document.body.classList.remove('mwMapOpen');
    mwPendingPoint=null;mwPendingLocationMeta=null;
  };

  window.useMyCurrentLocationForMap=function(){
    setStatus('جاري تحديد موقعك...',false);
    try{
      if(window.MashwarakLocation&&typeof window.MashwarakLocation.requestCurrentLocation==='function'){
        window.MashwarakLocation.requestCurrentLocation();
        return;
      }
    }catch(_){}
    if(!navigator.geolocation){setStatus('تحديد الموقع غير مدعوم على هذا الجهاز.',true);return}
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function(pos){
      placeMarker(pos.coords.latitude,pos.coords.longitude,true);
    },function(err){
      const msg=err&&err.code===1?'اسمح لمشوارك باستخدام الموقع ثم حاول مرة أخرى.':'تعذر تحديد موقعك حاليًا.';
      setStatus(msg,true);
    },{enableHighAccuracy:true,timeout:12000,maximumAge:15000});
  };

  function extractCoords(text){
    text=decodeURIComponent(String(text||'').replace(/\+/g,' '));
    const pats=[
      /(?:query|q|ll|destination)=\s*(-?\d{1,2}(?:\.\d+)?)\s*,\s*(-?\d{1,3}(?:\.\d+)?)/i,
      /@\s*(-?\d{1,2}(?:\.\d+)?)\s*,\s*(-?\d{1,3}(?:\.\d+)?)/,
      /geo:\s*(-?\d{1,2}(?:\.\d+)?)\s*,\s*(-?\d{1,3}(?:\.\d+)?)/i,
      /(?:^|[^\d.-])(-?\d{1,2}\.\d{4,})\s*,\s*(-?\d{1,3}\.\d{4,})(?:[^\d.]|$)/
    ];
    for(const p of pats){const m=text.match(p);if(m){const lat=num(m[1]),lng=num(m[2]);if(lat!==null&&lng!==null&&Math.abs(lat)<=90&&Math.abs(lng)<=180)return{lat,lng}}}
    return null;
  }

  window.pasteLocationLinkForMap=function(){
    const raw=prompt('الصق رابط الموقع أو الإحداثيات هنا:');if(!raw)return;
    const direct=extractCoords(raw);if(direct){placeMarker(direct.lat,direct.lng,true);return}
    setStatus('جاري قراءة رابط الموقع...',false);
    if(window.google&&google.script&&google.script.run){
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function(r){
        if(r&&r.success&&r.lat!=null&&r.lng!=null)placeMarker(r.lat,r.lng,true);
        else setStatus('لم نقدر نستخرج إحداثيات من الرابط. جرّب فتحه ثم مشاركة الموقع إلى تطبيق مشوارك.',true);
      }).withFailureHandler(function(){setStatus('تعذر قراءة رابط الموقع.',true)}).resolveMashwarakMapLinkV530(raw);
    }else setStatus('الرابط المختصر يحتاج فتحه من تطبيق مشوارك أو لصق الإحداثيات مباشرة.',true);
  };

  function setMapSelection(mode,lat,lng,label,source){
    mode=mode==='FROM'?'FROM':'TO';lat=num(lat);lng=num(lng);if(lat===null||lng===null)return false;
    const p=sidePrefix(mode),safeLabel=String(label||'').trim();
    const coords=fmt(lat)+', '+fmt(lng);
    const display=safeLabel||'موقع محدد على الخريطة';
    document.getElementById(p+'Lat').value=fmt(lat);
    document.getElementById(p+'Lng').value=fmt(lng);
    document.getElementById(p+'MapUrl').value=mapUrl(lat,lng);
    document.getElementById(p+'MapLabel').value=safeLabel;
    document.getElementById(mode==='FROM'?'rideFrom':'rideTo').value=display;
    if(mode==='TO')document.getElementById('rideToDetail').value=display;
    const choice=document.getElementById(p+'MapChoice');
    if(choice){
      choice.innerHTML='📍 <b>'+escapeMapHtml(display)+'</b><br><span>تم حفظ الموقع الدقيق على الخريطة</span><button type="button" onclick="clearMashwarakMapLocation(\''+mode+'\')">إلغاء الموقع</button>';
      choice.classList.add('show');
    }
    return true;
  }

  function escapeMapHtml(v){return String(v||'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return{'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]})}

  window.confirmMashwarakMapLocation=function(){
    if(!mwPendingPoint){setStatus('حدد نقطة على الخريطة أولًا.',true);return}
    const label=document.getElementById('mwMapLabelInput')?.value||'';
    if(mwPendingLocationMeta)autoFillLocationSelectors(mwMapMode,mwPendingLocationMeta);
    setMapSelection(mwMapMode,mwPendingPoint.lat,mwPendingPoint.lng,label,'MAP');
    closeMashwarakMapPicker();
  };

  window.clearMashwarakMapLocation=function(mode,keepManual){
    mode=String(mode||'TO').toUpperCase()==='FROM'?'FROM':'TO';const p=sidePrefix(mode);
    ['Lat','Lng','MapUrl','MapLabel'].forEach(function(s){const e=document.getElementById(p+s);if(e)e.value='' });
    const choice=document.getElementById(p+'MapChoice');if(choice){choice.classList.remove('show');choice.innerHTML=''}
    if(keepManual!==true){
      if(mode==='FROM'){ if(window.__mwOriginalSyncRideFrom)window.__mwOriginalSyncRideFrom(); }
      else { if(window.__mwOriginalSyncRideTo)window.__mwOriginalSyncRideTo(); }
    }
  };

  window.__mwOriginalSyncRideFrom=window.syncRideFrom;
  window.__mwOriginalSyncRideTo=window.syncRideTo;
  window.syncRideFrom=function(){
    const p=getExisting('FROM');if(p){
      const label=document.getElementById('rideFromMapLabel').value.trim();
      document.getElementById('rideFrom').value=label||'موقع محدد على الخريطة';return;
    }
    return window.__mwOriginalSyncRideFrom&&window.__mwOriginalSyncRideFrom();
  };
  window.syncRideTo=function(){
    const p=getExisting('TO');if(p){
      const label=document.getElementById('rideToMapLabel').value.trim();
      const display=label||'موقع محدد على الخريطة';
      document.getElementById('rideTo').value=display;document.getElementById('rideToDetail').value=display;return;
    }
    return window.__mwOriginalSyncRideTo&&window.__mwOriginalSyncRideTo();
  };

  const originalRouteNext=window.rideWizardNextFromRoute;
  window.rideWizardNextFromRoute=function(){
    const mapFrom=!!getExisting('FROM'),mapTo=!!getExisting('TO');
    if(!mapFrom&&!mapTo)return originalRouteNext();
    hideBox('rideError');syncRideFrom();syncRideTo();
    const missing=[],from=document.getElementById('rideFrom').value.trim(),to=document.getElementById('rideTo').value.trim();
    if(!from)missing.push('مكان الانطلاق');
    if(!mapTo){
      const gov=document.getElementById('rideToGovernorate').value,toCenter=document.getElementById('rideToCenter').value,toVillage=document.getElementById('rideToVillage').value,toOther=document.getElementById('rideToOther').value.trim();
      if(!gov)missing.push('المحافظة / الوجهة');
      if(gov&&gov!=='AIRPORT'&&!toCenter)missing.push('المركز / المدينة');
      if(gov&&gov!=='AIRPORT'&&!toVillage)missing.push('القرية / المنطقة');
      if(gov&&gov!=='AIRPORT'&&toVillage==='أخرى'&&!toOther)missing.push('كتابة القرية / المنطقة');
    }
    if(!to)missing.push('الوجهة');
    if(missing.length){showBox('rideError','يرجى استكمال: '+missing.join(' | ')+'.');return}
    rideWizardGo(2);
  };

  const originalReset=window.resetRideForm;
  window.resetRideForm=function(keepIdentity){
    const r=originalReset&&originalReset(keepIdentity);
    clearMashwarakMapLocation('FROM',true);clearMashwarakMapLocation('TO',true);return r;
  };

  // Any manual dropdown edit intentionally replaces a previously selected map point.
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
    ['rideFromCenter','rideFromVillage','rideFromOther'].forEach(function(id){const e=document.getElementById(id);if(e)e.addEventListener('change',function(){if(getExisting('FROM'))clearMashwarakMapLocation('FROM',true)})});
    ['rideToGovernorate','rideToCenter','rideToVillage','rideToOther'].forEach(function(id){const e=document.getElementById(id);if(e)e.addEventListener('change',function(){if(getExisting('TO'))clearMashwarakMapLocation('TO',true)})});
  });

  function importDestination(data){
    if(!data)return;const lat=num(data.lat),lng=num(data.lng);if(lat===null||lng===null)return;
    const label=String(data.label||'').trim();
    autoFillLocationSelectors('TO',data);
    setMapSelection('TO',lat,lng,label,'ANDROID');
    try{openScreen('customer');rideWizardGo(1);document.getElementById('rideToGroup')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'})}catch(_){ }
  }

  window.addEventListener('message',function(event){
    const data=event.data||{};
    if(data.type==='mashwarak-import-destination-location')importDestination(data);
    if(data.type==='mashwarak-current-location-result'){
      placeMarker(data.lat,data.lng,true);
      if(data.governorate||data.adminArea||data.center||data.subAdminArea||data.locality){
        mwPendingLocationMeta={governorate:data.governorate||data.adminArea||'',adminArea:data.adminArea||'',center:data.center||'',subAdminArea:data.subAdminArea||'',locality:data.locality||'',area:data.area||'',subLocality:data.subLocality||''};
      }
      const input=document.getElementById('mwMapLabelInput');
      const readable=String(data.label||'').trim()||'موقعي الحالي';
      if(input&&(readable!=='موقعي الحالي'||!input.value))input.value=readable;
      setStatus(readable==='موقعي الحالي'?'تم تحديد موقعك بدقة.':'تم تحديد موقعك: '+readable,false);
    }
    if(data.type==='mashwarak-current-location-error'){
      setStatus(data.message||'تعذر تحديد الموقع الحالي.',true);
    }
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
